title: Campaign Lead, Brand
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion's Integrated Marketing team connects our brand story to the world—ensuring that every campaign, launch, and experience builds on global awareness of Notion as the intelligent, AI-connected workspace for modern work. We're looking for a senior brand campaign leader who can set the vision for our biggest moments, turn ambiguous business goals into breakthrough campaign strategy, and rally a lean, cross-functional team to deliver work that's both culturally relevant and commercially effective. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: The Campaign Lead, Brand owns the strategy, orchestration, and performance of Notion's largest integrated brand campaigns—the tentpole moments that tell the most important stories about who we are, what we make, and why it matters. You'll be the connective tissue across launches and campaigns, making sure every global brand moment brings a cohesive, inspiring narrative to market across channels, audiences, and regions. Reporting to the Head of Brand & Integrated Marketing, you'll set the brand campaign roadmap, lead campaigns end-to-end from first brief to performance readout, and raise the bar for how the team plans, builds, and learns. You'll partner closely with Product Marketing, Creative, Comms, Growth Marketing, and Regional Marketing leads, and help develop other campaign managers on the team. Responsibilities include: - Define and own the annual brand campaign roadmap, aligning tentpole moments to company priorities, product launches, and business goals - Lead Notion's largest cross-functional tentpole campaigns from strategy through execution and measurement, making high-stakes calls on concept, channel mix, and trade-offs - Partner with in-house Creative to originate and champion bold, category-defining brand concepts, and know when to push an idea further versus when to ship it - Partner with Product Marketing and Comms to unify product and brand narratives into a single, compelling story for each moment - Own campaign budgets and agency/vendor relationships, and partner with Growth Marketing on integrated brand and performance media from planning through reporting - Build the measurement framework for brand campaigns with Analytics and Growth, connecting awareness and consideration to pipeline and business outcomes - Collaborate with regional teams and localization to adapt and scale campaigns across EMEA, APAC, and other key markets - Evolve the campaign operating system—briefs, tiering, workback plans, retros, and AI-powered workflows—so the whole team moves faster with more clarity - Represent brand campaigns with marketing leadership and executives, presenting strategy, progress, and results with a clear point of view SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 12+ years of experience in integrated or brand marketing, preferably in AI or tech, with a track record of leading large-scale, multi-channel brand campaigns that moved the business - Idea catalyst: You bring a concept-led approach and an opinionated point of view, sparking, shaping, and shepherding breakthrough concepts until they're undeniable—and you can sell them up and across the org - Strategic owner: You turn ambiguous goals into a clear campaign strategy and roadmap, and you're comfortable owning outcomes, budget, and trade-offs end to end - Hybrid brand + performance thinker: You care about craft and tone, and you think rigorously about metrics, media, and sales enablement. You're not a purist in any one discipline - AI fluency: You have deep, first-hand experience experimenting with AI tools and agents, and you have a perspective on the balance of human vs. AI in creative generation - Speed: You bias toward action and operate with ambition, creating processes that help cross-functional teams do the same - Leader without the title: People on the projects you lead become the best versions of themselves by working with you. You influence senior stakeholders, navigate conflicting feedback, and level up the people around you - Order agent: You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to run multiple complex workstreams at once while iterating for improvement NICE TO HAVES: - Experience leading global and/or regionalized campaigns - Experience managing creative agencies and large media budgets - Familiarity with hybrid audience targeting (individuals, teams, and enterprise) - Experience mentoring or managing marketers - Experience using Notion—both personally and professionally We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you're excited about a role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you're a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. customer outcomes.</li> <li value="7">Prepare and deliver accurate activity and forecast reports, and contribute to root cause analysis on wins and losses while sharing lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.</li> <li value="8">Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas, and use a consultative approach to create proposals, quotes, and presentations that clearly link GitLab’s solutions to customer business objectives.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">A true desire to see customers achieve meaningful outcomes and long-term value from their investment in GitLab.</li> <li value="2">Experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with large enterprises, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, business and technical teams.</li> <li value="4">Able to provide a high degree of account management and control, working under minimal supervision on complex opportunities while maintaining clear communication and alignment.</li> <li value="5">Ability to generate new business and expand existing accounts through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions that result in sustainable, long-term partnerships.</li> <li value="6">Experience collaborating with strategic channel partners to develop opportunities, co-sell, and support successful customer adoption.</li> <li title: Senior Account Manager - Warehouse Automation (Japanese Speaking) - BENELUX
description: At Exotec, we design elegant, plug-and-play, and reliable end-to-end warehouse robotics solutions. As a leading Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Integrator, we support some of the world’s most iconic brands in their transition to automation. We’re proud to design technology that doesn’t just redefine intralogistics; it also makes warehouses safer, faster, more efficient, and less physically demanding for the people working inside them. Why this role matters Ready to move the world of intralogistics with tech? Join us as a Service Account Manager. What You'll Do We are looking for individuals who put customers first, take ownership of their work, execute with rigor, and simplify complex challenges. Successful team members demonstrate a continuous improvement mindset, collaborate effectively across functions, and contribute to collective success. At Exotec, we value people who are proactive, transparent, respectful, adaptable, and committed to delivering excellence while building long-term trust with both customers and colleagues. Own the strategic relationship with a portfolio of customers, serving as their primary point of contact for service performance, escalations, and long-term success. Lead regular business reviews and governance meetings with customers, ensuring transparency on KPIs, system performance, ongoing actions, and improvement plans. Partner closely with Area Managers, Maintenance teams, Product, Performance Engineering, and Support functions to resolve customer concerns and drive operational excellence. Act as the voice of the customer internally, translating customer feedback and business needs into actionable improvement initiatives. Identify risks, challenges, and opportunities within customer accounts, coordinating proactive action plans to maintain customer satisfaction and contract performance. Support customer growth by identifying upselling opportunities, service extensions, and additional value-added solutions aligned with customer needs. Oversee the successful transition of customer sites from Deployment to Maintenance, ensuring a seamless handover and clear ownership model. Monitor contractual performance, service levels, and commercial commitments while ensuring alignment between customer expectations and operational delivery. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance system reliability, service quality, and the overall customer experience. Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders, from operational teams to senior leadership, acting as a long-term partner to their business. Requirements Fluency in Japanese (N2 level and above) Experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, or Service Delivery. Strong customer-facing skills and experience managing demanding stakeholders. Ability to navigate complex organizations and coordinate cross-functional teams. Commercial awareness with the ability to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts. Experience working in logistics, warehouse automation, intralogistics, manufacturing, industrial services, or a similar environment is highly valued. Excellent communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills. Fluent English required; additional languages are a plus. Why you’ll love working here Make an impact by building technology that improves business performance and people's everyday work. Grow faster by solving complex challenges in a fast-moving company where innovation, speed and ambition accelerate your development. Belong to a global team where diversity, inclusion and collaboration drive better decisions and stronger solutions. Connect beyond work by sharing passions, celebrating milestones and building lasting relationships that strengthen the way we work together. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Cyber Essentials Plus Lead Assessor (IASME licensed)
description: Intelance is a UK advisory and assurance firm and an IASME licensed Certification Body for Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus. We are adding experienced Cyber Essentials Plus Lead Assessors to our associate panel to lead UK client assessments from start to finish. This is an associate contractor role. Work is offered assessment by assessment, with no guaranteed volume. Each assignment is covered by a written statement of work that sets out the scope, timetable, location and fee before you accept it. Tasks Lead Cyber Essentials Plus assessments from scoping to certificate decision, in line with the current IASME and NCSC test specification. Check the Cyber Essentials self assessment and confirm the Cyber Essentials Plus scope is correct before testing starts. Work out the device sample and plan testing of user devices, internet gateways, cloud services and public facing services. Carry out remote and onsite testing, authenticated vulnerability scans and evidence checks. Record findings clearly, agree fixes with the client and manage retesting within the permitted timescale. Write complete assessment records and clear client reports. Review the work of other assessors on the panel before results are submitted, and give them practical feedback. Handle the larger and more complex assessments, such as multi site organisations and mixed Windows, macOS, Linux and mobile estates. Work through Intelance accounts, systems and quality checks, and protect all client information. Tell us about any conflict of interest before you accept an assignment. Requirements Essential Current IASME appointment as a Cyber Essentials Assessor and a Cyber Essentials Plus Assessor. We will check this with IASME. At least two years of delivering Cyber Essentials Plus assessments, with 20 or more completed in the last 12 months. Experience reviewing or signing off other assessors' work, or acting as Lead Assessor for a Certification Body. Based in the UK and able to attend client sites in the UK when an assessment needs it. Strong hands on knowledge of Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, firewalls, cloud services, multi factor authentication and vulnerability scanning. Able to explain findings in plain English to business owners and IT teams. Professional Indemnity and Public Liability insurance of at least £1m each before any client work starts. Two recent references for Cyber Essentials Plus work. Useful CISSP, CISM, CREST, OSCP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or another qualification accepted on the IASME assessor route. Experience with Qualys, Tenable Nessus or a similar approved scanning tool. IASME Cyber Assurance assessor status. Benefits Day rate of £375 to £550, or a fixed fee for each assessment agreed before you accept the work. A steady flow of scoped assessments from an established Certification Body, with no sales work for you to do. Remote preparation and reporting, with site visits only when the assessment needs them. Access to Intelance templates, scanning capability, secure collaboration tools and quality review. A clear route to a trusted associate role and more senior assurance work across ISO 27001 and IASME Cyber Assurance. You choose which assignments you accept. Apply with your CV and answer the short screening questions. Shortlisted applicants will be asked for IASME assessor evidence and two references. Please do not send any client material. Hiring will be a big focus early on as the team grows.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and develop the team.</strong> Coach and grow engineers across time zones, with clear expectations, useful feedback and async practices that hold up, and hire well as the team grows.</li> <li><strong>Own the technical direction and quality bar.</strong> This is an AI-native team: agents write most of the code, and engineers set the direction and own the result. You’ll review designs and architecture, set the standards for testing, code review, CI/CD and releases, and be accountable for everything the team ships meeting a high bar for quality, however much of it AI wrote.</li> <li><strong>Shape what gets built.</strong> Each application has a named business owner who owns the outcome; you own how it’s built and run. Decide with them whether to build, buy, configure or extend, weighing cost, expected return and long-term ownership.</li> <li><strong>Manage delivery across the portfolio.</strong> Turn priorities into achievable plans, make trade-offs visible and balance new work with maintenance and support.</li> <li><strong>Work as one team with AI Engineering.</strong> Application development and AI engineering are one Enterprise AI team with different focus areas. Decide together whether a problem needs an app, an agent or a skill.</li> <li><strong>Protect sensitive data.</strong> Several applications hold people and financial data. Work with Security, Privacy and Legal on access, data protection reviews and works council requirements.</li> <li><strong>Own each application for its whole life.</strong> Make sure each one has an owner, monitoring, support and a known cost to run, and consolidate or retire it when it stops earning its keep.</li> <li><strong>Measure what matters.</strong> Track idea-to-production time, user satisfaction (CSAT) and cost to run against value.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li>Several years managing software engineering teams, including senior engineers, with a record of hiring and developing people.</li> <li>A background building and running production software across the stack, including data and integrations, so you can engage credibly with the technical detail.</li> <li>Sound engineering and product judgment: you know when an approach needs to change and where custom software is justified.</li> <li>Experience leading a distributed team across time zones in a highly cross-functional, remote and asynchronous setting.</li> <li>Experience leading AI-native development, where agents write most of the code, and the judgment to keep quality high as output grows.</li> <li>Strong communication with technical and non-technical partners.</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading a portfolio of internal business applications.</li> <li>Experience with GitLab, CI/CD and data platforms such as Snowflake.</li> <li>Experience with applications that handle sensitive people or financial data.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Enterprise Application Development sits within Enterprise AI in GitLab’s Enterprise Technology & AI organization. title: Senior Professional Services Engineer - Charlotte, NC
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Professional Services Engineer at GitLab, you'll work directly with customers to deliver installation, migration, training, and advisory services that help them adopt GitLab successfully. You'll lead engagements from single-node Omnibus installs to large reference architectures built with infrastructure as code (IaC) and configuration as code. You'll also guide migrations from other systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed deployments, and help customers make practical decisions that improve reliability, security, and day-to-day workflows.</p> <p>In this role, you'll work closely with customers and GitLab's product and engineering teams to drive customer success and share feedback that improves GitLab and how we deliver services. You'll manage multiple projects at once, mentor other Professional Services Engineers, and help streamline how we deliver consistent outcomes in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li>Designing and delivering GitLab installations and reference architectures using tools like Terraform and Ansible across major cloud providers</li> <li>Leading migrations to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, and turning customer feedback into actionable improvements for GitLab's product and engineering teams</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deliver GitLab Professional Services engagements, including installation, migration, training, and advisory services across GitLab capabilities.</li> <li>Plan and execute deployments ranging from single-node Omnibus installations to large reference architectures using Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code practices.</li> <li>Lead migrations from multiple source systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, helping customers adopt secure, reliable workflows.</li> <li>Partner with Engagement Managers and Project Managers to improve delivery consistency, remove friction, and continuously refine delivery processes.</li> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor for customers, translating goals and constraints into practical implementation plans and clear next steps.</li> <li>Interface with GitLab's product and engineering teams to unblock customer outcomes and share feedback that helps improve GitLab features and services.</li> <li>Mentor Associate and Intermediate Professional Services Engineers, providing technical guidance, helping remove blockers, and supporting increased autonomy.</li> <li>Manage and deliver multiple customer engagements at once, either as the primary engineer or as a lead providing oversight and direction to other engineers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Professional exposure with one or more infrastructure as code or configuration as code technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, or Chef.</li> <li>Professional exposure with two or more cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure.</li> <li><strong>This role has a location requirement - Charlotte, NC or nearby - on site at the Customer location in Charlotte, 5 days a week.</strong></li> <li>Experience using, deploying, or configuring GitLab, including a solid understanding of Git and source control workflows.</li> <li>Experience delivering customer-facing services such as installation, migration, training, and advisory engagements across GitLab's feature set.</li> <li>Proven ability to independently manage one or more projects and to lead and provide direction to other Professional Services Engineers on complex engagements.</li> <li>Strong communication skills in English, written and verbal, with the ability to provide clear status updates and build consensus with peers and customers in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to take a solution-oriented approach by identifying root causes, proposing options and tradeoffs, and driving issues to resolution while balancing multiple customer engagements in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fully remote organization by communicating clearly in writing, documenting decisions, collaborating asynchronously across time zones, and working in ways consistent with GitLab's values.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Senior Professional Services Engineers are part of GitLab's Professional Services team. We partner closely with Engagement Managers and Project Managers to deliver consistent outcomes, and we work with GitLab's product and engineering teams to share customer feedback and improve GitLab. Professional Services operates in a fully remote and largely asynchronous environment, collaborating across regions and time zones. You’ll help both leaders focus on their highest-impact work across teams spanning digital experience, marketing operations, events, community and developer relations, campaigns, product marketing, and launches. Beyond calendar management, you’ll join leadership discussions, keep projects and recurring meetings moving, and connect the leaders with their organizations through a monthly launch rhythm. In your first year, you’ll build trusted relationships with both leaders, their teams, and the other executive support partners, and establish reliable processes for scheduling, meeting preparation, travel, events, recruiting coordination, and expenses. You’ll anticipate needs four to six weeks ahead and follow commitments through to completion. You’ll move quickly, build AI-powered workflows to automate recurring work, and be a warm, approachable partner to the people on both leaders’ teams.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own high-volume calendars across time zones for both leaders, connecting meeting priorities to quarterly goals and business rhythms. Protect focus time, recommend how to prioritize or delegate requests, and provide inbox triage when requested.</li> <li>Prepare leadership meetings, all-hands, and the monthly in-person launch review: coordinate agendas, pre-reads, and attendance, keep time, and capture and follow up on action items.</li> <li>Maintain the leadership project tracker and weekly leadership, monthly goals, and quarterly business reviews. Build work-back plans, follow up with owners, and flag delays, deadlines, and decisions so the right people stay involved and informed.</li> <li>Partner with senior directors and team leads across both organizations, helping when it moves the leaders’ priorities and bringing the leaders in when it matters.</li> <li>Support team connection by remembering milestones and getting notes, gifts, or flowers out quickly.</li> <li>Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, security needs, and documentation. Arrange alternatives when plans change, and prepare accurate monthly expense reports with receipts and reconciliation.</li> <li>Plan team offsites, leadership working sessions, and company kickoffs from start to finish, working with event partners and confirming reservations, deposits, and logistics through completion.</li> <li>Partner with Recruiting and hiring teams on interviews, candidate communication, and onboarding logistics, and with People, information technology (IT), and Security on team needs. Provide coverage for executive support partners, help onboard new support partners, and take on Marketing special projects.</li> <li>Build and maintain artificial intelligence (AI) workflows, with Claude as our standard, to automate research, drafting, meeting summaries, and recurring administrative work. Check outputs for accuracy and context rather than relying on automated summaries alone.</li> <li>Identify recurring friction in how the teams work, and propose and implement improvements to processes and documentation.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience supporting two or more VP-level leaders simultaneously at a fast-growing company, ideally SaaS or AI-forward, adapting to distinct working styles and business priorities.</li> <li>A bias for action and ownership: you move from ask to done quickly, act independently within agreed priorities, and communicate progress proactively, with an organized, reliable approach to balancing priorities.</li> <li>Comfort figuring things out on your own in a fast-changing environment with limited resources.</li> <li>Experience managing complex calendars across time zones, using judgment to balance competing requests and checking scheduling details and attendees.</li> <li>Project management skills, including building work-back plans, following up with owners, and keeping multiple workstreams moving with minimal oversight.</li> <li>Experience coordinating international travel and team events from start to finish, anticipating dependencies, responding to disruptions, and confirming arrangements through completion.</li> <li>Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Okta, Navan, Claude, and GitLab, alongside experience with expense reporting, recruiting coordination, and onboarding logistics.</li> <li>Clear, approachable communication across functions and levels, and a track record of building trust with executives, peers, and other executive support partners.</li> <li>Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information.</li> <li>Experience in a remote, asynchronous environment where documentation and written communication are central.</li> <li>Flexibility to support meetings across time zones outside standard hours on occasion, with up to quarterly travel for team meetings and all-hands (about four trips a year, three to four days each).</li> <li>Located in the US or Canada, with strong overlap with Pacific time.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>You’ll join GitLab’s Marketing organization and support two leaders who together lead about 120 people in a fast-moving, AI-forward organization. Their teams work closely together on campaigns, launches, and events. You’ll work alongside a globally distributed group of executive support professionals who collaborate asynchronously through clear documentation and shared processes. The focus is dependable support: keeping priorities clear, coordinating global travel and events, and ensuring commitments are completed and communicated as plans change.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. description: IMPORTANT Application note Please apply only through this job portal. Kindly do not send applications or recruitment messages by email or LinkedIn. Only applications submitted through the portal will be considered. Thank you. About AgentixLake AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities. Your role Build AI application components that are ready to be tested, deployed and maintained. You will take ownership of defined engineering work within our generative AI projects, collaborating with colleagues on implementation, review and operational quality. Our team builds enterprise AI solutions that connect models with useful data and tools. Your work may contribute to document intelligence, knowledge assistants, governed analytics or AI agents that support engineering and operational workflows. What you will do Develop Python services and integrations connecting language models to enterprise data, APIs and tools. Implement document ingestion, chunking, embeddings and retrieval, with source references that users can inspect. Build structured extraction and validation workflows for complex documents and downstream business systems. Implement defined agent steps, including tool calls, permission checks, error handling and human approval. Maintain evaluation cases and compare retrieval quality, answer usefulness, latency and cost as the application changes. Contribute automated tests, deployment configuration, logging and documentation through reviewed pull requests. What you bring Current university enrolment in computer science, AI, data science or a related technical discipline. Strong practical Python skills and evidence of software you have delivered for actual users, including responsibility for testing and deployment. Hands-on experience with an LLM application involving retrieval, tool use or structured outputs, and the ability to explain its limitations. Comfort working with APIs, JSON, Git and code review, and taking a defined task from an agreed requirement to a maintainable implementation. Clear English communication and an evidence-based approach to debugging and evaluating system behaviour. Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, FastAPI, Docker, vector databases or self-hosted models is valuable. We value sound implementation decisions more than the number of frameworks on your CV. What you can expect You will contribute to real delivery work with direct access to experienced engineers and the founders. Expect clear ownership, thoughtful code review and a part-time scope planned around your studies. How to apply Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Explain one AI application you built, your individual contribution, how you evaluated it and what you improved after testing. An anonymised description is welcome; please do not share confidential client material. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If the core responsibilities match your experience, we would like to hear from you. Stay connected Follow AgentixLake on LinkedIn for practical engineering insights, project updates and future opportunities. Following is optional and does not influence recruitment decisions. title: Performance Marketing Manager - Fokus SEA (m/w/d)
description: Wir möchten die Anlaufstelle für Google Ads & Web Analytics für E-Commerce Unternehmen mit großem Produktsortiment im DACH-Raum werden. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass viele Online-Shops noch nicht ihr volles Potenzial aufgrund von schlechter Betreuung ausschöpfen. Wir wollen das ändern. Dabei legen wir bei uns einen großen Wert auf persönliche Entwicklung, operative und strategische Erstklassigkeit sowie Transparenz. Wir wollen, dass sich alle unsere Teammitglieder fachlich als auch menschlich weiterentwickeln und so für außergewöhnlich gute Kundenergebnisse sorgen. Über uns Wir sitzen im wunderschönen Hamburg direkt am Jungfernstieg und unser Team besteht derzeit aus 7 Personen verteilt in Deutschland. Wir möchten als Unternehmen personell weiter wachsen, um noch mehr spannende Kunden bedienen zu können. Wir arbeiten vollständig Remote (mit Möglichkeit auf einen Büroplatz in Hamburg), treffen uns aber regelmäßig persönlich auf unseren Quartalsmeetings oder Konferenzen zum gemeinsamen Arbeiten, Workshops und Teambuilding Aktivitäten. Wir legen viel Wert auf strategische Beratung erstklassige operative Ausführung. Das heißt, Du findest hier keine Massenabfertigung sondern kannst Dir wirklich Zeit nehmen, um das Meiste aus Deinen Kunden rauszuholen. Aufgaben Als Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) bist du dafür verantwortlich, die besten Ergebnisse für Deine Kunden zu erfüllen - alleine und gemeinsam im Zweier-Projektteam. Du übernimmst ein Portfolio mit bestehenden E-Commerce Kunden (4-6 stellige monatliche Budgets) und betreust diese operativ und auch strategisch bei der Weiterentwicklung. Du übernimmst dabei das Aufsetzen, die Steuerung, Messung und Optimierung der Google Ads (& Microsoft Ads) Kampagnen und optimalerweise auch Web Analytics Maßnahmen und sorgst somit maßgeblich für den Erfolg des Kunden. Du konzipierst und planst eigenständig hochprofitable Performance-Marketing-Strategien: Dabei nutzt du deine Kenntnisse von Google Search / Shopping / PMAX/ Demand Gen / YouTube / Display und sorgst somit für die effiziente Steigerung der Umsätze deiner Kunden. Du hältst eigenständig oder bei Großkunden gemeinsam mit Sergej (Geschäftsführer) oder einem der Unit Leads SEA-Team, regelmäßige Termine zur Abstimmung mit den Kunden und zeigst ihnen neue Möglichkeiten fürs Wachstum. Du übernimmst die Analyse und Auswertung der Kampagnen und kannst anhand der Reportings Empfehlungen ableiten. Du beobachtest Marktentwicklungen und identifizierst neue Chancen zum weiteren Ausbau der Performance-Aktivitäten. Du analysierst die Unternehmensstruktur Deiner Kunden, verstehst die wirtschaftlich relevanten Kennzahlen und bildest darauf aufbauend performance-orientierte Lösungen ab. Es ist wichtig, dass du eigenständig arbeiten kannst, dir die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Kunden Spaß macht und du gerne ins Detail gehst. Du bist in der Lage Dir immer wieder das neueste Wissen anzueignen und bei Deinen Kundenprokten einzusetzen. Qualifikation Mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Agenturumfeld - im Bereich Performance-Marketing mit dem Schwerpunkt SEA bzw. Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMAX etc. Kampagnen). Erfahrener Umgang mit fünf- bis sechsstelligen Budgets bei Google Ads. Zusätzlich praktische Erfahrung mit Google Merchant Center, Google Analytics. Bonus wäre Erfahrung mit Looker Studio und dem Google Tag Manager. Praktische Erfahrung im eigenständigen Kundenkontakt und Kundenentwicklung durch vorherige Positionen. Kundenorientierte, selbstständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Dienstleistungsorientierung. Die Analyse und Auswertung von Daten gehört zu Deinen größten Stärken. Du wertest Deine Kampagnen aus und triffst auf Basis Deiner Analyse die nächste Entscheidung. Dein selbstbewusstes Auftreten, Deine souveräne Art sowie starke Kommunikations Skills zeichnen Dich aus und machen Dich unheimlich erfolgreich im Kundenkontakt/ in der Kundenbetreuung. Nice to have: Abgeschlossenes wirtschaftliches Studium und/ oder vergleichbarer Studiengang/ Ausbildung. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift. Fester Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Benefits Erlebe eine wachsende Agentur hautnah und nutze die Möglichkeit, direkt an Entscheidungen beteiligt zu sein und aktiv mitzugestalten, anstatt in eingestaubten Strukturen gefangen zu sein. Steile Lernkurve durch Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch unsere jahrelange Erfahrung im SEA und Web Analytics und jährlicher Besuch von Fachmessen oder Schulungen. Lange Kundenbindung ermöglicht es, sich sehr tief mit unseren Kunden und ihren Prozessen auseinander zu setzen, um gemeinsam mit den Kunden zu wachsen. Karriereperspektiven und die Möglichkeit an der Gestaltung der Agenturprozesse teilzuhaben. Flache Hierarchien: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Sergej, dem Geschäftsführer und Aufstiegschancen. Zugriff auf unser sehr umfangreiches internes Wissens Wiki. Quartalsweise mehrtätige Meetings mit dem ganzen Team für gemeinsames Arbeiten, Workshops und Teambuilding Aktivitäten. Ausstattung mit Apple MacBook, großem Bildschirm und hochwertigen Peripheriegeräte. Home Office (innerhalb Deutschlands) mit Option ins Büro in Hamburg zu kommen. Zusätzlich die Möglichkeit vereinzelnt aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten. Flexible Arbeitszeiten - 39h Wochenarbeitszeit mit Kernarbeitszeiten von Mo. - Fr. 10:00 - 15:00. 30 Tage Urlaub + 1 Urlaubstag am Geburtstag + Halber Tag am 24. & 31.12 = Bis zu 32 Urlaubstage. Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft. Du solltest Lust haben, in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten und Prozesse mitzugestalten, damit wir als Agentur weiter wachsen können. Wir wünschen uns auch, dass Du Deine Expertise einbringst und uns als Team weiter entwickelst. Der interne Austausch ist uns sehr wichtig, denn nur so ist ein gesundes menschliches und fachliches Wachstum möglich. Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder Dein gepflegtes LinkedIn Profil zu und erzähle uns über Deine bisherigen praktischen Erfahrungen im SEA als auch in der Kundenbetreuung. Wir freuen uns sehr auf Deine Bewerbung! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Web Designer Intern (m/f/d)
description: Most of the internet looks the same now. Help us make sure our corner of it doesn't. Cloud Studios is a product studio in Berlin. We build our own products and grow the strongest into companies. Our whole idea fits in one line: build what should exist . We're looking for a Web Designer Intern to own how our websites look, feel and work. Ours, and our clients'. What you'll work on A wide range of work, across several brands at once: Our own sites. The Cloud Studios and GetMOW websites are live, and they're never finished. You'll redesign pages, sharpen what's there and add what's missing. Launches. We have new products in the pipeline. When one is ready to meet the world, you'll design the site it meets the world on, often starting from a blank page. Client websites. We also design and build websites for clients. You'll take projects from first idea to live site, and help present them. The details nobody asked for. Motion, interactions, the 404 page, what happens when you hover. That's where a website stops looking like everyone else's. By the end of your internship, you'll have several live websites with your name on them. Ownership, for real You won't be pushing pixels on someone else's mockup. You'll get a brief, sometimes just a problem, and the freedom to answer it your way. You'll work directly with Eli, our founder, from the first idea to launch day, and see your work go live in weeks, not quarters. That freedom comes with responsibility. If you think a page is wrong, say so and redesign it. Nobody here will ask you to stay in your lane. About AI Anyone can generate a website now. That's the problem. The internet is filling up with sites that look like they all came from the same prompt, and we're not hiring someone to make more of them. We use AI every day, and we'd love it if you do too: to explore faster, prototype faster and build things you couldn't build alone. But the idea has to be yours. Your taste, your references, your weirdness. We want work that nobody could copy by typing the same prompt. If something in your portfolio has made someone ask "how did you do that?", we want to see it. Who you are You've designed websites before, and you can show us. Client work, a side project, your own portfolio, a site for your friend's band: live sites count for more than concepts. You have opinions about type, layout and motion. You notice when something is a few pixels off, and it bothers you. You'd rather make something strange that works than something safe that nobody remembers. You'll need: Experience designing websites, and a portfolio that proves it. Strong skills in Figma or a similar design tool. A real eye for typography, layout and motion. Good English, written and spoken. To work independently. You'll manage your own time and projects, whether you're at home or in the office. Bonus points: You can turn a design into a simple live page with a no-code tool like Framer or Webflow, or with a little HTML and CSS. Nice to have, not a must: you won't be writing production code here. You've designed or built with AI before, and you have an opinion on where it helps and where it doesn't. There's something in your portfolio you made purely because you wanted it to exist. German. A design role, not a development role To be clear about what this is: this internship is about visual and interaction design . You'll spend your time on concepts, layouts, typography, motion and design systems, mostly in Figma. Development is handled separately. If you're mainly a frontend developer who designs a bit on the side, this probably isn't the right fit. If you're a designer who can't stop thinking about how a site looks, feels and moves, it is. What you get Ownership early. Real websites, real clients and real launches, from your first week. Creative freedom. We give you problems, not pixel specs. A portfolio that's actually live. Websites real people use, not concepts in a Figma file. Founder-level access. You work directly with Eli, and you see how a studio launches products. Work from anywhere in Germany. Remote is fine. If you're in Berlin, or want to be, there's a desk for you at our office. A way in. If it's a great fit, the conversation towards the end of your internship is about staying on. How we work Execution beats perfection. We ship, learn and improve. We don't wait for perfect. Be a sponge. Learn from everyone, every project and every mistake. Agency is a skill. Nobody hands you the next step. You find it. Say it directly. We tell you what we think, and we expect the same back. Who you'll work with You'll work directly with Eli Cloud Läufer, who founded Cloud Studios in Berlin in autumn 2025, and alongside Öykü, our product designer, and Jenna in marketing and design. Who can apply You must live in Germany and be currently enrolled at a German university or in vocational training in Germany, and one of these must apply to you: Mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum): your study or training regulations require you to complete an internship. You'll need to confirm this with your enrollment certificate and your program's internship requirement. Voluntary internship alongside your studies: up to three months, and only if you have never interned at Cloud Studios before. If neither applies to you, we unfortunately can't consider your application. Details Duration: Three to six months (mandatory internship) or up to three months (voluntary internship). Working hours: 20 to 40 hours per week. Location: Remote from anywhere in Germany, or from our Berlin office. You don't need to be in Berlin. Start date: As soon as possible. How to apply Apply through our application form. It takes about ten minutes. The most important part is your portfolio, and the one project in it you'd fight for. Show us something nobody else would have made. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d)
description: Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus) You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology. Why join us? 🎯 Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development. 🌍 Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations. 🤝 International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites. 🚀 Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure. 📚 Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company. About us – in brief Headquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%. Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide. Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure. Your Role – What You'll Own You will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform. Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation. Your Responsibilities Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites. Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication. Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need. Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites. Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop. Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs. Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues. Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities. Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned. What You Bring We are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations. Must-have – Essential Requirements The following skills and experience are essential for this position: Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage. Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure. Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management. Infrastructure Modernization A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems. Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations. Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments. Identity & Access Management Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments. Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication. Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls. Endpoint Management Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment. Resilience, Security & Monitoring Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor. Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation. Communication & Collaboration Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations. Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders. Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage. Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations. Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered. Nice-to-have – Additional Experience The following skills are beneficial but not essential: Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects. Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods. Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management. Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers. Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel. Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub. Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform. Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP. Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300. Your First 12 Months Your initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure: Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure. Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt. Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required. Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune. Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency. Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery. Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop. What We Offer Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site. Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience. Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses. Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security. Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company. Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices. Team culture: Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the group. 📍 Location: Remote within Germany or Switzerland (Bexbach proximity is a plus) 📅 Start date: As soon as possible ⏳ Employment type: Permanent, full-time Ready to Shape Our Global IT Infrastructure? We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make things better and deliver real technical improvements. Send us your application – no perfectly polished cover letter required. We are interested in your experience, your technical expertise and what you can bring to our team. We look forward to hearing from you! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You’ll focus on building strong relationships with hiring teams, improving and standardizing coordination workflows, and supporting GitLab's goal of hiring a qualified, diverse, and motivated team in our all-remote, global environment.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Recruiters, hiring teams, and Recruiting leadership to understand and execute the hiring plan for each job requisition.</li> <li>Coordinate with Recruiters to maintain accurate, up-to-date hiring process information in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li>Manage candidate scheduling and act as the Recruiting Coordinator to organize interviews and keep hiring processes running smoothly.</li> <li>Ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and engaging communication at each stage of the hiring process.</li> <li>Help manage candidate traffic for all roles, monitoring pipelines and flagging issues or bottlenecks to the recruiting team.</li> <li>Create and stage employment contracts for candidates receiving offers on behalf of hiring managers and Recruiters.</li> <li>Partner with People Operations to create a seamless handoff for new team members joining GitLab.</li> <li>Promote GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction, acting as a brand ambassador for potential team members.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting end to end hiring processes in partnership with recruiters and hiring managers, ideally in a fast paced or high volume environment.</li> <li>Skill using an applicant tracking system to schedule, track, and move candidates through interview stages; Greenhouse experience is beneficial but not required.</li> <li>Proficiency with Google Workspace, scheduling tools,  and a willingness to learn and use additional tools.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally with candidates and internal stakeholders at all levels, including executives.</li> <li>Demonstrated strength in organization, time management, and prioritization, with a consistent focus on meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to build collaborative relationships with team members across time zones and functions while maintaining a high level of confidentiality.</li> <li>Interest in learning about talent acquisition and contributing to an inclusive hiring process that attracts a qualified, diverse, and motivated team.</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab's values and comfort working in an all remote, asynchronous environment, including flexibility in your working hours to support candidates and hiring teams across multiple time zones, with openness to transferable experience from related coordination or operations roles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Candidate Experience team partners with Recruiters, hiring managers, and People Operations to run a smooth, consistent, and inclusive hiring process across GitLab's all-remote, global organization. You'll join a collaborative group that coordinates interview logistics, manages candidate flow in our applicant tracking system, and supports offer and onboarding handoffs so candidates and hiring teams have a clear, organized experience at every stage. The team works asynchronously across time zones, using GitLab and shared documentation to stay aligned while handling high-volume hiring. Our focus is on refining processes, maintaining accurate data, and acting as brand ambassadors for GitLab's values in every candidate interaction.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Solutions Architect - SLED (East)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a SLED Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted technical advisor to State, Local, and Education customers in every state east of the Mississippi River: state agencies, counties, cities, special districts, community colleges, and public, private, and research universities. These organizations deliver services residents and students rely on every day, often with lean IT teams, aging systems, fixed fiscal-year budgets, and growing cybersecurity threats.</p> <p>You'll show them how GitLab's DevSecOps platform and AI capabilities, including the GitLab Duo Agent Platform, help them modernize legacy applications, protect sensitive resident and student data, meet state and sector compliance requirements, and do more with the staff they have. You'll own the technical evaluation and validation stages of the sales cycle, guide customers through proofs of concept and value, and translate platform capabilities into outcomes that agency leaders, CIOs, CISOs, and procurement officers can defend in a budget request or an RFP evaluation.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with SLED account executives, channel partners, and systems integrators, provide technical guidance from first conversation through successful deployment, and bring the voice of the SLED customer back into Product, Sales, and Marketing.</p> <p><strong>Location and travel:</strong> The territory covers all states east of the Mississippi River. The candidate must reside in the Northeast part of the United States. This role requires up to 50% travel.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Engage SLED customers onsite and remotely, from state capitals to university campuses, with tailored demos, technical presentations, and hands-on workshops that tie GitLab to their mission.</li> <li>Partner with SLED account executives to shape account strategies that align with each customer's fiscal year budget cycle, legislative appropriations, IT modernization plans, and grant or federal pass through funding.</li> <li>Own the technical evaluation process, including proof of concept (POC) and proof of value (POV) design and delivery, and provide technical responses for RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and security questionnaires.</li> <li>Support purchases made through cooperative purchasing agreements and statewide contract vehicles by working with channel and reseller partners.</li> <li>Guide customers through state and sector security requirements, such as GovRAMP and NIST frameworks, and show how GitLab's built in security, auditability, and deployment options reduce compliance burden.</li> <li>Help agencies and institutions modernize legacy and mainframe applications, such as unemployment insurance, tax, DMV, benefits, and student information systems, using GitLab and AI-assisted development to lower risk and offset shrinking pools of legacy skilled staff.</li> <li>Advise customers on adopting AI responsibly, including the GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in line with state AI policies, governance boards, and data privacy requirements.</li> <li>Lead the creation of Customer Success Plans that capture technical success criteria and handoff details, ensuring a smooth path to deployment and adoption, often for IT teams with limited capacity.</li> <li>Work alongside Account Executives to build data driven business cases that quantify delivery bottlenecks, giving customers a defensible basis for budget requests and clear evidence of return on taxpayer investment.</li> <li>Build relationships with CIOs, CISOs, agency directors, enterprise architects, faculty, research computing leaders, and procurement officers so they become advocates for GitLab, including across agencies and campuses that share services.</li> <li>Collaborate with systems integrators and state IT shared-services organizations to scale GitLab adoption across multiple agencies, local governments, or campuses.</li> <li>Serve as the SLED customer advocate internally, channeling feedback on procurement, compliance, and deployment needs to Product, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li>Stay current on GitLab and related technologies, and create reusable SLED demos, reference architectures, and assets for customers and partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Background in technical pre-sales, consulting, or IT roles serving state agencies, local governments, or public, private, and research universities, where you guided customers through evaluations and solution design.</li> <li>Working knowledge of how SLED organizations buy technology: RFP and RFI cycles, cooperative purchasing agreements, statewide contracts, fiscal-year budgeting, and the role of resellers and systems integrators.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using GitLab and familiarity with modern software development and operations practices, such as CI/CD, DevSecOps, and automation.</li> <li>Experience with cloud, hybrid, and self-managed deployments in regulated environments, including government cloud regions, and an understanding of data residency and sovereignty concerns.</li> <li>Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks common in SLED, such as GovRAMP and NIST SP 800-53.</li> <li>Ability to connect technical solutions to mission outcomes, such as resident service delivery, cyber resilience, cost avoidance, and workforce efficiency, and to advise senior stakeholders on tradeoffs and options.</li> <li>Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including presenting to both technical teams and non-technical leaders such as agency heads, procurement officers, and university administrators.</li> <li>Openness to learning, seeking feedback, and building new skills, including familiarity with GitLab's Solutions Architect handbook and related resources.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience working in or for state or local government IT, or a university IT or research computing organization.</li> <li>Experience with legacy or mainframe modernization programs.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI governance practices in the public sector, such as AI use-case inventories, acceptable-use policies, and risk assessments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The SLED Solutions Architect role is part of GitLab's Public Sector Solutions Architect team, a group of trusted technical advisors who help government and education customers understand, evaluate, and adopt the GitLab DevSecOps platform. The team is distributed and collaborates asynchronously across time zones using GitLab and our handbook-first practices to share knowledge, reusable examples, and best practices.</p> <p>On the SLED team, you'll help customers solve challenges unique to state, local, and education organizations: protecting resident and student data, modernizing mission-critical legacy systems, buying through public procurement processes, and stretching limited IT staff and budgets. You'll also bring SLED customer insights back to GitLab to shape product direction.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement.
