title: Senior Java Backend Developer – Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes (m/w/d) – Festanstellung
description: Wer wir sind Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden. Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen. Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest in einem agilen Release Train nach SAFe bei einem großen Mobilitätsunternehmen. Es geht um Fahrplan-, Vertriebs- und Abrechnungssysteme auf einer Cloud-Native-Plattform mit Kubernetes. Du arbeitest mit mindestens zwei weiteren Teams zusammen, die von deiner Arbeit abhängen. Backend-Services mit Java (17+) und Spring Boot entwerfen und weiterentwickeln REST-APIs mit Versionierung und OpenAPI-Dokumentation, Absicherung mit OAuth2, JWT und Spring Security Datenmodelle in PostgreSQL, SQL-Optimierung, Migrationen mit Flyway oder Liquibase, Spring Data JPA / Hibernate API-Contracts und Schnittstellen mit den anderen Teams abstimmen Testgetriebene Entwicklung mit JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers und Contract-Tests Container-Images bauen und Deployments in Kubernetes pflegen, inklusive CI/CD Rufbereitschaft und 2nd/3rd Level Support nach Absprache Die Arbeit läuft überwiegend remote. Vor Ort bist du für die PI-Plannings, etwa zwei Tage im Monat. Wo du landest Großkonzerne aus Mobilität und Logistik Öffentlicher Sektor / Behörden (z. B. Bundesagentur für Arbeit, ITZBund, Bundesdruckerei) Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung. Was du mitbringst Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten. Das erwarten wir: Java und Spring Boot in Backend-Services, mehr als fünf Jahre PostgreSQL oder vergleichbar: Datenmodelle, Queries, Indexierung, Migrationen, mehr als drei Jahre Zusammenarbeit mehrerer voneinander abhängiger Teams in Enterprise-Umgebungen, mehr als fünf Jahre Testgetriebene Entwicklung, mehr als drei Jahre Docker und Kubernetes, mehr als drei Jahre Von Vorteil (kein Muss): SAFe und PI-Plannings BPMN 2.0 und Camunda Monitoring mit Grafana, Prometheus, Loki oder Tempo Apache Kafka oder RabbitMQ GitLab CI KI-Werkzeuge in der Entwicklung (Copilot, ChatGPT, Amazon Q) AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Wenn du AI-Tools für einen Hype hältst und lieber alles selbst tippst: falsche Firma. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills. Was wir bieten Homeoffice, Büro oder Mix, du entscheidest MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware) Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung Bewerbung Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Nach einer kurzen Video-Frage-Runde (2×90 Sekunden) melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Complaints Policy Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>London OR Cardiff OR Remote (UK) | 💰 <span class="collapsed-field-text">£51,200- £64,700</span>  + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers">benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐Our Complaints team</strong></p> <p>Our mission is to make money work for everyone. And while having a great app is part of that, we pride ourselves on providing world-class support. By solving customers' problems, treating them fairly and being transparent, we believe we can make banking better 💪</p> <p>Our Complaints team works alongside Customer Operations to make sure customers receive the best possible service, even when things go wrong. We put empathy at the heart of how we handle complaints and use what we learn to make things better.</p> <p>As our Complaints Policy Manager, you'll lead a team of technical experts and shape how we handle complaints across Monzo. You'll bring together regulatory requirements, customer needs and operational priorities to make sure our policies are clear, effective and fair. You'll play an important role in strengthening our complaints framework, influencing decisions across the business and helping us deliver better customer outcomes at scale.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Leading, coaching and developing a team of Complaints Lead Experts, creating an environment where people can grow and deliver high-quality technical advice.</p> </li> <li> <p>Owning and improving our complaints policy framework, making sure processes, guidance, systems and customer communications are consistent, effective and meet regulatory expectations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Providing oversight and direction on complex complaint handling issues, supporting teams to make fair, well-informed decisions across different complaint types.</p> </li> <li> <p>Using insights from quality assurance, Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) outcomes and escalations to identify root causes, shape our strategy and drive meaningful improvements.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partnering with Product, Legal, Risk, Compliance and Operations leaders to develop and embed policies, frameworks and operational changes that improve customer experiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Leading our response to regulatory developments, audits and compliance reviews, making sure our controls, reporting and governance remain robust.</p> </li> <li> <p>Overseeing specialist activities, including regulatory disclosures, legal escalations and engagement with third parties, to make sure we meet our obligations and deliver fair customer outcomes.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>You have strong knowledge of UK complaint-handling regulations, including the FCA's DISP handbook and FOS requirements, and can apply them to real customer situations.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're experienced in leading, coaching and developing technical specialists, helping them build confidence and deliver great outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p>You can see the bigger picture, using complaint data, quality insights and emerging trends to shape strategy and improve how things work.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're comfortable managing regulatory governance, control frameworks, audits and changes to regulatory requirements.</p> </li> <li> <p>You can build strong relationships across different teams, influence senior stakeholders and turn complex regulatory information into clear, practical guidance.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're confident balancing long-term strategic priorities with day-to-day operational challenges, making thoughtful decisions and keeping things moving.</p> </li> <li> <p>You're passionate about fair customer outcomes and finding ways to make complaint handling simpler, more consistent and more empathetic.</p> </li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply- even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</em></p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>💰<span class="collapsed-field-text">£51,200 - £64,700</span>  + Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits</p> </li> <li> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> </li> <li> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> </li> <li> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> </li> <li> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of <a href="https://monzo.com/careers">benefits</a>.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <p>1. Application <br>2. Recruiter Call <br>3. Role specific Interview <br>4. Values Interview</p> <p>This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!</p> <p>🤖 We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage, so please apply as soon as you can - we don’t want you to miss out!</p> <p>LinkedIn Tags: #LI-JK1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Executive Business Director, West
description: Who We Are: Xenon Pharmaceuticals ( NASDAQ:XENE ) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team. What We Do: We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our Phase 3 azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal onset seizures (FOS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FOS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also have multiple Phase 3 azetukalner clinical trials underway in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we are proud of our strong heritage in human genetics, deep understanding of ion channel biology, and expertise in novel chemistries to enable potent, selective ion channel targeting. We continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel therapeutic candidates, including Phase 1 studies for XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations. About the Role: We are seeking a dynamic, patient-centric, strategic, collaborative, agile, and results-oriented Executive Business Director (EBD), Epilepsy to lead our West region. This leader will be responsible for leading and developing a team of Regional Sales Managers and ensuring successful execution of Xenon's commercial strategy across a multi-state geography. title: Senior Performance Strategist
description: As a Senior Performance Strategist at Superside , you'll own how the work performs in market: what runs, how it's tested and how it keeps getting better. You'll work alongside our creative strategists, creative teams and product team, using evidence to turn great ideas into results for global brands. What You'll Do Bring performance data and past results into every brief, so strategy starts from what people actually do. Lead performance-focused projects, finding the opportunity in the data and briefing creative teams. Turn campaign ideas into in-market plans across channels, formats and audiences. Design testing roadmaps and measurement frameworks, and set up tests and tracking. Analyse creative performance to show what's working, what isn't and why. Optimise creative in market, scaling what works and moving people through the funnel. Turn results into clear recommendations on what to scale, cut and try next. Advise senior client stakeholders as a trusted strategic partner, presenting results and recommendations with confidence. Identify opportunities to grow accounts, from ongoing optimisation programs to new performance offerings. Incorporate an AI-native mindset across the whole strategic process. Partner with our product team to invent and build new performance creative solutions, workflows and offerings that scale across clients and studios, going beyond applying existing tools. Share learnings and help shape how performance and creative strategy work together. What You'll Need to Succeed 7+ years in performance or growth strategy at an agency or brand, with a focus on performance creative. Experience independently leading complex performance strategy engagements and influencing senior client stakeholders and creative leaders. A track record of designing and running creative testing programs that improved results. Strong analytical skills across major ad platforms, with a working grasp of attribution and measurement. Full-funnel experience across paid social, acquisition and conversion. The ability to find creative opportunities in data and write briefs creative teams want to run with. A belief that brand and performance work best together. Genuine curiosity about emerging technology and experience experimenting with or building new workflows. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience working directly with senior clients. Curiosity, collaboration and a commitment to growing your strategic craft. Compensation Additional Information Why Join us? Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are. Remote-first. Customer-led. Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones. Global team, local impact. Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands. High performance, low ego. Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration. Impact meets opportunity. We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here. Grow fast. Lead well. You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones. Learn more at superside.com Diversity, Equity and Inclusion We’re an equal-opportunity company. title: City Manager, LA
description: Flex is building AI-native financial services for business owners . We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners. Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue) —the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt. - Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. - High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. - Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. - Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. Team & Locations We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. Flex Fuels Ambition. About the Role We're seeking an ambitious problem solver with a record of achievement on an exponential trajectory. As City Manager, you'll lead Flex's growth in New York. You know the business owners, the culture, and which rooms matter. Your job is to turn that into new Flex customers. You'll build a target list of 50 business owners you'd most like to bring to Flex. title: INTESCIA - Ingénieur systèmes et réseaux (H/F) - CDD 6 mois
description: Ingénieur systèmes et réseaux (H/F) CDD - 6 mois Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! Qui sommes-nous ? Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business. En tant qu’Ingénieur Systèmes & Réseaux, vous rejoignez une équipe d’experts et jouez un rôle clé dans la conception, l’évolution et la sécurisation de nos infrastructures IT. Vous participez activement à plusieurs projets structurants, notamment la modernisation de notre architecture d’identité Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, le déploiement de Microsoft Intune pour la gestion de nos équipements Windows, macOS et iOS, ainsi que la migration de VMware vers Proxmox. Vous contribuez également à l’évolution de nos infrastructures réseau et cloud, en veillant à garantir la performance, la disponibilité et la sécurité de nos environnements techniques. Dans le cadre de notre mission, nous recherchons une personne capable de nous venir en renfort sur les 6 prochains mois, avec pour objectif de réaliser les missions suivantes (liste non exhaustive) : Administrer, maintenir et faire évoluer les infrastructures systèmes et réseaux du groupe. Participer à la modernisation de notre architecture d'identité Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, notamment la synchronisation des identités et la mise en place des configurations hybrides. Déployer et administrer Microsoft Intune pour l'enrôlement et la gestion des équipements Windows, macOS et iOS (iPhone). Mettre en place et maintenir les profils de configuration, les stratégies de sécurité et de conformité des équipements, ainsi que les déploiements applicatifs. Concevoir, administrer et maintenir les infrastructures de virtualisation Proxmox VE. Participer activement à la migration de VMware vers Proxmox, en collaboration avec nos partenaires technologiques. Administrer les environnements Linux et Windows Server et assurer leur maintien en condition opérationnelle. Administrer et faire évoluer les infrastructures réseau : VLAN, switching, routage, segmentation et interconnexions entre sites. Administrer les pare-feu Fortinet, les VPN inter-sites et les règles de sécurité réseau. Mettre en œuvre et maintenir les solutions de sauvegarde, de restauration et de continuité de service. Participer à l'administration et au maintien en condition opérationnelle des ressources AWS, ainsi qu'à leur intégration dans l'infrastructure existante. Assurer la supervision des infrastructures, analyser les incidents et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires. Contribuer à la sécurisation des systèmes et des réseaux, à l'amélioration continue et à la documentation technique. La rémunération fixe sur ce poste est de 48K€ annuelle. Le profil que nous recherchons : Nous recherchons un profil avec minimum 5 années d’expérience, mais aussi : Expérience confirmée en administration systèmes et réseaux en environnement de production. Expérience sur Microsoft Entra ID, la synchronisation Active Directory / Entra, les environnements hybrides et Microsoft Intune (Windows, macOS et iOS). Expérience en virtualisation Proxmox VE et participation à des projets de migration depuis VMware. Maîtrise de l'administration réseau et des pare-feu Fortinet. Expérience en administration Windows Server et Linux, gestion des sauvegardes et supervision des infrastructures. Connaissance des outils de gestion de parc informatique et de ticketing, notamment GLPI. Pratique régulière d'AWS appréciée. Capacité à rédiger et maintenir une documentation technique claire et à jour. Ce que nous vous offrons : Poste basé à : Toulouse / Carquefou / Issy-les-Moulineaux. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: About the Role Vantage is looking for its next Full Stack Engineer to join our Product Development Team. Experience designing and executing both unit and integration tests, with tools such as pytest, jest, react testing framework, etc. Experience working with large data sets. Experience monitoring application performance, debugging, and reviewing logs. Familiarity working with Continuous Integrations and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD). Familiarity working with cloud platforms such as Azure, GCP, and/or AWS. Track record of successful collaboration with other engineering and product teams. title: Lead Product Designer, Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London (Hybrid) / UK Remote | 💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐Our Design team</strong></p> <p>We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers, and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up over half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, engineering and data to solve real customer problems at scale.</p> <p><strong>We design for the "magic moments"</strong></p> <p>We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product <em>is</em> our personality. We blend research, empathy, data and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.</p> <p>Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future — and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.</p> <p><strong>🌱 About Growth</strong></p> <p>Our Growth collective is focused on helping more people discover Monzo, understand what makes us different, and find the products that can make money work better for them.</p> <p>For this role, you’ll have a particular focus on our <strong>web experiences</strong>, helping us rethink how people discover, explore and choose Monzo before they ever open the app. You’ll combine strong visual and interaction design with a data-informed mindset, using experimentation and customer insight to understand what works and continuously improve the experience.</p> <p>You don’t need to have worked in a dedicated Growth team before. We’re interested in designers who are curious about customer behaviour, comfortable using data to inform their decisions, and excited by the opportunity to apply exceptional craft to high-impact customer journeys.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading the design of high-quality web experiences that help new and existing customers discover the value Monzo can bring to their financial lives.</li> <li>Using quantitative and qualitative data to identify opportunities, understand customer behaviour and make informed design decisions.</li> <li>Turning customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, designing experiments and using what you learn to shape what we do next.</li> <li>Bringing exceptional visual and interaction craft to our web experiences, creating work that feels unmistakably Monzo while driving meaningful customer and commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Tackling complex and ambiguous design challenges, balancing customer needs, business goals and technical constraints to create simple, effective experiences.</li> <li>Defining compelling product visions and direction, helping teams think beyond individual experiments towards a coherent long-term customer experience.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Research throughout the design process, bringing people together around customer problems and opportunities.</li> <li>Using AI to level-up parts of your design workflow. Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code.</li> <li>Taking a pragmatic approach to experimentation — moving quickly when we need to learn, while knowing when an experience needs a higher level of craft and polish.</li> <li>Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the wider Design team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of designing <strong>high-quality web experiences</strong>, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual and interaction design craft.</li> <li>You’re comfortable using <strong>data to inform your design decisions</strong>, partnering with Data Scientists or Analysts to understand customer behaviour and measure the impact of your work.</li> <li>You can connect great customer experiences with measurable outcomes and understand how design can contribute to wider product and commercial goals.</li> <li>You’re comfortable forming hypotheses, experimenting with different approaches and adapting your thinking as you learn.</li> <li>You can balance speed and experimentation with a high bar for craft, knowing when to prototype quickly and when to invest in creating an exceptional final experience.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who can bring together Product, Engineering, Data, Research and other partners around complex customer problems.</li> <li>You thrive in ambiguity and can create clarity and direction when the answer isn’t immediately obvious.</li> <li>You’re comfortable thinking beyond an individual screen or experiment, connecting work across journeys and helping shape a longer-term vision.</li> <li>You’re a role model who actively contributes to the growth of the Design team through mentoring, feedback and sharing your expertise.</li> <li>You’re excited about Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone and the opportunity to help more people discover the value of Monzo.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.<br>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.<br>✅ We can sponsor your visa.<br>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).<br>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.<br>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.<br>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.<br>➕ Plus lots more!</p> <p>🌈 <strong>The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>30-minute call with our Recruiter, Tom</li> <li>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Design team</li> <li>2 x 45-minute interviews covering Teamwork and Impact</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-TR1<br>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: General Counsel (remote)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel </strong>to<strong> </strong>lead Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical’s legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment where the questions are often genuinely unprecedented — the terms on which Ubuntu is distributed, copyleft at enterprise scale, and commercial models built with the world’s largest cloud and silicon providers. The role calls for breadth across commercial contracting, corporate governance, IP and compliance rather than depth in any one of them. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting its structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.</li> <li>Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.</li> <li>Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.</li> <li>Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Owning the commercial contracting data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO from preparation to admission.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, title: Fachredakteur Steuerrecht (m/w/d) - Content & SEO
description: Wer wir sind Seit 16 Jahren betreuen wir als digitale Steuerkanzlei Unternehmen in ganz Deutschland, vor allem E-Commerce, vemögensverwaltende GmbH und KMU. Wir sprechen Steuerrecht genauso fließend wie Software und machen Steuerberatung mit eigenen Lösungen einfacher. Wir sind inhabergeführt, unabhängig und ohne Investoren. Unser Ziel: Deutschlands beste digitale Steuerkanzlei zu werden. Damit Unternehmer das auch verstehen, suchen wir dich. Deine Vision bei uns Wir wollen die Steuerkanzlei sein, der Unternehmer im Netz am meisten vertrauen. Nicht durch Werbung, sondern durch Inhalte, die wirklich helfen. Du baust diese Wissensplattform mit auf. Deine Texte werden zur ersten Anlaufstelle, wenn jemand eine Holding gründen, eine Trading GmbH verstehen oder seinen Jahresabschluss einordnen will. Und danach? Eine Wissensplattform ist nie ganz fertig, aber wir haben schon viele Ideen, wie es weitergeht. Du wächst mit und gestaltest mit, welche Formate und Projekte als Nächstes kommen. Deine Aufgaben Neue Blogartikel nach SEO/GEO-Standards zu Steuerthemen schreiben (Keyword-Beispiele: holding gründen kosten, jahresabschluss bundesanzeiger, gmbh steuern) Bestehende Blogartikel und Landingpages inhaltlich und sprachlich verbessern Fachliche Texte für Landingpages: Leistungsbeschreibungen, FAQs, Rechenbeispiele Skripte schreiben für YouTube-Videos und Social-Media-Clips Fachliche Prüfung von Texten und Freigabe Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing-Manager (SEO, Themenplanung) Texte mit Persönlichkeit: Du schreibst selbst und nicht per KI-Knopfdruck. Uns sind Texte wichtig, die menschlich klingen und Erfahrung zeigen. So könnte deine Woche aussehen: Du schreibst zwei neue Blogartikel, überarbeitest ein YouTube-Skript eines Kollegen und optimierst Texte von drei bereits vorhandenen Landingpages. Das bringst du mit Du bist Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsjurist (Schwerpunkt Steuerrecht) oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Texten, Content oder Blogs Spaß am Schreiben und daran, Komplexes einfach zu erklären Sicheres Deutsch: Du schreibst klar, verständlich und grundsätzlich fehlerfrei. Selbstständiges Arbeiten: Du organisierst dich remote gut selbst und hältst Termine ein. Neugier auf Steuerthemen: Du verfolgst Gesetzesänderungen und hast Lust, sie verständlich aufzubereiten. Das bieten wir Rahmenbedingungen, die passen: Unbefristeter Vertrag, Voll- oder Teilzeit ohne Kernarbeitszeit, High-Tech-Homeoffice-Setup, individuelle Arbeitszeitgestaltung und 30 Tage Urlaub ohne Urlaubssperre. 100 % Homeoffice: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und bist trotzdem eng in die fachlichen und persönlichen Strukturen des Teams eingebunden, das sich gegenseitig stark unterstützt. Kein Fristendruck, keine Buchhaltung, keine Jahresabschlüsse, Steuererklärungen Sichtbarkeit: deine Texte und Videos erreichen tausende Unternehmer Direkter Draht zu unseren Steuerberatern und Spezialisten für Trading, E-Commerce und GmbH, du bleibst fachlich am Puls. Tolles Team: Du arbeitest mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die ihr Wissen gern teilen und sich gegenseitig unterstützen. Auch remote sind wir ein Team: Jedes Jahr gibt es ein Sommerfest, ein Winterfest und ein eigenes Event in Deinem Team. Dein Benefit is nicht dabei? Frag uns gerne an! Noch mehr Eindrücke von uns und unserer Unternehmenskultur erhältst Du auf unserer Karriereseite und auf www.kununu.com/de/steueragenten-de. Bereit für diese etwas andere Stelle? title: Manager, Developer Advocacy, APJ
description: Role Summary We’re hiring a manager to lead our Developer Advocates in APJ. The team covers two things: getting more developers in the region to discover and try Temporal, and helping our biggest customers get more out of it once they’re on board. You’ll own both. You’ll manage a group of developer advocates, but you won’t be stuck in meetings all day. We expect you to still give talks, run workshops, write code, and get in front of customers yourself. You’ll work closely with our Marketing department on events and community, and with Sales, Solutions Architects, and Developer Success on customer accounts. Good relationships with all of them are your key to success. What you’ll do Hire, coach, and support a team of Developer Advocates spread across the region. Set priorities, then trust them to adapt to their own markets and audiences. Decide how the team splits its time between community and customer work. Sort incoming customer requests by deal size, stage, and strategic value, and make the tough calls when there’s more demand than people, without letting community work get pushed aside. Work with Marketing to plan where we show up in APJ: which conferences to speak at and which meetups to start or support. Create and translate content that developers in the region will use, like talks, tutorials, blog posts, videos, sample apps, and livestreams. Find the people in local communities who care about the problems Temporal solves and help them lead, contribute to open source, and spread the word. Track whether it’s working: are more developers signing up, trying Temporal, and sticking around? Own DevDays, our onsite customer engagement program, in APJ from start to finish. Work with the Global DevDays lead to tailor each one to the customer’s use cases. Spot the engineers inside each account who could become champions, and make sure someone follows up with them. Take what you hear from developers and customers back to Docs, Education, and Product, especially around localization and what different markets need. What you bring Experience in developer advocacy, solutions engineering, developer education, or community work, ideally at a developer-focused or enterprise software company. You’ve worked on both sides: reaching developers in the broader community and working with engineering teams inside large customers. Experience managing people, or you’re ready to take that step. Bonus if you’ve led a team spread across multiple time zones. Real technical depth. You can build things, demo them, give a talk, and answer hard questions from experienced engineers. You like running programs that work the same way every time. You’re organized about requests, priorities, and following through on commitments. You’re comfortable working with Marketing, Sales, SAs, Dev Success, and Product, and you can explain how technical work leads to business results. You’ve worked across different cultures and markets, and you know APJ isn’t one audience. You care about helping developers, and you’d rather build trust than push a product. Experience with durable execution, workflow orchestration, or distributed systems (Temporal especially) is a big plus. Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Service Desk Engineer
description: Service Desk Engineer The Service Desk Engineer serves as the primary technical point of contact for RFA 's global client base, delivering exceptional white-glove support across endpoint, cloud, security, and collaboration technologies. This role is responsible for providing first and second-level technical support, resolving incidents, fulfilling service requests, and maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction while supporting a diverse portfolio of managed IT services. The Service Desk Engineer utilizes modern troubleshooting methodologies, automation tools, AI-assisted support platforms, and cybersecurity best practices to efficiently resolve issues and improve the client experience. Successful candidates demonstrate strong technical aptitude, exceptional communication skills, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment. Responsibilities Utilize AI-enabled support tools and knowledge platforms to improve incident resolution times and service quality. Support Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Teams, SharePoint Online, and related cloud services. Assist with endpoint management, mobile device management (MDM), and device compliance monitoring. Respond to security-related incidents including phishing reports, compromised accounts, malware alerts, and suspicious user activity. Maintain accurate documentation, knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, and technical runbooks. Monitor service queues and proactively identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for automation. Participate in onboarding and offboarding processes including provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, and asset management. Support hybrid and remote workforce technologies including VPN, virtual desktops, collaboration platforms, and cloud applications. Meet established service metrics including SLA attainment, ticket quality, first-contact resolution, and customer satisfaction goals. Participate in after-hours support, escalation rotations, and major incident response activities as required. All other responsibilities delegated by the Management team. May be asked to provide on-site technical support to system users by troubleshooting issues and working directly with vendors to resolve major hardware and software problems. Qualifications Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent professional experience. 2+ years of experience in a Service Desk, Help Desk, Technical Support, or Managed Services environment. Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), Exchange Online, Intune, Teams, SharePoint Online, and Active Directory. Experience supporting Windows 11, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms. Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including MFA, Conditional Access, endpoint protection, phishing prevention, and identity management. Familiarity with Azure, AWS, virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), and SaaS application administration. Experience with ITSM platforms such as ConnectWise, ServiceNow, HaloPSA, Autotask, or similar systems. Knowledge of ITIL service management principles. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users. Preferred Certifications: CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft Fundamentals, AZ-900, or equivalent. Experience supporting financial services, hedge funds, legal firms, or highly regulated industries preferred Preferred Qualifications & Development Potential Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent professional experience. 1–3 years of experience in a Service Desk, Help Desk, Technical Support, or Managed Services environment. Foundational IT certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft Fundamentals , or equivalent coursework demonstrating core technical knowledge. Demonstrated hands-on technical experience through internships, help desk roles, school IT programs, volunteer IT work, home labs, or other practical troubleshooting environments. Exposure to scripting, automation, or technical problem-solving through coursework, personal projects, or professional experience. Basic familiarity with PowerShell, Python, batch scripting, or other automation tools preferred. Strong understanding of Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, endpoint management, and common business productivity applications. Excellent customer service, communication, documentation, and troubleshooting skills. Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt in a fast-paced MSP environment. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Azure, AWS, or similar cloud platforms. Experience with ITSM/ticketing systems such as ConnectWise, HaloPSA, Autotask, or ServiceNow. Knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals including MFA, endpoint security, phishing awareness, and identity management. ITIL Foundation, Microsoft, CompTIA, or cloud certifications. Experience supporting financial services, legal, healthcare, or other regulated industries. AI Competencies Demonstrates familiarity with AI-powered productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or approved company AI platforms. Uses AI tools to assist with troubleshooting, documentation, knowledge searches, and drafting communications while validating accuracy. Understands basic AI concepts, limitations, risks, and data privacy requirements. Follows company policies regarding the secure and responsible use of AI technologies. Leverages AI-generated recommendations to improve ticket resolution efficiency and customer service quality. Demonstrates curiosity and willingness to learn emerging AI technologies relevant to IT support. Compensation Additional Information

title: Senior Developer Success Engineer, APJ
description: Summary The Senior Developer Success Engineer will be the frontline technical expert for our developer community. You’ll gain deep expertise in large scale distributed systems, orchestration, reliability, and observability while learning from complex, real-world customer use cases. Our stack includes Go, Python, Typescript and Java, providing continuous opportunities to hone your programming skills in resilience engineering and performance tuning. As a Senior Developer Success Engineer , you’ll work directly with developers to troubleshoot complex issues, help them optimize performance and reliability, contribute to improving user experience, and help them be successful with using Temporal. Once ramped up, we expect you to independently drive technical solutions, whether debugging complex production issues or designing infrastructure best practices. Don't worry—we have seasoned engineers and mentors to support you along the way! Be a great communicator : As a Senior Developer Success Engineer you will engage directly with developers, engineering teams, and product teams to understand infrastructure challenges and provide solutions that enhance scalability, performance, and reliability. You’ll serve as a bridge between developers and the Temporal platform, ensuring that reliability, performance, and developer experience remain top priorities as Temporal scales. What You'll Bring 6+ years of experience as a developer, preferably fluent in one or more of the following languages: Python, Java, Golang, TypeScript. Experience with deployment and managing medium to large-scale architectures (e.g., Kubernetes or Docker). Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana and troubleshooting performance and availability issues. Minimum of one year experience in an internal or external customer-facing role. Passion for helping others regardless of who they are or how they act. Experience working with or as part of remote teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Seek to understand first, lead with data, and rely on facts. Nice to Have Previous experience in customer-facing positions such as a professional services consultant, solutions architect, customer engineer, etc. Experience with security certificate management and implementation. Ability to understand use cases and translate them into Temporal design decisions and architecture best practices. Technologies: EKS, GKE, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTracing, Terraform/Ansible/CDK. Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Senior Network Engineer
description: Available shifts: Sat–Wed, 3 PM – 12 AM PHT Sat–Wed, 11 PM – 8 AM PHT Senior Network Engineer The Senior Network Engineer will interact directly with our high-profile, elite client base ensuring they receive our first-rate service. This position will be responsible for all network and security designs, implementations, and day-to-day support for various client network infrastructures. The Senior Network Engineer will also be an integral part in handling various networking functions including Datacenter, security and firewalling while leveraging their Cisco and Palo Alto expertise. This job is visible to all levels of Senior Management and awards the exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing, global IT services provider. The Network Engineer must display a high-level of professionalism and sound judgment at all times by promoting superior service to RFA clients. Our ideal candidate will have experience providing IT support to the financial services industry and have worked for a Managed Services Provider (MSP). RESPONSIBILITIES Prepare complex network designs for new and existing client site establishments, site relocations, network upgrades, network expansions, and disaster recovery setups with a focus on Cisco for core network requirements Assist in the design, build and configuration of the Global Network environments, show a strong knowledge of Datacentre technologies and be able to document these and train peers in their application Implement and maintain logical design models (L2/L3, spanning tree, VTP, VLANs, physical cabling), remote VPN software, network control protocols (QOS, PoE, NTP, DHCP), network management protocols (CDP, FTP, TFTP, SNMP), and security protocols (SSH, HTTPS, AAA) Provide Tier 3 support for all network and data communication issues including private and internet circuits, routing protocols, VPN connectivity, WAN optimization, hardware, and 3rd party vendor connectivity Research networking issues and products as required and leverage critical thinking skills to evaluate all possible solutions while using appropriate judgment in applying effective resolutions Properly address and prioritize tasks based on urgent and highly-sensitive RFA client needs and manage appropriate/realistic expectations to ensure overall client satisfaction Responsible for configuring IPSec VPN tunnels, IP communication, and routing (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP) Leverage a strong knowledge of equipment, production processes, quality control, and other techniques for maximizing efficiency Position is a split of BAU and Project work, time sheets are required to be completed for Client billing purposes. Candidate will be on call for a week every staff rotation (approx. every 10 weeks) and will handle escalations from other business units. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent level of hands-on experience. 7-10 years of related IT experience in a Cisco environment. Must have 5+ years of network engineering experience. Should have CCNP or equivalent. Has been involved in Network Design Architect work. Advanced Routing and Switching Experience. Must be able to travel to our Client offices and Data Centers if needed. Palo Alto experience required, Fortigate, ASA an advantage. Financial services industry and MSP experience is preferred. Strong understanding of routing, WAN/LAN, and transport technologies (Ethernet, SDWAN, VPN, DMVPN, MPLS). Excellent desktop and server troubleshooting skills. Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and Visio. Hands-on experience with Solarwinds Orion and Kiwi, Syslog is a plus. Compensation Additional Information

title: Senior Sales Executive (Enterprise Partnerships)
description: Senior Sales Executive (Enterprise Partnerships) Location: Remote (US) We are Virtual care only works if the infrastructure behind it does. Wheel builds that infrastructure: the systems that let telehealth run at scale for the patients, clinicians, and companies that depend on it. We're not bolting AI onto old workflows; we're rebuilding how care gets delivered, with AI in the product and in how we build it. We do this in a live, regulated healthcare environment where getting it right matters. This is the next architecture of virtual care, and we're building it now. About the Role We are hiring a Senior Enterprise Partnerships Executive to sell Pathway to enterprises that want to bring longevity and preventive care to the customers they already serve. You will carry a quota, own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed agreement and handoff to implementation, and build and manage the overall Pathway pipeline. This is a partnership-style enterprise sale. Your buyers are companies, not individual patients: digital health companies, health plans, employers and benefits platforms, retailers, diagnostics and wearable companies, life sciences organizations, and health systems. Each wants to launch longevity care under its own brand without building the clinical, pharmacy, payment, data, and quality infrastructure itself. You will need to understand the longevity market well enough to advise buyers, and you will need digital health selling experience to move multi-stakeholder deals forward. What You'll Do Carry quota and own the full sales cycle Own an annual new-partner and expansion revenue quota for Pathway. Run each deal end to end: prospecting, qualification, discovery, solution design, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close. Process deals accurately and on time, including order forms, pricing and deal desk approvals, contract routing, and booking, in coordination with Finance and Legal. Hand signed partners to Implementation and Account Management with a clear record of scope, commitments, and success criteria, and stay involved through launch. Build and manage the pipeline Build a pipeline large enough to cover quota, using outbound prospecting, partner and ecosystem introductions, events, and inbound leads. Forecast accurately, keep CRM records current, and report pipeline health, stage conversion, and risk to leadership on a regular cadence. Work with Marketing and Revenue Operations on target account lists, messaging, and campaigns for the Pathway segments you cover. Sell the Pathway partnership Position Pathway as a way for a partner to add longevity care to an existing customer relationship, under its own brand, with Wheel providing clinical delivery and operations. Identify each partner's use case, such as extending a membership, adding a benefit, connecting diagnostics or wearable data to care, or opening a new revenue line, and shape the program configuration to fit it. Sell to several stakeholders at once, including business and product leaders, clinical and medical leadership, compliance and legal, operations, finance, and executives. Guide buyers through diligence on clinical governance, pharmacy and treatment access, data and integration requirements, and brand and customer experience. Work with Product, Clinical, Operations, and Legal to scope integrations and launch plans, and escalate non-standard requests early. Grow accounts and shape the offering Expand live partners into additional care programs, populations, and channels. Bring back competitive, pricing, and market feedback to help refine packaging, positioning, and sales materials. Represent Pathway at industry events, partner meetings, and customer briefings. Mentor newer sellers as the Pathway team grows. What You'll Bring Required 6+ years of B2B sales experience, including 4+ years selling digital health, telehealth, or consumer health solutions to enterprise buyers. Direct experience selling in or adjacent to the longevity, preventive health, wellness, or metabolic and hormone health market, with working knowledge of how the category operates and what buyers expect from it. A record of meeting or exceeding a six- or seven-figure annual quota as a senior individual contributor. Experience owning the complete sales process: building pipeline, running multi-stakeholder cycles, negotiating complex agreements, processing the deal through internal approvals, and handing off to delivery teams. Experience with partnership, white-label, or platform sales in which the customer's brand and customer base are central to the deal. Strong executive presence and the ability to explain clinical, operational, and commercial topics to different audiences. Sound judgment on regulatory, clinical governance, and privacy considerations, and a willingness to work within the guardrails Legal and Compliance set. This includes not making clinical or efficacy claims outside approved materials. Proficiency with a CRM (for example, Salesforce) and forecasting discipline. Preferred Existing relationships with digital health companies, health plans, employers, retailers, diagnostics or wearable companies, or life sciences organizations. Experience selling a newly launched product line or building a new market. Familiarity with telehealth operating models, including clinician networks, pharmacy fulfillment, and reimbursement or cash-pay models. Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare data privacy concepts. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. title: Senior Deal Desk Manager
description: JOB OVERVIEW The Senior Deal Desk Manager is a senior individual contributor role responsible for how Legion prices, structures, approves, and contracts global deals across every region Legion sells into. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, this person will take a Deal Desk that already has a foundation and scale it into a fast, compliant, AI-native function — through better systems and automation, not more headcount. The ideal candidate has built Deal Desk operations from scratch at an early-stage or growth-stage SaaS company and knows what to standardize, what to automate, and what to leave flexible. They work AI-first: when a process is slow, their first move is to build an agent, a tool, or an automation. This person will serve as the connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Legal, and Client Management, helping to streamline quote-to-close workflows, enforce pricing governance, and accelerate revenue realization. Own the approval matrix, discount guardrails, non-standard terms policy, and SLAs, with accountability for approval cycle time and quote accuracy. Support global deals end to end, including multi-currency pricing, multiple contracting entities, regional terms and tax considerations, and approval cycles that span time zones. Partner with Legal and Finance on contract standards, regional contracting requirements (data protection terms, local entity paper, currency/FX policy), revenue recognition alignment, and the order-to-cash handoff. Design Deal Desk workflows with AI at the core — for example, automated deal pre-screening against pricing and packaging policy, AI-generated deal summaries for approvers, and AI-assisted redline review against Legal’s playbook. Build and iterate working tools — pricing calculators, quoting tools, and approval automations — using AI-assisted development. Set guardrails for AI in deal workflows, including human-in-the-loop approvals, appropriate data handling, and a clear audit trail. Own and evolve Legion’s quoting and contracting stack (CPQ, CLM, DocuSign) with Salesforce as the system of record, including tools built in-house, and ensure workflows handle currencies, entities, and regional templates without manual workarounds. Develop reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Finance, and executive leadership visibility into discount trends, packaging adherence, approval turnaround times, and the impact of automation. Present deal analysis and insights directly in executive pricing reviews and forecast discussions. Partner closely with RevOps, Product Marketing, and Finance to operationalize pricing and packaging changes. Build the deal calculators, edge-case rules, and sales playbooks that bring new pricing to life in the field. REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations within B2B SaaS companies, including 3+ years owning Deal Desk operations end to end. Demonstrated experience building Deal Desk processes from the ground up at an early-stage or growth-stage company, with the ability to walk through what was built, in what order, and what you would do differently. Hands-on AI practitioner who has used AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Agentforce) to automate real Deal Desk or RevOps work, with an example to share. Hands-on experience structuring and contracting international SaaS deals across multiple regions, currencies, and legal entities. Deep expertise in SaaS pricing — subscription, usage-based, consumption-based, and hybrid models — along with discount governance and contracting best practices. Experience implementing CPQ and CLM systems; strong modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets. Proven ability to influence without authority across Sales, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership, including saying no to senior sellers while keeping the relationship intact. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES Experience launching AI, agentic, or data product SKUs, or partner and marketplace deal structures. Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM Experience in WFM, HCM, or enterprise SaaS selling to retail, hospitality, or healthcare. Operates with a builder’s mindset — proactive, resourceful, and eager to create clarity from ambiguity with a high degree of independence. Strong personal ownership, high integrity, and a focus on outcomes over activity. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Thrives in a collaborative, mission-driven environment and embraces change with enthusiasm. Flexibility to cover urgent deal approvals across time zones, especially at quarter-end. We do this in a live, regulated healthcare environment where getting it right matters. This is the next architecture of virtual care, and we're building it now. You are A staff-level engineer who has built software in a regulated, high-stakes domain (ideally health tech; fintech and insurtech count too) and knows what that demands: sensitive data, regulatory constraints, and the cost of getting it wrong. You've designed and shipped AI and agentic systems in production, you know where they break, and you have opinions, held loosely and argued well, about building them safely. You're a builder first, and you've done real work in small, scrappy teams. You still write the hard parts of the code yourself, and you've done it recently. You don't need a platform org, TPMs, or layers of review to move. You operate as a domain owner, not a task owner. You take a problem that isn't well-formed, define it, tie it to what the business has committed to, and lead a group of engineers to a shipped, measured outcome. Your impact shows up in other people's work: the patterns they reuse and the ambiguity you removed before it cost the team a quarter. You get things done. You have sharp judgment about what actually moves the outcome, you'd rather ship something useful this week than something perfect next quarter, and you know when good enough is good enough (and when, in healthcare, it isn't). And you're good to work with. You're curious, generous with your time, quick to give credit, and you can disagree hard without making it personal. Smart matters here; kind matters just as much. Bonus points if people genuinely enjoy being on a team with you. The Work Technical Leadership & Direction Own the technical direction for a significant AI-native area of the platform, such as patient and clinician experiences, care delivery, or the AI platform layer other teams build on. Act as tech lead for a team or cross-team initiative: break down ambiguous problems, sequence delivery, clear blockers, and keep the team pointed at the outcome rather than the ticket. Connect day-to-day engineering to quarterly commitments and company goals, and make those links visible to the team. Write and review design docs. Make and document the load-bearing calls, including "not yet" and "buy, don't build." AI & Agent Engineering Design and build production AI features and agents: retrieval, orchestration, tool calling, guardrails, evaluation, and observability. Define what "production-ready" means for AI here (testability, rollback safety, cost ceilings, failure modes, human-in-the-loop boundaries) and hold the bar in review. Take on the hardest parts of the build yourself. This is a hands-on role; you are expected to be in the code every day. Healthcare-Grade Engineering Treat privacy, security, and responsible AI use on sensitive health data as hard engineering requirements, and turn compliance constraints into concrete architecture. Partner with clinical, compliance, and legal stakeholders early, so safety and review are designed in rather than bolted on. Build for the realities of healthcare: integrations with clinical systems, auditability, and high-reliability workflows. Cloud-Native Delivery Own full-stack delivery in TypeScript/Node.js and Python: services, APIs, data jobs, and the interfaces on top. Own deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting in production, including on-call, and improve the operational posture of what you inherit. Measure & Improve Own the evaluation strategy for your area: metrics, test harnesses, and plans for accuracy, latency, safety, and cost. Instrument systems so their behavior is legible after the fact, not just at demo time. Kill approaches that aren't working, early and visibly. Stakeholders & The Org Work directly with product, operations, clinical, and business leaders to decide which use cases are worth building. Explain trade-offs and risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, up to the executive team. Mentor engineers through code review, design review, and pairing, and build reusable patterns that raise the bar beyond your own team. What success looks like First 30 days: you've shipped something to production, met the people you'll build with, and know where the sharp edges are. First 90 days: you own an area, set its technical direction, and have shipped AI features with an evaluation story behind them. First 6 months: patterns you established are used by teams you don't sit on, the business can point to outcomes you drove, and engineers say their work got better (and more fun) because you're here. What we're looking for 8+ years building and operating production software, with full-stack depth in TypeScript/Node.js and at least one other language (Python strongly preferred). 3+ years building software in health tech, fintech, or insurtech, including work with sensitive data under HIPAA, PCI, SOC 2, or similar requirements. Hands-on experience designing and shipping AI or agentic systems in production (retrieval, orchestration, tool calling, evaluation), with a clear view of where LLMs work and where they don't. A record of shipping outcomes, not just output: you can point to what you delivered, why it mattered, and the judgment calls you made to get it out the door. Recent hands-on output: in the last two years you've personally built and debugged significant production systems, not only directed others. Meaningful time at a startup or growth-stage company where you owned what platform, release, or infrastructure teams would handle elsewhere. A track record of technical leadership as an IC: owning a domain, leading multi-engineer efforts to completion, and driving decisions across teams without positional authority. A collaborative, low-ego style: you raise the people around you and make hard conversations easier, not harder. Fluent use of AI development tools as a force multiplier, with judgment about when to trust, verify, or override them. Strong cloud-native fundamentals: CI/CD, observability, and running what you build. Fluency with relational data and SQL. Clear written and verbal communication, including design docs that change minds. This is a remote, cross-functional role. Strongly desired Health tech experience specifically: telehealth, EHR/EMR, digital health, payer/provider, or pharmacy. Experience with clinical workflows or integrations with clinical systems (EHRs, e-prescribing, labs, HL7/FHIR). Model evaluation and guardrail infrastructure: measuring output quality, catching regressions, and keeping AI inside safe bounds. Patient-, clinician-, or customer-facing AI products shipped to real users. Experience building platform capabilities consumed by other engineering teams. Experience as a formal tech lead or mentoring engineers. What's hard about this role We'd rather you hear it now: Ambiguity is the job. Problems often arrive half-formed, and priorities can shift as the business and market change. You'll build, not just direct. There's no large platform org; you'll write code, run what you ship, and take on-call. Healthcare raises the bar. Clinical safety, privacy, and compliance review are part of shipping, and they take real time. If that sounds energizing rather than draining, we'd love to talk. How we work Remote-first (US), fast-moving, with tight loops between engineering, product, clinical, and the business. We're an AI-forward engineering org: we expect AI in the toolchain and in the product, and we measure outcomes over activity. We handle sensitive healthcare data under strict controls; privacy, security, and responsible AI are engineering requirements, not afterthoughts. We take the work seriously, not ourselves. We're direct and kind, we help each other out, and we have fun doing it. Salary and Perks Pay Range: $185,725-$264,500 USD Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: Medical, Dental and Vision Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability 401K match Flexible PTO Parental Leave Stock options Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
