At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

title: Case Manager
description: Join the dynamic journey at Vynca , where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs. We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day. At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home. About the job We are seeking a dedicated Lead Care Manager (LCM) to join our team. Reporting to the Director of Enhanced Care Management, ECM Clinical Manager, and/or ECM Program Manager, the LCM serves as the primary coordinator for clients, partnering with healthcare providers, specialists, pharmacists, social service agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless, person-centered care. The LCM manages client cases, coordinates health care benefits, provides education and facilitates member access to care in a timely and cost-effective manner. The LCM collaborates and communicates with client’s caregivers/family support persons, other providers and others in the Care Team in order to promote wellness, recovery, independence, resilience, and member empowerment, while ensuring access to appropriate services and maximizing member benefit. Internal Title: Lead Care Manager At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states: California*, Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Nevada, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington. *Applicants based in California must be bilingual with the ability to fluently speak in two or more languages as needed. Bilingual in Spanish is highly preferred. Vynca hires for this role on an ongoing basis throughout the year. This posting stays open because we regularly have openings for the Lead Care Manager role, but we don’t have a fixed start date or hiring timeline. We review applications as positions become available, and not every applicant will be contacted right away. Submitting an application doesn’t guarantee an interview or offer. If your background strongly matches a current or upcoming opening, a member of our team will reach out. Applications may be kept on file for 6 months for future openings. What you’ll do Remote care management duties as described below: Assess member needs in the areas of physical health, mental health, SUD, oral health, palliative care, memory care, trauma-informed care, social supports, housing, and referral and linkage to community-based services and supports Oversees the development of the client care plans and goal settings Offer services where the member resides, seeks care, or finds most easily accessible, including office-based, telehealth, or field-based services Connect clients to other social services and supports that are needed Advocate on behalf of the client with health care professionals (e.g. PCP, etc.) Utilize evidence-based practices, such as Motivational Interviewing, Harm Reduction, and Trauma-Informed Care principles Conduct outreach and engagement activities in order to facilitate linkage to the ECM program and log activity in the Client Relationship Management (CRM) system Evaluate client’s progress and update SMART goals Provide mental health promotion Arrange transportation (e.g., ACCESS) Complete all documentation, including outcome measures within the timeframes established by the individual care plans Maintain up-to-date patient health records in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system and other business systems Complete monthly reporting to ensure program compliance Attend training as assigned Your experience and qualifications 2+ years experience as a care manager, care navigator, or community health worker supporting vulnerable populations Willing and able to work Monday-Friday 8:30am-5:00pm Pacific Time with flexibility for potential evenings and weekends. Working knowledge of government and community resources related to social determinants of health Clean driving record, valid driver's license, and reliable transportation Excellent oral and written communication skills Positive interpersonal skills required Must have general computer skills and a working knowledge of Google Workspace, MS Office and the internet Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states: Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Nevada, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington. Keywords: Care Manager, Case Manager, Social Work, Community Health Worker, Behavioral Health, Housing Navigator, Care Navigator, Care Coordinator, Healthcare Additional Information The hiring process for this role may consist of applying, followed by a phone screen, online assessment(s), interview(s), an offer, and background/reference checks. Background Screening: A background check, which may include a drug test or other health screenings depending on the role, will be required prior to employment. Job Description Scope: This job description is not exhaustive and may include additional activities, duties, and responsibilities not listed herein. Vaccination Requirement: Employees in patient, client, or customer-facing roles must be vaccinated against influenza. Requests for religious or medical accommodations will be considered but may not always be approved. Employment Eligibility: Compliance with federal law requires identity and work eligibility verification using E-Verify upon hire. Equal Opportunity Employer: At Vynca Inc., we embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We value all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or membership in any other protected group under federal, state, or local law. Environmental Conditions and Physical Requirements: Works with Vynca patients/clients remotely and/or in-person. Successfully performs the essential duties and responsibilities of the position through the use of physical activities as described below: Regularly requires sitting, standing, walking, talking, use of hands, listening, and observing. Regularly requires working at a computer for an entire shift (with appropriate breaks). Regularly requires use of laptop and video-conferencing technology. Occasionally requires reaching, stooping, bending, kneeling, and lifting items weighing 25 pounds or less. Occasional travel may be required to perform job duties, attend training, or company events.

title: AI Researcher
description: Hume AI is seeking talented AI researchers interested in working with our team to build state-of-the-art speech-language models (SLMs). Our new SLM training method—reinforcement learning from human expression (RLHE)—learns human preferences from behavior in millions of audio and video recordings, making SLMs superhumanly helpful, interesting, funny, eloquent, honest, and altruistic. Join us in the heart of New York City and contribute to our endeavor to ensure that AI is guided by human values, the most pivotal challenge (and opportunity) of the 21st century. About Us Hume AI is a Series B startup dedicated to building artificial intelligence that is directly optimized for human well-being. As the first company to release speech language models, we’re focused on expanding our research to encompass audio understanding models and evaluation platforms for enterprises. Our goal is to enable a future in which technology draws on an understanding of human emotional expression to better serve human goals. As part of our mission, we also conduct groundbreaking scientific research, publish in leading scientific journals like Nature , and support a non-profit, The Hume Initiative, that has released the first concrete ethical guidelines for empathic AI ( www.thehumeinitiative.org ). You can learn more about us on our website ( https://hume.ai/ ) and read about us in WIRED , Forbes , and Venturebeat . About the Role We are looking for talented researchers with relevant publications, 2+ years of experience in a research role in industry, and/or a proven track record of contributions to open source language, audio, or video models. (A PhD is neither necessary nor sufficient.) We're looking for someone excited to work with our team to build state-of-the-art audio models and evaluation tools. In this role, you will build out software systems that support distributed model training, inference, and benchmarking as well as massive-scale data collection, storage, preprocessing, and analysis. You will be working to solve some of today’s most exciting AI research problems at industry scale. Requirements Expertise in the Python ecosystem and popular ML libraries and tools (e.g. PyTorch) Experience writing robust and maintainable production-ready code Comfort iterating quickly on new and uncertain research directions 2+ years of experience contributing to the training and/or fine-tuning of models with large-scale datasets of text, audio, image, and/or video data (predictive or generative) Application Note Please apply only to the position that best aligns with your qualifications. If you submit multiple applications or have applied within the past 6 months, only your initial submission will be considered. Annual Salary $180,000—$350,000 USD

title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Meta Ads & Performance Marketing
description: Über die Horn Druck & Verlag KG Die Horn Druck & Verlag KG ist ein traditionsreiches, seit 1986 bestehendes Unternehmen mit Fokussierung auf die Fitness- und Gesundheitsbranche. Du weißt, wie erfolgreiche Facebook- und Instagram-Kampagnen funktionieren, kannst Budgets strategisch einsetzen und holst durch kontinuierliche Optimierung das Maximum aus Werbeanzeigen heraus. In dieser Position übernimmst du die eigenständige Planung, Umsetzung und Optimierung von Social-Media-Kampagnen für unsere Kunden aus der Fitness- und Gesundheitsbranche. Meta-Kampagnenmanagement: Eigenständige Konzeption, Einrichtung und Steuerung anspruchsvoller Facebook- und Instagram-Werbekampagnen im Meta Ads Manager. Performance-Optimierung: Kontinuierliche Analyse und Optimierung von Kampagnen hinsichtlich Reichweite, Leads, Conversions, CTR, CPC, CPL und ROAS. Strategische Kampagnenplanung: Entwicklung zielgerichteter Werbestrategien, Zielgruppen, Retargeting-Konzepte und individueller Funnel. Tracking & Analyse: Sicherer Umgang mit Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Events und Tracking-Strukturen sowie aussagekräftige Auswertung der Kampagnenergebnisse. Anzeigenentwicklung: Entwicklung überzeugender Anzeigenkonzepte, Werbetexte und Creatives in Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team. A/B-Testing: Systematisches Testen unterschiedlicher Zielgruppen, Anzeigenformate, Werbebotschaften und Kampagnenstrategien. Kundenberatung: Fachliche Beratung unserer Kunden, Präsentation von Kampagnenergebnissen und Entwicklung konkreter Optimierungsmaßnahmen. Reporting: Erstellung aussagekräftiger Performance-Auswertungen und verständlicher Kundenberichte. Was du mitbringst Wir suchen jemanden, der sein Handwerk versteht und Meta Ads nicht nur bedienen, sondern wirklich beherrschen kann. Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im professionellen Meta-Kampagnenmanagement. Sehr tiefgehende Kenntnisse des Meta Ads Managers und seiner vielfältigen Funktionen. Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit der Planung, Steuerung und Optimierung größerer und komplexerer Kampagnen. Fundiertes Wissen in Zielgruppenstrategie, Retargeting, Lookalike Audiences und Conversion-Optimierung. Sicherer Umgang mit Meta Pixel, Conversion API, Events Manager und Tracking. Sehr gutes Verständnis relevanter Performance-Kennzahlen und deren Interpretation. Erfahrung mit Leadgenerierung, Landingpages und Conversion-Funnels. Kreatives Gespür für erfolgreiche Anzeigenmotive, Werbebotschaften und unterschiedliche Zielgruppen. Selbstständige, strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise. Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und an der Entwicklung erfolgreicher Marketingstrategien. Besonders wichtig: Du solltest bereits eigenständig zahlreiche Meta-Kampagnen betreut haben, Ergebnisse kritisch hinterfragen und genau wissen, an welchen Stellschrauben du drehen musst, um die Performance zu verbessern. title: Product Designer UX/UI (m/w/d), Teil- oder Vollzeit, Remote
description: Über AZAV Pilot Unsere Vision: Jede(r) sollte lehren und lernen können. Mit AZAV Pilot können sich Bildungsanbieter in der Erwachsenenbildung auf das konzentrieren, was wirklich zählt: fantastische Kurse & Coachings für ihre Kundinnen und Kunden anzubieten, anstatt im Bürokratiesumpf zu versinken. Wir entwickeln das Betriebssystem für alles rund um die Verwaltung der Teilnehmenden, die Dokumentation von Anwesenheit und Klassenbuch sowie das Qualitätsmanagement. Wir sind profitabel, 100 % bootstrapped und suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine(n) Product Designer UX/UI (m/w/d). Wenn du es liebst, Probleme tief zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit Kunden Lösungen zu entwickeln, die kurzfristig umgesetzt werden, bist du bei uns richtig! Die Stelle ist in Teil- oder Vollzeit (mindestens 30h / Woche) remote, mit der Möglichkeit, jederzeit in unserem Büro in Berlin Charlottenburg zu arbeiten. Deine Aufgaben Bisher kümmert sich unser CPO Jakob neben seinen anderen Aufgaben selbst um das Design der Plattform. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die das ganz übernimmt und die Sicht unserer Nutzer:innen in jede Produktentscheidung einbringt. Du hast Freude daran, Projekte eigenständig zu übernehmen? Du arbeitest strukturiert und analytisch? Du machst gerne Research, testest Prototypen und kannst Anforderungen klar an die Entwicklung kommunizieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine(n) Product Designer UX/UI für unser Product Team. Konkret verantwortest du Folgendes: Du sprichst mit den Nutzer:innen unseres Produkts und findest heraus, wo es hakt. Du machst aus Research klare Problemstellungen, Personas und Journeys. title: Lead Machine Learning Scientist, Business Banking
description: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! Monzo Business Banking is fast-growing, is the UK’s most recommended business account for overall service quality. We recently hit 1 million customers and are used by 1 in 6 UK SMEs. We want to help businesses spend less time on financial admin and more time focused on running and growing their business. We’re building intelligent, data-driven and AI/ML-enabled product experiences that help small businesses feel more in control, make better decisions, and get more value from Monzo. ML is at the core of how we build and scale our products, enabling Monzo to make better decisions, faster, and helping us serve businesses more effectively. As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist in Business Banking, you’ll help build and ship models that power the next generation of Business Banking experiences. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science and Analytics Engineering to bring ML-enabled product capability into the heart of how we build for businesses. Whether it’s helping businesses understand their cash flow, reducing manual admin, surfacing the right insight at the right moment, or helping teams build intelligent product experiences responsibly, our work makes business banking smarter, simpler and more useful for SMEs. What you'll be working on As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll be a technical leader and hands-on individual contributor, spearheading our ML and GenAI capabilities and shipping key models that powers magical Business Banking experiences. You’ll: Be one of the first ML Scientists in Business Banking, bringing leadership through ambiguity by adding structure and direction to our ML capabilities while staying agile and building momentum. Develop and deploy advanced ML models on our cloud-native data platform to serve hundreds of thousands of business customers. Partner with Product, data science and other stakeholders to identify the highest-impact opportunities, size impact, and define success metrics. Decide when to use ML, GenAI, or simpler approaches and be clear on trade-offs. Design robust evaluation and monitoring so we can ship responsibly and measure impact in production. Lead the design and implementation of batch and near-real-time models (e.g. LLM-powered experiences, predictive models, time-series forecasting). Collaborate closely with MLOps and Backend Engineering to operationalise models end-to-end and raise the bar on ML lifecycle rigor. Set technical standards, mentor others, and support experimentation and iteration. You should apply if What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you! You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems, preferably in a fast-moving tech company. You have experience developing and shipping state-of-the-art ML models to production and delivering business impact. You're impact-driven and excited to own the end-to-end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production. You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so. You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with scikit-learn . You are comfortable using SQL, and keen to learn Go, which is used in many of our backend microservices. You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity. You want to be involved in building a product that small businesses use to run and manage their financial lives every day. You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions. You’re excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and AI and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain. You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas. You’re excited by the opportunity to help Business Banking evolve into AI and ML-enabled product capability. You can work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research and Data colleagues to shape product strategy, clarify trade-offs and build things that customers actually use. You’re thoughtful about responsible ML/AI; especially in financial products where trust, transparency and customer control matter. Nice to haves Experience working on personalisation, ranking, recommendation, forecasting, classification or decisioning problems for customer-facing applications. Experience working on ML systems for fintech, banking, accounting, payments, lending, invoicing, cash flow, tax, risk or business software. Experience with GenAI, LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation frameworks, or human-in-the-loop product experiences. Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices. Experience designing experiments, A/B tests or other approaches to measure product and customer impact. Experience working in regulated environments or with products where explainability, auditability and customer trust are especially important. Today, identity verification is fragmented across several product and onboarding experiences. Users are repeatedly asked to verify themselves across different services, creating unnecessary friction, inconsistent outcomes, and degraded trust. Universal KYC (UKYC) is a new initiative to solve this problem by creating a single, reusable identity layer across MetaMask. At the centre of this is MetaMask Passport , a product designed to enable users to verify once and unlock multiple experiences across the MetaMask ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of platform and product experience . You will define the primitives, standards, and user journeys that make identity verification seamless, privacy-conscious, and globally compliant. What you’ll do You will own the vision and roadmap for Universal KYC and MetaMask Passport, defining how a reusable identity layer unlocks the broader MetaMask product stack. You will build the underlying identity platform, creating scalable verification primitives and standards that can be adopted across products. In parallel, you will design a seamless, low-friction KYC experience that reduces time-to-first-transaction while maintaining compliance integrity. You will drive adoption across MetaMask by partnering closely with internal teams to integrate a consistent identity layer, while balancing privacy, trust, and global regulatory requirements. Throughout, you will lead execution end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and delivering measurable outcomes. What we are looking for: Proven experience building or scaling identity verification (IDV), KYC, or onboarding products Strong background in fintech , ideally with exposure to Web3 Hands-on experience working with identity verification providers (IDV vendors) such as Sumsub, Veriff, Onfido, Persona, or Stripe Identity Familiarity with compliance workflows , including KYC, KYB, and customer due diligence (CDD) processes Track record of delivering platform products adopted across multiple teams Ability to operate across both technical systems and user experience What Success looks like: Increased KYC completion rates and reduced onboarding friction Reduced time-to-first-transaction across KYC-gated flows Increased reuse of verified identity across products Improved transaction success rate through consistent verification outcomes Strong user trust with minimal friction and compliant execution Attributes that will make you stand out First-principles thinker with strong product judgment Deep user empathy with a focus on reducing friction and cognitive load Strong understanding of trust, privacy, and compliance trade-offs Clear, structured communicator who drives alignment and momentum High ownership and ability to operate in ambiguity Why This Role Matters Universal KYC is a foundational unlock for MetaMask, enabling users to move from fragmented, repetitive identity verification to a seamless, reusable experience across the entire product stack. It establishes a scalable, privacy-conscious identity layer that strengthens user trust while meeting global compliance requirements. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of access, trust, and growth, critical to unlocking the next phase of MetaMask’s evolution. Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. title: Financial Operations Analyst, 12 Month Fixed Term Contract

As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ 📍 London, Cardiff or UK Remote | 💰 £35,700 - £45,000 (depending on experience) + Benefits ⭐ O ur Financial Operations Team: Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective, our job is to ensure we pay our suppliers & employees on time, ensuring invoices are posted correctly in the ledger. title: Senior Manager, Application Security
description: Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day. About the role MetaMask is a self-custody wallet that does not hold users’ private keys. Blockchain transactions are generally irreversible, meaning a vulnerability in the product or its software delivery chain can lead directly to financial losses for users. As a result, MetaMask attracts sustained attention from financially motivated attackers and sophisticated supply chain actors. We are looking for a Senior Manager, Application Security to lead application security across the MetaMask extension, mobile app, Snaps, backend services, DeFi primitives, stablecoins, and supporting smart contracts. The role covers architecture, code, dependencies, build and release controls, security testing, and vulnerability disclosure. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and operating model, lead a small senior team, and remain directly involved in code review and threat modelling. You will report to the Head of Security and work closely with MetaMask Engineering leadership to ensure security risks are understood, owned, and addressed. Responsibilities Leadership and planning Lead and develop the Application Security team, including hiring, performance management and career development, while remaining directly involved in technical work. Set the Application Security strategy, annual goals and quarterly OKRs in line with company objectives and the approved Target Operating Model. Define and track KPIs to measure performance and progress. Report AppSec progress, coverage, remediation performance and material gaps to Security leadership and contribute to Risk Committee reporting. Secure design and delivery Define security review requirements across development and release, assess whether they are met and escalate unresolved risks. Lead threat modelling and security design reviews across clients, APIs and backend services, including authentication, key management, signing and delegated actions. Assess trust boundaries across the full system and participate in architecture and RFC reviews. Define software supply chain security requirements and work with engineering teams to implement and validate controls for dependencies, builds, artefacts and publishing. Lead security code reviews across MetaMask applications and smart contracts, working with engineers and relevant specialists to address findings. Define and evolve the secure development lifecycle to incorporate AI agents, including their access, actions and human review requirements. Set security standards for AI development tools, generated code and AI components in products. Integrate security testing into development and delivery workflows, including static and dynamic analysis, dependency scanning, secrets detection and AI scanning. Evaluate tools and validate their findings. Help engineers prevent recurring vulnerabilities through secure coding guidance, reusable libraries, training and the security champions programme. Vulnerability management and external testing Own application vulnerability assessment, triage, prioritisation and remediation tracking within the organisation’s vulnerability management framework. Correlate findings across clients, services and supporting infrastructure with the relevant owners to assess combined impact. Ensure findings have clear owners and deadlines, verify fixes and escalate overdue risks. Set the scope and proposed investment for bug bounty, penetration testing and AI security scanning based on risk and results. Manage external providers, researcher relationships, rewards and payouts, and coordinate vulnerability disclosure. Assurance and incident support Provide evidence of application security controls for audits and assurance reviews, and support customer and partner due diligence. Provide application security expertise during incidents, including vulnerability analysis and remediation support. Qualifications Required : At least eight years in application security or software engineering with a security focus, including two years leading people. Strong practical code review skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or Solidity across browser extensions, mobile applications and backend services, with the ability to identify vulnerabilities and work with engineers to fix them. Proven experience securing applications across clients and backend services, including distributed authentication, authorisation and key management. Experience building or substantially improving an AppSec programme, including security reviews, automated testing, AI scanning, vulnerability management and developer support, with sound judgement on where AI adds value and how to validate its findings. Practical experience securing software supply chains, including dependency policies, software composition analysis, npm, artefact integrity and CI/CD. Experience running bug bounty and penetration testing programmes, including selecting and managing external providers. Working knowledge of EVM smart contract security, including common vulnerabilities, review methods, upgrade and admin controls, and assessing external audits. A record of delivering security improvements through engineering teams outside your reporting line. Clear written communication, from actionable threat models to concise summaries of risk for executives. Preferred : Offensive security qualifications such as OSCP, OSWE or OSWA, or a proven record in bug bounty programmes or CTF competitions. Experience securing browser extensions or mobile applications. Experience securing development workflows that use AI, or AI components in production applications. Experience in crypto, Web3 or another sector facing sustained attacks, such as fintech, payments or infrastructure. Knowledge of or a strong interest in applied cryptography. Familiarity with attacks by state actors against software companies, particularly DPRK supply chain and social engineering campaigns. Experience providing evidence of secure development controls for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 assessments. Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role. In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3. MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page. MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.

title: Community Field Strategist- UK
description: What We Do: Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection. Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other. Reports to: Manager, Community Location: Remote UK Compensation Range: £68,000 to £78,000 base plus bonus and equity What You'll Do: You are the person who brings Huntress to life in the room. You travel to roadshows, tradeshows, and other events, meet people who didn't plan to meet you, and turn genuine conversations into momentum for the business. Give More Than We Take shows up in the way you create value first, listen closely, and build relationships that feel human rather than transactional. You are Outcome-Obsessed about creating meaningful engagements at events from the moment you leave your house to the moment you return, knowing that booth hours are just the tip of the iceberg. You make sure the right prospects receive thoughtful follow-up, account executives get the context they need, and qualified conversations become fully booked demo opportunities. You take ownership of the details, spot what is missing, and use sound judgment when the process needs to bend to serve the customer and the team. Responsibilities: Travel to assigned roadshows, tradeshows, and other events up to 60% of the time while representing Huntress with energy, professionalism, and a clear understanding of the audience. Drive meaningful traffic to the Huntress booth with pre-event outreach, and by starting conversations, engaging attendees, and creating reasons for the right people to stop and learn more. Execute on-site activations and feet-on-the-street account-based marketing activities as directed by your manager. Build genuine relationships with prospects and partners, in transit, in hallways, over drinks, over dinner, at the booth, at event receptions and parties. Wherever the MSPs are, that’s where you’ll be found. Drive interest through thoughtful conversation, and book demos at in-person events. Manage event follow-up and relationship progression so account executives receive timely context, clear next steps, and strong opportunities to pursue. Use AI tools to research target accounts, prepare for conversations, organize event notes, and draft timely follow-up while applying sound judgment to the final work. What You Bring to the Team: Experience engaging prospects at tradeshows, roadshows, conferences, or other in-person events is valuable. You are curious, self-starting, eager to learn, driven, and comfortable taking initiative without waiting for perfect instructions. You can engage strangers naturally, make small talk that leads somewhere useful, and build relationships without making the interaction feel transactional. You are travel-ready and comfortable working in environments that require frequent movement, quick judgment, and consistent energy. You are detail-oriented and able to follow a process while recognizing when the situation calls for a thoughtful deviation. You use AI to work faster and smarter in day-to-day preparation, research, and follow-up, with good judgment about accuracy, privacy, and when human context matters most. What We Offer: 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015 New starter home office set up reimbursement (£398) Generous personal leave entitlements Digital monthly reimbursement (£92) Travel to the US 1-2 times/year for various company events Pension Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status. We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes. Accommodations: If you require reasonable accommodation to complete this application, interview, or pre-employment testing or participate in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to accommodations@huntresslabs.com . Please note that non-accommodation requests to this inbox will not receive a response. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Neobank app. This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly. What You'll Own Build and ship full product features across frontend, backend, APIs and databases. Create customer and internal workflows for onboarding, accounts, payments, rewards, travel, FX, support automation, KYC and risk. Turn ambiguous product problems into working systems with clean UX and reliable backend logic. Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI engineers to launch fast and improve after release. Build internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and help teams operate at scale. Own your work beyond release: monitor, debug, learn and improve. What We're Looking For Strong full stack engineering experience with real shipped products. Comfortable across frontend, backend, APIs, databases and production debugging. Good frontend execution using React, Next.js, Vue or similar modern stack. Good backend fundamentals around APIs, data models, authentication, integrations and reliability. Strong product sense and ability to simplify messy workflows. Able to work fast with ambiguity and own outcomes end-to-end. This Role Is Not For Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer. People who need complete specs before starting. Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact. Candidates who avoid production support. People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work. The Bar We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Spain . We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in Spain . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Business Recruiter - International Sales (UK/EMEA)
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. "At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you." – Alicia Strait , VP of Talent, TRM Labs As TRM expands across EMEA and other global markets, our ability to hire the right sellers, compliance experts, and go-to-market talent in-region determines how fast our blockchain intelligence reaches the institutions and agencies fighting illicit finance worldwide. As an International Sales Recruiter , you'll own high-priority searches across EMEA and beyond — Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and broader business roles — partnering closely with hiring managers and Talent leadership to define strategy, map regional markets, engage passive candidates, and drive high-quality hiring decisions with speed and precision. Your success is measured by the quality, velocity, and business impact of the hires you make across TRM's international business functions. The impact you'll have: Own full-cycle recruiting for international roles across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other functions. Act as a strategic talent partner to hiring managers, including advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, sourcing strategy, and close approach. Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional talent across EMEA and other global markets. Develop regional talent maps across priority markets that include high-performing companies, competitive talent, referral networks, and specialized candidate communities. Create an exceptional candidate experience where every touchpoint reflects TRM's talent bar, mission, and operating principles. Use data, market insight, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and adjust strategy in real time. Drive urgency and decision quality through clear calibration, structured feedback, and timely hiring decisions. Continuously improve international recruiting including intake quality, scorecard alignment, sourcing strategy, debrief rigor, and offer execution. Partner cross-functionally with Talent, People, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to navigate international hiring considerations and keep searches moving. What we're looking for: 5-7+ years of recruiting experience, with strong experience supporting international sales hiring in high-growth technology companies. Proven success hiring across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other business functions. Strong knowledge of EMEA talent markets, with the ability to adapt strategy by region, function, and candidate profile. Strong search fundamentals including market mapping, talent intelligence, passive candidate engagement, candidate assessment, and closing. The ability to quickly understand complex business roles across GTM, compliance, marketing, and operations. Strong analytical ability to interpret recruiting metrics, funnel health, conversion rates, and pipeline quality and translate them into action. Exceptional stakeholder management that includes building trust, influencing hiring managers, pushing back thoughtfully, and operating as a strategic advisor. Excellent written and verbal communication, including synthesizing market insight, candidate tradeoffs, and search progress clearly for stakeholders. High ownership, autonomy, persistence, and judgment in navigating ambiguous, specialized, business-critical searches. The ability to operate effectively in a remote, globally distributed environment with strong overlap across EMEA and U.S. business hours. About the team: Our talent team is fully remote and async-first. We keep work moving across time zones through Slack, thorough documentation, and proactive updates. We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together. We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting. We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration. Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: Within 72 hours of a role opening, you've scheduled the intake, researched and published the role, and brought 5 calibration profiles to the intake for the hiring manager to review. Within a week of opening the role, you've mapped the total addressable market, built a shortlist of the top 30 profiles, conducted 5–10 recruiter screens, and stood up the full interview process — including the approved questions that define what good looks like on a recruiter screen. Two weeks after the initial interviews, you analyze the data to identify what is and isn't driving pass rates and conversions, share insights and recommendations with the hiring team, and continue to monitor and adjust until the position is filled. Our Onboarding Process: Within your first 30 days , you’ll be fully onboarded, calibrated, and operating as the DRI for your positions. Within your first 60 days , you’ll have your first sourced candidates reaching final rounds. Within your first 90 days , you’ll have made 2–3 hires . The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role: Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only The estimated base salary range for this role is $153,000 - $172,000. Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan. Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Lakes
description: From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re seeking a Principal Software Engineer to contribute to the technical architecture, design and development of Fivetran’s Managed Data Lake product offering. As part of a senior engineering team, you’ll partner with product and engineering teams to build scalable, high-performance systems, advance open-source technologies, and set technical standards that raise the bar across the organization. This is a full-time remote position based out of Germany. Technologies You’ll Use Java, C++, Postgres, Temporal, gRPC AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Grafana Iceberg, Polaris, Delta Lake, Parquet, DuckDB What You’ll Do Partner closely with product teams to understand requirements and design cutting-edge new capabilities that go directly into customer’s hands. Design, develop, implement, and operate highly reliable large-scale data lake systems in cooperation with a dedicated data lake engineering team. Contribute to open-source projects such as DuckDB and Polaris. Embrace Fivetran innovations with open-source standards and toolsets. Analyze fault-tolerance and high availability issues, performance and scale challenges, and solve them. Ensure operational excellence of the services and meet the commitments to our customers regarding security, reliability, availability, and performance. Set technical directions and influence cross-functional teams. Skills We’re Looking For 6+ years of hands-on or research experience with high-performance relational data management systems. Deep understanding of infrastructure & software optimizations and performance engineering to drive significant performance, latency, and availability improvements. Proven track record of leading and delivering large and complicated projects. Strong development skills in Java and C++. Solid experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP). Demonstrated knowledge of columnar storage formats. Growth mindset and excitement about breaking the status quo by seeking innovative solutions. Excellent team player who is consistent in making everyone around you better. Bonus Skills Strongly prefer an MS or PhD in Computer Science, ideally focusing on database management and/or storage engines. #LI-IM1 #LI-REMOTE Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenMusic
location: Denmark,  France,  Netherlands,  Poland,  UK,  USA
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two. You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days. You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it. Requirements Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Employee Relations Advisor
description: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ 📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£34,000 - £46,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨ Our Employee Relations team⭐ We’re looking for an experienced Employee Relations Advisor to join our Employee Relations team and help us create fair, consistent and genuinely positive people experiences across Monzo. You’ll partner closely with managers, People Partners and teams across the wider People Collective, providing specialist advice on complex and higher-risk employee relations matters across our global locations, specifically the UK and EU . This is a role where you’ll be trusted to use your judgement. You’ll help managers navigate difficult situations with clarity, empathy and confidence, balancing employment law and risk with what’s fair, practical and right for Monzo and our people. As Monzo continues to grow internationally, you’ll also bring experience of working across different employment landscapes. Experience supporting Employee Relations at a Global scale is particularly important for this role, alongside an understanding of how ER approaches need to flex across different jurisdictions, cultures and legal frameworks. You’ll be comfortable working independently, getting stuck into problems where the answer isn’t always obvious, and spotting opportunities to make things better. You’ll also be an escalation point for more complex ER matters, coach others to build their confidence and judgement, and contribute to projects that improve how we approach Employee Relations across Monzo. 🔑You’ll play a key role by... Being a trusted ER specialist: You’ll partner with managers and People Partners on complex, sensitive and higher-risk ER matters, giving clear, pragmatic advice and helping them reach fair and consistent outcomes. Supporting ER across our global locations: You’ll adapt your advice to different employment landscapes, taking account of local employment law, regulatory requirements, culture and established practices. Getting stuck into complex problems: You’ll independently support matters across performance, conduct, grievances, absence, capability, organisational change and other complex workplace issues, including situations where there isn’t an obvious answer. Helping managers own their decisions: We want our managers to feel confident managing their people. You’ll coach, advise and appropriately challenge them, while making sure ownership of decisions stays with the relevant manager. Being an escalation point: You’ll support ER colleagues with more complex or ambiguous cases, helping them think through risk, options and the best way forward rather than simply giving them the answer. Growing capability across the team: You’ll coach and mentor less experienced ER colleagues, sharing your knowledge and helping them develop their judgement, confidence and independence. Supporting employment disputes and litigation: You’ll support ACAS Early Conciliation, Employment Tribunal claims and other employment-related disputes, partnering closely with Legal, external counsel and other teams where needed. Keeping our ER foundations strong: You’ll make sure ER matters are properly documented and managed through our case management systems, with high standards of confidentiality, accuracy and data quality. Turning data into action: You’ll use ER and wider People data to spot trends, themes and emerging risks, getting underneath what’s driving them and turning those insights into practical recommendations. Making our policies and processes better: You’ll help design, review and improve People policies, processes and ER frameworks so they’re easy to use, fit for purpose and work across the different jurisdictions in which we operate. Building manager confidence: You’ll design and deliver training, knowledge shares and other interventions that help managers handle people matters confidently and consistently. Keeping us ahead of changes: You’ll stay curious about developments in employment law, case law, regulation and ER practice across our global footprint, particularly Spain , helping us understand what they mean for Monzo and what we might need to do differently. Making things better: You’ll lead and contribute to ER and wider People Collective projects, taking ownership from idea through to implementation and looking for ways we can make our ER approach simpler, stronger and more scalable. 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if… You’re an experienced Employee Relations specialist with strong practical knowledge of employment law and ER best practice, including experience supporting ACAS Early Conciliation and/or Employment Tribunal claims. You’re confident independently managing complex, sensitive and higher-risk ER matters , using sound judgement to balance legal and ER risk with fairness and practical business considerations. You’ve worked in a global or multi-jurisdictional ER environment and understand how to adapt your approach to different local employment laws, regulations, cultures and employment practices, including when to seek specialist local advice. You’re comfortable challenging, influencing and building trusted relationships with managers and senior stakeholders, combining empathy and diplomacy with appropriate challenge. You enjoy coaching and developing others , helping managers and colleagues build their own confidence and judgement rather than simply giving them the answer. You’re proactive and comfortable with ambiguity — you spot problems, risks and opportunities, get to the root of them and take ownership of finding practical solutions. You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities and complex pieces of work while maintaining strong attention to detail. You’re comfortable using data and insights to identify trends, understand what’s driving ER activity and spot opportunities to improve how we do things. You care about creating kind, fair and respectful people experiences , particularly when navigating difficult or sensitive situations. It’d be great, but isn’t essential, if you… Are CIPD qualified or have another relevant employment law or HR qualification. Have designed or implemented ER policies, frameworks, training or broader People 🙌 What’s in it for you 💰 £34,000 - £46,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance. 📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences. 🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits . 🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps Recruiter Call Role Specific Interview Values and Behavioural Interviews This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here. We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. #LI-CB4 #LI-REMOTE Equal opportunities for everyone Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report. We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

title: Senior Design Engineer
description: Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day. About this role We’re looking for a Senior Design Engineer to join the Consensys Design team, supporting MetaMask - the most used wallet in crypto. This is a rare opportunity to bring beautiful, intuitive experiences to millions of users engaging with decentralized applications and Web3 technologies every day. As a Senior Design Engineer, you'll turn complex flows into simple and delightful experiences across our app and browser extension. Working closely with designers, engineers, and product managers, you'll take ideas from prototype to production - sweating the animations, haptics, and micro-interactions that make every interaction feel considered, not just functional. You'll build in React and React Native with an eye for pixel-perfect execution, contribute to our design system, and build agentic workflows that help the team move faster without cutting corners. If you love making complex things feel simple, care about craft down to the smallest detail, and want that craft in the hands of 30M+ users, this role is for you. What You'll Do In one sentence: Make MetaMask interactions feel intuitive, fast, and delightful - across mobile and extension Build pixel-perfect interfaces in React and React Native, with obsessive attention to detail. Design and implement animations and micro-interactions that make every tap feel considered. Translate Figma designs into accessible, production-ready experiences with minimal handoff friction. Build agentic workflows and tooling that speed up design-to-code and day-to-day engineering work. Grow the MetaMask design system: reusable, accessible components built to scale across platforms. Move from idea to prototype fast and validate with real users. Push for craft everywhere - the small animation nobody asked for that makes an interaction click. Key Experience Portfolio demonstrating delightful, polished interfaces and interactions - not just static screens, but the motion and detail that make them feel alive. Proven track record shipping high-traffic, consumer-facing products in React and React Native. Fluency in modern JS/TypeScript and cross-platform frontend architecture: performance, accessibility, and scalable UI patterns An eye for interaction design and motion - you know when animations and haptics earn their place and when they're just noise. Strong Figma literacy - you read a design file like code. Good judgment about when to polish and when to ship. Comfortable working autonomously across a distributed, global team Hands-on experience with crypto wallets, blockchain, or related Web3 products. Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3. MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. title: Manager, Solutions Engineering | NorBen | Remote
description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. You will own the regional build-out with your sales leader counterparts, adopting existing OSS Specific GTM strategies and developing new ones as needed. You’ll work with your Customer Experience counterparts to ensure that your customers are successful after the sale, in their adoption and rollout of Grafana products through professional services, support, training and customer success. You’ll work with marketing to drive community and adoption programs in the region designed to broaden the adoption of both OSS and commercial/cloud versions of our products. You’ll also work closely with Product Management and Engineering to ensure that we are constantly delivering value to our customers by influencing the roadmap, based on your customers and team feedback, as well as leveraging your own experience in the Monitoring and Observability space. All of this will be required for you to hit and then exceed your region's financial targets and ultimately, our company's goals. Your impact will be felt globally when the job is done well. Adopting a player/coach mentality will be critical here, ensuring that you balance your field responsibilities with the needs of your team. Mentoring and career development will be critical to your team's success over the long term Direct the bulk of your day to day work based on guidance and goals from leadership, owning the planning, actions and outcomes of the region. Partner with the Benelux / NEMEA Sales leadership on customer programs, marketing initiatives and community/company events to drive adoption and expansion within our customer base. Understanding your key customers’ strategies for adoption of Grafana technologies and developing programs and collateral to enable them to be successful. Ensure that your customers’ requirements are being met with our product through partnership with Product Management and Engineering, helping them prioritize their team's time with a data-driven approach to wins/losses/needs vs wants, etc. Own and report on the quarter over quarter cadence of your team while they help prospects evaluate our software with demonstrations, technical deep dives, trials and POVs. Find and drive enablement and sell with/through channel partners in the region. Both at a local, geo and global level with both RSI’s and GSI’s. Has successfully mentored individual contributors. Open Source selling or Cloud first/Product led sales go to market motion a big plus. Direct experience implementing and/or executing a formal sales methodology, eg COM, Value selling, qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC Direct experience selling monitoring/data/visualisation products. Proven ability to own a book of business, direct your own and your team's work and initiatives to exceed your quarterly targets. English fluency required, and a second European language is preferred Located in the Netherlands In the Netherlands, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 161,000 - EUR 191,000. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law.
