title: Staff Solutions Architect - N.A.
description: Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane , and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane —a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable . Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents . We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence. Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries . Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide . We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital , and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io As a Staff Solutions Architect at Upbound, you own the technical success of our customers. You are the primary driver of customer outcomes, from initial implementation through production adoption, ensuring customers achieve real business value with Crossplane and the Upbound platform. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role embedded in the post-sales motion , working closely with customers to deliver working solutions, not just guidance. In this role, you will own: Customer Technical Outcomes Drive end-to-end technical success for a portfolio of enterprise customers, from post-sales handoff through production adoption. Own the implementation of known Upbound use cases — control plane architectures, Upbound/Crossplane configurations, GitOps integration, platform engineering patterns — and ensure customers reach their target state. Define and track technical milestones that map to customer business objectives and contract value. Act as the primary technical escalation point when customers face blockers, coordinating engineering and product resources to resolve them. Implementation & Architecture Lead technical discovery to deeply understand customer environments, platform requirements, and target architecture. Design and deliver Crossplane-based control plane architectures tailored to customer infrastructure and organizational context. Build and maintain reference platforms and implementation accelerators that codify Upbound best practices and reduce time-to-value for common use cases. Contribute Statements of Work that accurately scope implementation engagements. Write code, fix bugs, and build scoped features within Upbound products, provider ecosystem, and Crossplane core where needed to unblock customers. Technical Voice of the Customer Represent customer technical needs internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization. Partner with pre-sales SEs to ensure smooth, informed handoffs with full context on customer environment and expectations. Identify expansion opportunities as customer technical maturity grows and new Upbound capabilities become relevant. You are a good fit if you have: Hands-on Kubernetes expertise — operators, controllers, or add-ons; production deployment and management experience. Platform engineering or SRE background, with direct experience building or operating an Internal Developer Platform (IDP). Deep familiarity with cloud-native tooling: CNCF ecosystem, IaC (Terraform/Pulumi), GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines. Experience across at least two major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) at production scale. Strong programming skills; Go is strongly preferred. Proven track record of leading customers through complex technical implementations to successful, measurable outcomes. Excellent communication skills — comfortable presenting architecture and trade-offs to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders. Able to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously in a fast-moving startup environment. It is a plus if: Crossplane power user — contributions to core or the provider ecosystem are very appreciated [for many reasons] Active Kubernetes community involvement: contributions, conference talks, technical writing, or open source maintainership. CKA or CKAD certification. Prior startup, familiarity with coding agents and distributed team experience. #LI-REMOTE Why Upbound? At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table. About Upbound Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io .

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: About Quilter At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full-speed toward our goal. No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there: Curiosity Conviction Rigor We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join Quilter’s Application Team and help us build the software platform behind the future of circuit board design. We are a team of generalists who pride ourselves on solving new challenges and always learning. You’ll work across the stack to create helpful and friendly user interfaces as well as the services backing them. As one of our early engineers, you’ll have massive ownership and influence over the direction of our product, architecture, and team culture. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in high-ownership environments, loves solving complex technical problems, and is excited by the idea of bridging the worlds of software and hardware development. Today, the team works mainly with Python and Typescript / Javascript so strong fundamentals with those tools is required. title: Principal Product Manager, Fraud and Risk
description: Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started! As the Principal Product Manager for our Defend product, you will own the strategy, vision, and execution of tools designed for fraud investigation and risk prediction. Defend is our anti-fraud platform that protects consumers against forgery or impersonation. Experience in building fraud or cybersecurity products is a must. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with engineering, data science, and design teams to create intuitive investigative tools and data-driven risk models that protect businesses and their customers. You’ll work directly with customers to deeply understand their challenges, anticipate emerging fraud trends, and deliver solutions that drive real impact. In addition, you will also lead strategic planning, vision definition, GTM strategy, stakeholder alignment, executive presentations and customer briefings as it pertains to your product area. You may also need to be an expert in specific customer segments such as enterprise, real estate or financial services. This role is an individual contributor role, reporting to the VP of Product. What you'll do as a Principal Product Manager: Independently lead customer solution conversations to help unlock activation and gather key product insights to improve your product area. Build a deep understanding of the intersection between our customers and our trusted agents to drive these insights back into our product strategy. Make critical product and business decisions in an area that is highly ambiguous and requires the synthesis of data, feedback and customer insights Creating product vision and roadmaps to advance our product strategy in the market and presenting this to key customers and stakeholders Partner with internal stakeholders to review product strategy, build consensus and ensure alignment. Provide status updates, action plans and recommendations to senior leadership on an ongoing basis Partner with our operations teams to streamline the onboarding of new notaries and agents to our platform. Partner with our strategy team to define new business opportunities and business models for agents to earn on our platform. Shape the GTM strategy for how we drive engagement and community within our network of trusted agents. Partner with the Fraud Operations team and Customer Support to respond to cases of fraud, creating a feedback loop for the platform. Research and introduce new technologies that can be incorporated into our product (for example, technologies such as machine learning, computer vision, PKI, real-time analytics, etc.) Define the work for our engineering team by writing functional specs, prioritizing roadmaps, troubleshooting customer issues and managing the day-to-day execution of several software development projects. Partner across Solutions, Customer Success, Sales and Engineering to advance the mission of our Trust Platform. What were looking for: 10+ years of experience in software development (ideally with a mix of SaaS, startup, B2B/B2C experience) 5+ years of experience in technical product management 3+ years of experience with design thinking product methodology Ability to influence, negotiate and drive results Excellent communication skills and executive presence Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way. A solid toolbox of product management skills A passion for building great customer experiences You thrive in ambiguity and believe every problem has many solutions You have a knack for navigating competing opinions, making everyone feel heard, and shifting perspectives when necessary You’re naturally innovative. You’re dreaming of new solutions before their problems arise. A strong working knowledge of APIs and SDKs You can lead engineering conversations on technical topics like, information architecture, object model and data flows Experience working on platform products, marketplace, PKI or real-time analytics Prior experience with documents or eSignature is recommended A technical degree is a plus Position Logistics: Travel: This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process. Our Proof Pillars: Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow. Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own. Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success. Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win! Here are some of our great benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date Unlimited Sick and Vacation time 14 paid company holidays 12 weeks of paid parental leave 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit Monthly work from home stipend Professional development credit Monthly reimbursement for Wellness And more! Compensation This is the expected total cash compensation range for this position. The salary offered within this range will be determined based on factors including but not limited to skills, qualifications, experience and location. The total compensation package for this role includes base pay, the benefits listed above, and equity. Additional Information This position will be posted and accepting applications through November 20, 2026. Proof uses Identify & Defend, our fraud prevention and identity verification tools, to confirm that individuals engaging with Proof at any stage correspond to a real identity. It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications. Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. title: Senior Accountant
description: ComputerCare has spent more than 20 years building something rare in the IT world: a company where technical excellence and genuine human connection are valued equally. We're the trusted partner that IT leaders turn to when technology can't afford to fail. As a woman-owned business serving innovative companies worldwide, we combine certified technical expertise with a human approach. Whether it's managing complex device lifecycles for global teams or performing authorized repairs for Apple, Lenovo, HP and Dell devices, our work directly impacts how thousands of people stay productive every day. We never outsource our work because we believe in accountability, quality, and building lasting relationships—with our clients and as a team. If you're passionate about technology, take pride in solving real problems, and want to be part of a company that values both technical excellence and the people behind it, ComputerCare is where you belong. Come join us in our mission of being the Human Side of Hardware! ComputerCare is creating an internal accounting department after previously outsourcing the accounting function. Thishands-on Senior Accountant role is suited to someone with approximately three to four years of relevant experience and will be part of an initial two-person accounting team, reporting directly to the Controller. The immediate priorities are customer invoicing, customer account maintenance, accounts receivable, and sales tax administration. An external accounting firm will initially handle some account reconciliations and portions of the monthly close. The function is expected to move fully in-house over approximately 12 months, with this role taking on additional accounting responsibilities as the transition progresses. What You'll Do Initially Customer invoicing and customer accounts Prepare and issue timely, accurate customer invoices; work with internal teams to resolve billing questions and discrepancies. Record and apply customer payments and credit memos accurately. Confirm that each customer has the appropriate credits on their account and research unapplied payments and credit balances. Coordinate refunds and account adjustments under established approval procedures, maintaining supporting documentation. Respond to customer billing inquiries and reconcile customer account balances. Accounts receivable and collections Monitor AR aging and provide first-line follow-up on overdue invoices, payment discrepancies, and disputed balances. Work with customers and other team members on collections in coordination with the Controller; maintain follow-up records and escalate unresolved items. Provide the Controller with updates on aging, collection activity, and accounts requiring attention. Sales tax administration Handle day-to-day sales tax administration under the Controller’s oversight, including reviewing tax charged on customer invoices and researching discrepancies. Maintain customer exemption certificates and supporting sales tax records. Prepare sales tax account reconciliations, investigate differences, and coordinate corrections with the Controller and external providers. Coordinate and monitor sales tax return preparation and filing by external providers, review supporting information, and track filing and payment deadlines. Assist with sales tax notices and information requests, referring technical questions and compliance decisions to the Controller and external tax advisors. Roles and Responsibilities Additional duties will be assigned progressively by the Controller as work transitions from the external accounting firm. These may include: Prepare recurring and adjusting journal entries, supporting schedules, and balance sheet account reconciliations. Complete assigned monthly close tasks within the Controller’s close schedule and assist with financial reporting and variance analysis. Maintain fixed asset records and record depreciation, payroll, benefits, and related accruals. Support accounts payable, including invoice coding, approval routing, vendor inquiries, vendor records, and payment preparation under established approval controls. Assist with expense reports, corporate card reconciliations, 1099 preparation, and supporting schedules for external tax preparers. Learn existing processes from the external accounting firm and help transfer supporting records and workpapers. Follow procedures and controls established by the Controller, help document and implement them, and provide input on recurring issues or practical improvements. What You'll Bring 4+ years of relevant accounting experience, including hands-on customer invoicing, customer account maintenance, and accounts receivable. Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting Working knowledge of sales tax administration, including sales tax account reconciliations, exemption certificates, and coordination of return preparation and filing. Understanding of general ledger accounting, reconciliations, and the monthly close process. Demonstrated curiosity and ownership mindset; notices recurring issues or patterns and proactively raises them as opportunities for improvement, even when the solution falls outside their direct responsibility. Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and ability to research and resolve account discrepancies. Clear, professional communication skills and comfort coordinating billing and collections with customers and internal teams. Ability to manage recurring deadlines and take on additional responsibilities as the department develops. Experience with NetSuite preferred. Perks and Benefits Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans to keep you feeling your best 401(k) with employer match—because your future matters Company-paid Life Insurance, plus HSA & FSA options Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for real support when you need it Adoption Assistance to help grow your family Commuter Benefits for an easier ride Free Coursera Professional Certifications to level up your skills Generous vacation & sick time, plus paid time off to give back to your community Compensation Additional Information If you get to this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job you just read. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in ComputerCare’s mission, core values and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways – not just candidates who check all the boxes. At ComputerCare, we welcome passionate individuals who have the unrestricted right to work in the United States, including natural citizens and Green Card holders. ComputerCare is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

title: Senior Product Designer, Mobile
description: About Us: Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home. We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us. About the Role: This is an early-stage app with huge expansion planned this year — a rare opportunity for a designer who wants to define the vision for a mobile product from the ground up. As Senior Product Designer, you will define how AI feels for the teams building our homes. You'll shape the experiences that our Superintendents and Direct Construction Operators (DCOs) rely on every day—across our mobile application, advanced AI based video analysis, and new experiences around automated data capture on site. This is a role for a designer who blends sharp interaction design with strong visual craft. You'll take novel, sometimes ambiguous AI capabilities—computer vision, multimodal models, agents—and turn them into interfaces that feel clear, trustworthy, and genuinely delightful on a jobsite. You know the emerging patterns for designing with AI (surfacing confidence, handling uncertainty, guiding and correcting the model) and you have a point of view on how to make them feel effortless for users who are not sitting at a desk. You're also an exceptional communicator: helping craft executive level presentations that carry Homebound's AI narrative across the entire company, our board, and our investors. What You'll Do: Own the end-to-end experience: Design interaction flows and polished, high-craft visuals across all of our field initiatives. Design compelling AI patterns: Turn frontier AI capabilities into interfaces that are clear and trustworthy—handling confidence, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop correction in delightful ways. Design for the field, not the desk: Craft mobile-first experiences that work for Superintendents and DCOs in real jobsite conditions. Bring experiences to life with motion: Use motion design where it counts to make AI interactions feel intuitive, responsive, and compelling. Partner tightly with your PM and engineers: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Field AI PM and Engineering to move from concept to shipped product. Communicate the AI story: Present to executives and teams across the company, using your work to make Homebound's AI vision tangible and shared. What You'll Bring: A portfolio showcasing highly polished mobile app case studies, demonstrating strong interaction design and high visual craft. 5+ years of product design experience, with direct experience designing mobile applications (iOS strongly preferred). Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML patterns into products in delightful, usable ways. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, including direct experience presenting to executive-level audiences. Comfort designing in ambiguity—translating novel, evolving AI capabilities into clear, intuitive experiences. A collaborative, self-starting approach; you partner naturally across product, engineering, and operations. Interest in construction and the built environment is a plus; no prior industry experience required, but an expectation to learn the domain rapidly. Our Commitment : We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. To apply, please submit an application with your resume on the Career’s page. Homebound is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Homebound considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our Compensation Philosophy : Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Please note that the salary range displayed on each job posting may vary by state. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that each job posting includes a general description of any other compensation offered for the position in addition to the salary range displayed on the job posting. You can find information about our benefits here .

title: Senior Customer Support Engineer
description: Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane , and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane —a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable . Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents . We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence. Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries . Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide . We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital , and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io As a Senior Customer Support Engineer at Upbound, you won’t just resolve tickets, you'll own the customer experience from first touch to full resolution, setting the standard for what world-class technical support looks like in the cloud-native ecosystem. You’ll be a trusted technical advisor to our customers, working alongside Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to make every interaction exceptional. This is a high-impact role for someone who gets genuine satisfaction from solving hard problems, has a natural drive to help, and believes that great support is a craft not a function. In this role, you will: Serve as a primary technical resource for customer inquiries related to Upbound’s products Spaces, Cloud, Official Extensions, Marketplace, Registry & More delivering a “wow” experience with every single touch Apply a structured, methodical troubleshooting approach to diagnose and resolve complex customer issues, moving efficiently from hypothesis to root cause Triage, own, and drive tickets to resolution with urgency and clear communication proactively keeping customers informed every step of the way Identify, document, and escalate bugs and product issues to Engineering with thorough reproduction steps, collaborating closely to ensure fast resolution Partner with the Solutions team on complex, strategic customer requests, ensuring seamless handoffs and continuity of experience Capture and contribute knowledge back to the team building and maintaining a high-quality internal knowledge base using KCS (Knowledge-Centered Service) methodology Gather and synthesize customer feedback to surface trends, advocate for product improvements, and drive process enhancements across the team Build or contribute to agentic tooling, automation, and internal workflows that meaningfully elevate the support experience and scale your own impact You’re a good fit if you have: 4+ years of experience in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role, ideally in a SaaS or enterprise infrastructure environment A natural “helper gene” you’re energized by solving problems for others and take personal ownership of customer outcomes Strong, systematic troubleshooting methodology you approach complex issues with a clear framework, not just instinct Solid experience with Kubernetes, cloud-native technologies, and infrastructure-as-code Excellent written and verbal communication skills you can explain deeply technical concepts to any audience without losing precision A customer-first mindset with a relentless drive to deliver experiences that genuinely delight Solid experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies — including Helm, OCI artifact distribution, RBAC, admission webhooks, and policy frameworks (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno) Able to drive root cause analysis independently using observability tooling — Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or equivalent — without needing Engineering to interpret metrics or traces for you Experience with vulnerability management in containerised environments — triaging CVE severity, assessing blast radius, and communicating risk and remediation timelines to enterprise security teams It’s a plus if you have: Hands-on experience with Upbound and/or Crossplane Familiarity with KCS (Knowledge-Centered Service) practices and methodology Experience building agentic tooling, support automations, or AI-assisted workflows to improve customer outcomes Proficiency with Unix-like shells and command-line interfaces Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar Startup experience you know how to operate with ambiguity and move fast Hands-on experience with GitOps tooling (ArgoCD or Flux) and familiarity with reconciliation failure modes — drift, conflicts, dependency ordering Background in platform engineering or internal developer platforms (IDPs) — you understand what platform teams are trying to build and why it breaks Working proficiency in Go — enough to read Crossplane/provider source, identify relevant fixes, and #LI-REMOTE Why Upbound? At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table. About Upbound Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io .

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (Power Generation / Gas-to-Power)
description: What We’re Building Candid is building the AI layer for EPCs. We use AI to reduce the manual effort behind preconstruction engineering by automating document understanding, consistency checks, and repetitive workflow steps across major disciplines. Our goal is to make preconstruction 10x faster without sacrificing engineering quality. We recently raised $6.5M from top AI and industrial investors (including Schneider Electric and Meta’s Chief AI Scientist). Our team includes engineers from MIT, Carnegie Mellon, major LNG and power projects, and leading EPCs. This Role We're hiring a senior mechanical engineer who has actually delivered power generation and gas-to-power projects at a top EPC, PMC, owner-operator, or equipment OEM. Think combined cycle, simple cycle and peakers, gas-to-power for data centers and behind-the-meter campuses, LNG, and cogeneration, with the rotating equipment and balance of plant that goes with them. If your career has been refining or petrochem static equipment with no power work, this isn't the right fit. This is a hands-on role. You'll do real mechanical engineering on our delivery work for the parts our software can't handle yet, you'll be the quality check on what the software does produce, and you'll shape where the product goes next. Three jobs in one, and the mix shifts as the product gets better. What You'll Do This is hands-on engineering plus product. Day to day you'll: Do real mechanical engineering on our FEL-2 and early-phase delivery work, owning the parts our software can't handle yet so projects ship Be the quality gate on Candid's automated mechanical outputs: catch what's wrong before it reaches a client, and feed it back so the product gets sharper Define how equipment scope gets developed and validated through FEED on power and gas-to-power projects, and what "good" looks like Review and validate mechanical content across equipment datasheets, vendor packages, and discipline handoffs Build repeatable checks that catch scope gaps and inconsistencies early Map where mechanical rework happens, why it happens, and what inputs drive it Clarify interface points with Process, Piping, I&C, and Electrical Separate the steps that are genuinely repetitive from the ones that need real engineering judgment You'll help define the checks, workflows, and product requirements that let software take on the repetitive parts, with engineers in control. What We're Looking For 7+ years at a large scale EPC, PMC, owner-operator, or OEM, with most of it on power generation or gas-to-power Direct experience on combined cycle, simple cycle, gas-to-power, LNG, or cogeneration projects (not refining or petrochem only) You've personally owned mechanical equipment datasheet development and vendor package review through FEED Strong on rotating and power-plant equipment: gas turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, pumps, compressors, fans, and balance of plant mechanical (cooling systems, fuel gas conditioning, water treatment) Hands-on with equipment specification to API and ASME (API 610, 611, 612, 617; ASME VIII; B31.1 power piping) Experience coordinating OEM turbine and major equipment packages (GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, Mitsubishi Power, or similar) You spot inconsistencies across datasheets, P&IDs, and vendor packages fast Clear understanding of cross-discipline dependencies You've felt boxed in by big-company process and you want out Comfortable with ambiguity and wearing multiple hats; bias to action over waiting for perfect Nice to Have Discipline lead or technical authority experience Work on data center or behind-the-meter power campuses Taking equipment from FEED into procurement and detailed engineering Packaged or modular systems and skid integration Real interest in AI and automation Who Thrives Here You've outgrown the big-firm machine. You're tired of waiting three weeks for a markup to clear four layers of review, and tired of watching good work die in a stage gate. You want to own your scope end to end, see what you build actually ship, and have a direct line to the founders and the product instead of a 12-person approval chain. At Candid you'll wear several hats and there's no playbook handing you a defined lane. If that sounds like freedom, you'll love it here. If it sounds like chaos, you won't, and that's okay. Perks Meaningful base + equity Unlimited PTO. Great work needs recharging. Health insurance covering medical, dental, and vision Up to $150/mo health and wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, and similar)

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Search & Recommendation
description: About Cantina: Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning. If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future! About the Role: Cantina is a place where people create AI characters and the videos those characters star in, and the catalog grows far faster than anyone can browse. Search and recommendations are what turn that catalog into a product: they decide which characters a new user meets in their first minute, which creators get discovered, and what appears in every feed, leaderboard, and discovery surface we ship. We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own that area end to end — retrieval, ranking, relevance quality, and the roadmap for all three. This is the first dedicated hire for search and recommendations, so you will inherit a real production system serving live traffic along with a large amount of unclaimed ground, and you will set the technical direction rather than execute someone else’s. What you'll do: Own the architecture and roadmap for search and recommendations end to end — query understanding, retrieval, ranking, and the surfaces they feed: search, discovery, the home feed, and our trending and creator leaderboards. Make relevance a measured discipline rather than an opinion: define the quality metrics per surface, build the offline evaluation and golden-set tooling, and run the online experiments that decide whether a ranking change ships. Design and evolve the ranking stack — engagement signal pipelines, decay and freshness models, and the pattern we use to combine pre-computed index-time signals with live re-ranking at query time. Own OpenSearch in production: index and mapping design, reindex and cutover safety, query performance, cost, and the operational headroom of the clusters behind every discovery surface. Build candidate generation and personalization for recommendation surfaces, and partner with data and ML on the feature pipelines and models behind them. Work directly with Product and Trust & Safety on what “good” means for each surface — quality gates, cold-start behavior for brand-new creators and characters, and what must never be recommended. Set the engineering standard for the area: instrumentation, flag-gated rollouts, and runbooks that let other teams change ranking behavior without breaking it. Act as the technical point of contact for discovery across backend teams, and mentor the engineers whose work touches it. What you'll bring: 10+ years building production software, with substantial depth in search, ranking, recommendations, or ML-driven relevance on a consumer-scale product. Hands-on expertise with a production search engine — OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Lucene, Vespa, or similar — covering index and analyzer design, relevance tuning, and operating the cluster, not only querying it. A rigorous approach to relevance measurement: you have owned offline evaluation, golden sets, and A/B or interleaving frameworks, and you can explain what moved a metric and why. Fluency across the recommender stack — candidate generation, feature pipelines, embedding retrieval, re-ranking — and a working understanding of the serving constraints that make an offline win fail online. Strong distributed systems and backend fundamentals, with production experience in Go or a comparable systems language, and comfort in the data layer behind it (SQL warehouses, streaming and batch pipelines). Demonstrated ownership of an ambiguous area: you have picked up something with no dedicated owner, decided what mattered, and can show the result. Clear written communication and the judgment to work with Product on real tradeoffs between relevance, freshness, safety, and latency. Preferred: experience with AI-generated or rapidly growing content catalogs, severe cold-start conditions, or ranking under trust-and-safety constraints. Compensation: The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is between $250,000 - $320,000 (USD). When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data. Benefits: Competitive salary and generous company equity Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina 42 days of paid time off, including: 15 PTO days 10 sick days 15 company holidays 2 floating holidays Generous parental leave & fertility support 401(k) retirement savings plan Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees One Medical membership, and more!

As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll be working in a fast moving environment, building and iterating on our financial crime defensive capabilities to ensure we keep Monzo and our customers safe.</p> <p>Our financial crime team has a large impact on Monzo’s bottom line as fraud and scams are usually some of the largest cost line items in a bank's P&L. We have a major influence on the overall customer experience and it’s our duty to keep our customers safe. The work we do results in directly measurable customer or company benefit, which is incredibly satisfying.</p> <p>Our Machine Learning Scientists work on a range of problems within the different financial crime areas ranging from fraud detection and prevention, transaction monitoring for different types of suspicious activity through to customer risk assessment and operational tooling.</p> <h1>What you’ll be working on:</h1> <p>A Lead Machine Learning Scientist at Monzo is a technical Individual Contributor (IC) leadership position. You’ll also be a technical leader within the Machine Learning discipline, helping to steer technical work and drive up standards.</p> <p>This will involve:</p> <ul> <li>Working with stakeholders across the organization to identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities to tackle Financial Crime and Fraud with Machine Learning.</li> <li>Leading the design and development of advanced real time Machine Learning models, for example exploring how neural network, graph-based, and sequence-based architectures can drive improvements in detection of financial crime.</li> <li>Providing technical leadership to drive up levels of technical expertise and best practice across the Machine Learning discipline, leading by example and mentoring others.</li> <li>Working closely with our MLOps team to steer the ongoing development of tools to enable rapid iteration of models and optimisations of the full ML model lifecycle.</li> </ul> <h1>You should apply if:</h1> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems preferably in a fast moving tech company</li> <li>You have experience developing and shipping deep learning, graph-based, and/or sequence-based ML architectures to production and delivering business impact</li> <li>You're impact driven and excited to own the end to end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>Reducing financial crime and protecting customers with data driven strategies sounds exciting to you</li> <li>You have extensive experience writing production Python code and a strong command of SQL. You are comfortable using them every day, and keen to learn <a href="https://go.dev/">Go lang</a> which is used in many of our backend microservices</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity</li> <li>You want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>You're excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain</li> <li>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas</li> </ul> <h1>Nice to haves:</h1> <ul> <li>Experience working with financial crime and in regulated institutions</li> <li>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices</li> </ul> <h1>The interview process:</h1> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. title: Treasury Lead
location: London or remote within the UK
description: About Griffin Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences. We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more. We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies. Learn more about what we do Our culture We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible. We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers. Learn more about our culture. The Team Our vision is that our Finance team plays a central part of the business, somewhere the Board can rely on to support strategic planning. In this our treasury team keeps us safely funded and liquid and gives the Board and ALCO numbers they can trust. As we add products and markets, the team is growing. As second hire to the team, you’ll report directly to our Treasurer, sitting at the heart of how we capture, report, analyse and manage risk to support how we optimise Griffin’s balance sheet. The opportunity Treasury at a fintech bank is different. You’ll see real-time payment flows and deposit behaviour that a conventional bank never sees. You’ll work directly with our Treasurer to build our treasury processes, reporting and systems rather than inherit them. You’ll contribute to management of liquidity as a Direct FPS participant, use of facilities within the Bank of England’s Sterling Monetary Framework (SMF), card issuing and stablecoin infrastructure. What success looks like By month 3, you’ll understand our business and processes, run daily reporting with Michael’s review and handle daily cash positioning, including our Bank of England reserve account. By month 6, you’ll own daily and monthly reporting and run intraday cash management independently, including testing the SMF. You’ll have drafted ALCO papers and credit reviews, delivered your first automation improvements and contributed to the impact assessment for Direct FPS or a similar product launch. To do this you’ll own Daily and intraday reporting on liquidity, capital, interest rate risk, funding capacity and asset encumbrance, with every output sense-checked before it goes out Risk monitoring against our risk appetite: limits, triggers and early warning indicators, forecast-versus-actual reviews, and stress tests you design with the Treasurer Intraday cash management and liquidity forecasting: cash positioning, payments and transfers, depositor behaviour and outflow assumptions Monthly management reporting, including interest income, margin and customer profitability, the ALCO pack, inputs to regulatory returns, and contributions to the ILAAP and ICAAP Dealing operations: pre- and post-trade checks, confirmations, settlements and collateral movements, plus credit analysis on counterparties and issuers. You’ll also cover for the Treasurer with brokers, treasury bill auctions and SMF drawdowns Automating manual steps, closing control gaps, and documenting procedures that mean knowledge never sits with just two people Maintaining our treasury bank and broker mandates We expect you to shape this role This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are. Your background To succeed in the role, we're looking for people who have: 5+ years in a bank treasury function (e.g. middle-office, ALM or balance sheet management), measuring and reporting liquidity and capital from economic and regulatory perspectives. You will have produced reports hands-on rather than reviewed them Strong prudential knowledge across liquidity, capital and leverage (e.g. CRR, Basel III, LCR, NSFR, IRRBB, ILAAP, ICAAP), and hands-on exposure to the dealing lifecycle: pre- and post-trade checks, confirmations and settlements Advanced Excel skills (e.g. data tables, scenario analysis, VBA), plus the attention to detail and reconciliation discipline to sense-check everything you produce An analytical, inquisitive mindset, with a habit of automating what’s manual The organisation and drive to work autonomously, remotely and asynchronously, and the appetite for the breadth and ambiguity of building in an early-stage bank A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write ) Ideally, you would also: Hold a treasury or accountancy qualification (ACT, CertBALM, FRM, CFA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA) Bring Python, SQL, Power BI or AI skills Knowledge of Direct FPS and Bank of England SMF facilities Experience implementing or using treasury or ALM systems What can we offer you? Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year Time off: 28 days’ holiday + bank holidays Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment. As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks. How long will the process take? We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other. Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience. Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements. Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin. Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview. Step 5 : Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here . How do I apply? Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next. We don’t work with recruitment agencies, so please don’t send us speculative CVs. Under representation At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Information Security
description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity 🚀 Carrot is looking for a Director, Information Security to lead the security program that protects the highly sensitive fertility and family-building data of members around the world. You will set the security strategy, own both corporate security (GRC, incident response, security awareness, vendor risk) and product security (application, cloud and infrastructure security, secure development lifecycle), and serve as the trusted voice on Carrot's security posture with executives, auditors, and enterprise customers. Day to day, you will balance setting direction with staying close to the work: prioritizing risk with Engineering and IT, guiding audit and certification cycles, coaching a small and talented team, and joining customer conversations where security is part of the buying decision. Carrot has already earned SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, HITRUST, and PCI DSS compliance, so this role is about taking a strong foundation to the next level of maturity, not starting from scratch. What makes this role different is the combination of stakes and influence. Few security leaders get to protect data this personal, at global scale, while working directly with executive leadership and shaping how a health platform is built, sold, and trusted. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Lead Carrot's security strategy and roadmap, using a recognized maturity model (such as C2M2 or NIST CSF) to prioritize investments and report progress to executive leadership Own the full security program across corporate security (GRC, incident management, security awareness, third-party risk) and product security (application security, cloud and infrastructure security, secure SDLC) Partner with Engineering, especially the Internal Platform team, to build security into how Carrot designs, ships, and operates its systems, going beyond compliance Lead internal risk assessments across application, cloud, and corporate environments and turn the results into prioritized technical safeguards Own the compliance portfolio, including SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and HIPAA, and prepare Carrot for additional frameworks such as ISO 27001 as the business requires Direct incident response readiness, including playbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication, and post-incident learning Represent Carrot's security posture to employers, health plans, and health systems through security reviews, questionnaires, and strategic sales conversations Work with Legal and Privacy to meet global data protection requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) for member health data Build, coach, and grow the security team, balancing hands-on execution with delegation as the team scales Manage the security budget, tooling, and vendor relationships, and tailor security guidance for a remote-first workforce and physical offices What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: A documented, executive-endorsed security strategy and multi-year roadmap with clear priorities, owners, and measures of progress Clean outcomes on recurring audits and certifications (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS), with remediation items closed on schedule A tested incident response program, with regular tabletop exercises completed and lessons learned built back into the program A measurable reduction in high-risk vulnerabilities and open security findings, with remediation timelines agreed on with Engineering A living risk register and vendor security review process that leaders rely on to make decisions A security team with defined roles, clear growth paths, and the right capacity for Carrot's growth, including key hires made Faster, more consistent security reviews for Sales and Customer Success, with fewer escalations from enterprise customers A clear plan, and visible progress, on any additional frameworks the business prioritizes, such as ISO 27001 About You ✨ You likely have: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience) 10+ years of experience in technology, including 5+ years in information security and at least 3 years leading security teams A security certification such as CISSP or CISM Experience leading the security function at a late-stage startup, scale-up, or public company Working depth in healthcare data protection and privacy frameworks, including HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA Experience overseeing enterprise frameworks and audits such as SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001 Strong knowledge of application, network, and cloud security (AWS and Azure) and frameworks such as NIST CSF and OWASP Experience running core security programs, including incident response, risk management, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security awareness Executive-level communication skills and confidence engaging customers and sales teams on security requirements Experience managing budget and allocating resources across people, tools, and vendors Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience leading security through a major company event such as an IPO, acquisition, or large-scale audit cycle A background in healthcare, digital health, or another highly regulated, high-trust environment Experience leading security in a remote-first, globally distributed company Familiarity with compliance automation platforms such as Drata Experience building a security engineering practice alongside platform and infrastructure teams Why This Role Matters 🧡 Members trust Carrot with some of the most personal information a person can share, often during some of the most meaningful moments of their lives. Protecting that trust is not a back-office function. It is what allows employers, health plans, and health systems to bring Carrot to millions of people worldwide. As Carrot grows, security leadership shapes how we build, how we sell, and how we show up for customers. In this role, you will make security a strength that members and customers can see and rely on, and build a team that keeps raising the bar as the business scales. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation: Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $188,000.00 - $245,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

title: Cloud Native Architect, Strategic Accounts (EMEA)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p> <p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Position Overview</strong></h3> <p>As a member of the World Wide Strategic Accounts field team, the Cloud Native Architect (CNA) is a senior technologist who owns the <strong>technical sales strategy, evaluation program, and architectural vision</strong> creating repeatable business with software opportunities with the company’s largest multinational customers. You will guide C‑level and engineering stakeholders through solution discovery, validation, and financial justification, ensuring every engagement results in a <em>technical win</em> and a clear path to enterprise‑wide adoption that delivers the customers business outcomes aligned to the project. Driving Everpure as the standard solution for delivering data-management in the WWSA Segment. Creating market penetration strategy and thought leadership across the entire theater/segment.</p> <p>The role of a Cloud Native Architect (CNA) is a multifaceted position that serves as a technical bridge between the sales, product, and engineering teams. This role is important for driving revenue growth and enhancing customer relationships by providing technical solutions for a specific set of accounts. Primarily focused on the pre-sales process, the individual in this role will engage with potential and existing customers to understand their business issues and technical hurdles related to Kubernetes. They will deliver tailored product demonstrations, respond to technical inquiries, and work with the Everpure technical field to architect solutions that integrate Everpure offerings with clients' software driven platforms. The responsibilities of the Cloud Native Architect will fall into (5) categories:</p> <ul> <li>Participation in Lead Generation</li> <li>Technical Qualification</li> <li>Solution Validation</li> Process to provide the best possible customer experience.</p> <h3><strong>Role Scope</strong></h3> <p><strong>Theater:</strong> Strategics (EMEA)</p> <p><strong>Builds and leads:</strong> CNA team accountability.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Focus Areas & Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ol> <li><strong>Technical Sales Leadership</strong></li> <ul> <li>Lead the full Cloud Native technical sales description: Location : 100% remote (EMEA) Classification : Full-time Pay Range : 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful! As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations! What you’ll work on : We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers. What’s unique about management at Miaplaza: Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice: You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which: 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which: 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred) 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level. Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD) Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems What makes you stand out: Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration Experience with consumer platforms at scale Experience building in regulated environments Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ) Experience with Istio or other service meshes Responsibilities Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example. Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs Our hiring process As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us. Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update. Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role. Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far. 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work. Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them. Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership. Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports. Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law. We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder. Compensation and setup The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area. Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know. As a Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and execute tier 1 field events that drive pipeline and contribute meaningfully to Notion’s business. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. title: Career Program Participant (m/w/d) – Exklusive Beta-Phase für Professionals
description: Wir sind Alvra Labs , ein Venture Studio mit Sitz in Basel. Wir entwickeln digitale Produkte und Ventures im Bereich KI und Zukunftstechnologien, die Menschen mehr Zeit, Wahlfreiheit und berufliche Selbstbestimmung ermöglichen. Das Problem & unser neuer Ansatz Der Arbeitsmarkt hat ein massives Matching-Problem: Qualifizierte Professionals schicken CVs an anonyme Portale, während Unternehmen nach genau diesen Talenten suchen – und sie im Rauschen nicht finden. Aus unserem Venture Studio heraus entwickeln wir aktuell ein neues Venture für inverses Headhunting : Ein persönlicher Career Coach arbeitet exklusiv auf deiner Seite, erkennt dein Potenzial jenseits des Lebenslaufs und vertritt dich aktiv im Markt. Für unsere geschlossene Beta-Phase wählen wir gezielt eine handvoll qualifizierter Persönlichkeiten aus, die diesen Ansatz gemeinsam mit uns testen. Was wir gemeinsam einsetzen Potenzial-Assessment & 360°-Sicht: Strukturierte Analyse deiner Stärken – ergänzt durch optionales Feedback ehemaliger Kollegen, um dein Profil über den CV hinaus greifbar zu machen. Inverses Headhunting: Dein Coach sucht aktiv nach passenden Positionen und bewirbt dein Profil gezielt im Markt. Bewerbungs-Support & Warm Intros: Je nach Situation unterstützen wir dich direkt im Bewerbungsprozess oder nutzen unser Netzwerk für persönliche Vorstellungen (Warm Intros) bei relevanten Unternehmen. Beta-Feedback: Du testest den Prozess in der Praxis und gibst uns direktes Feedback zur Weiterentwicklung. Wen wir suchen 3 bis 12 Jahre Berufserfahrung (Mid-Career) sowie ein Hochschulabschluss oder vergleichbarer Leistungsausweis. Klarer Anspruch an den nächsten Karriereschritt und Offenheit für einen neuen Recruiting-Ansatz. Rahmenbedingungen Kostenloser Zugang: Ausgewählte Teilnehmer der Beta-Kohorte erhalten kostenlosen Zugang zur Plattform und zur Begleitung durch unsere Coaches. 100 % Remote & Diskretion: Volle Kontrolle darüber, welche Features genutzt werden und wem dein Profil vorgestellt wird.
