You'll help make that happen on GitLab.com by improving how Hosted Runners provision compute, isolate customer workloads, and recover from failures. Your decisions will shape how long customers wait for jobs to start and how efficiently GitLab uses cloud compute.</p> <p class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed mb-2">As a Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you'll set technical direction across teams while continuing to write and operate production software in Go. You'll lead work across the runner control plane, worker provisioning, and job execution. Your primary focus will be GitLab.com, and you'll also provide technical leadership support for GitLab Dedicated Hosted Runners. You'll report to the engineering manager responsible for Hosted Runners.</p> <div class="text-[15px] mb-1 font-semibold"><strong>Some examples of our projects:</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Tuning autoscaling to reduce job wait times during demand spikes</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Evaluating ways to isolate customer workloads</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Improving how runner usage is measured for capacity planning and billing</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Lead architecture and delivery across teams. Plan migrations with representative workload tests, safe capacity handovers, and rollback paths.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Write, review, and ship Go code across GitLab Runner, autoscaling components, cloud integrations, and operational tooling.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Improve reliability from job pickup through cleanup. Join the Runners Platform on-call rotation, investigate failures across system layers, and verify fixes in production.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Work with Security and Runner engineers to evaluate workload isolation, balancing security and compatibility with performance and cost.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Build observability that connects the customer experience with fleet behavior and guides capacity decisions. Partner with Finance, Product, and the billing platform team on usage metering and cost attribution.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Reduce recurring operational work through automation, tooling, and runbooks that engineers can use independently.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Mentor experienced engineers through design, implementation, and operations. Clarify ownership across teams and help engineers validate AI-assisted changes before they reach production.</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Recent hands-on experience building and operating production systems software such as controllers, agents, or schedulers. title: Senior Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Meet Yubico</strong></h3> <p>Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.</p> <p><strong>Why Join Our Mission?</strong></p> <p>At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of <em>Speed with Integrity</em>, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Battle Friction:</strong> We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.</li> <li><strong>Inspire Higher:</strong> We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.</li> <li><strong>One Team:</strong> We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.</li> </ul> <p>Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the<a href="https://developers.yubico.com/"> Yubico Developer Program</a>, offering free<a href="https://developers.yubico.com/Software_Projects/"> open-source repositories</a>, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our <a href="https://www.yubico.com/why-yubico/secure-it-forward/"><em>Secure it Forward</em></a> program.</p></div><p><strong>At Yubico, we offer:</strong></p> <p><strong>Yubico Values: </strong>We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work <a href="https://www.yubico.com/why-yubico/secure-it-forward/">here</a>).</p> <p><strong>Social Connection:</strong> Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/yubico/life/17456342-be9b-4b35-b561-9ea3e892e9cc/"> Life at Yubico Page</a> on LinkedIn and our awards<a href="https://www.yubico.com/about/awards/"> here</a><strong>.</strong></p> <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products  from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms.</p> <p>Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries & Apps.</p> <p>This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio</p> <h2><strong>Tasks & Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership:</strong> Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for our foundational tools, libraries, and applications, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and customer needs.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner deeply across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Security teams to design high-impact capabilities that enhance product foundations that underlie efficiency and scalability of our solutions.</li> <li><strong>Customer focus</strong>: Meet with customers to understand market demand and outcomes for new products</li> <li><strong>Requirements Definition:</strong> Translate complex workflows and software requirements into clear, high-quality product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories.</li> <li><strong>Technical Partnership & Conflict Resolution:</strong> Serve as the strategic unifier in cross-functional technical decisions. Actively synthesize competing priorities between product vision and architectural necessity, ensuring trade-offs are documented, data-backed, and optimized for long-term reliability.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven Insights</strong>: Provide data-driven insights on the specific products being managed, including sales and financial performance, year-over-year trends, pipeline, etc.</li> <li><strong>Full life cycle management: </strong>Manage the full life-cycle of a product from inception to end of life including: conception, market and requirements gathering, customer validation, creation of high-quality requirements document, management of engineering, marketing preparation, release and end-of-life processes</li> <li><strong>Security & Compliance Management:</strong> Collaborate with security and engineering teams to ensure software systems seamlessly integrate with critical cryptographic infrastructure (such as PKI and HSMs) while maintaining Yubico's gold standard of security.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 10+ years of progressively broadening product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping complex, enterprise-class hardware & manufacturing solutions.</li> <li><strong>Domain Expertise:</strong> Proven experience in technical product management including development of large-scale internal tools.</li> <li><strong>Leadership & Acumen:</strong> Proven ability to act as a constructive challenger to highly technical engineering partners. title: Customer Success Manager - Key
description: About SugarAI SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI. We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next. More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference. Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done. If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you. Impact You Will Make in the Role Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within client accounts. Act as a trusted advisor to guide clients in leveraging our CX platform for maximum impact, ensuring long-term satisfaction and value realization. Account Ownership & Renewals: Own the entire post-sale lifecycle for assigned accounts, including ensuring timely contract renewals, driving retention strategies, and mitigating churn risks. Growth Opportunities: Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling across existing client portfolios. Leverage deep knowledge of clients’ business needs and our product offerings to provide tailored solutions. Data-Driven Decision Making: Use client data and analytics to track account health, uncover opportunities, and tailor strategies that maximize customer success. Monitor key success metrics (e.g., adoption rates, usage patterns) to proactively address potential challenges and maximize renewal probability. Collaboration & Networking: Work cross-functionally with sales, product, and support teams to address customer needs and deliver exceptional service. Identify new contacts and departments within existing accounts to expand product adoption and customer footprint. Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer within the company. Gather feedback and communicate customer needs and insights across product, sales, and marketing teams to help guide the direction of product development and marketing strategies. What You Will Bring Proven Track Record: 4-7 years of experience in customer success, account management, or client-facing sales roles with direct responsibility for renewals, retention, and expansion within a SaaS B2B environment. Experience working with reseller partners is desired. Customer-Centric Mindset: Demonstrated ability to build long-lasting relationships with clients, anticipating needs and providing value-added solutions. Comfort working in a consultative manner to advise on business process improvements through technology, a deep understanding of customer pain points, and the ability to navigate complex client relationships. Revenue Growth Expertise: Success in identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, with a clear understanding of how to leverage customer relationships to drive revenue growth and meet KPIs. Communication Excellence: Ability to communicate effectively across all levels of an organization, including C-suite executives, both verbally and in writing. You should be clear, concise, and persuasive in your approach. Resilience & Motivation: Demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and consistently delivering results while maintaining a positive, proactive attitude. Team Collaboration: You excel in team settings, working cross-functionally to ensure clients receive a seamless experience. You contribute to the broader team success and offer insight into best practices for customer engagement. Fluent in German and English. Fluency in Spanish language will be a plus. Our Approach to Hiring We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support our recruiting process, including scheduling, candidate search, prioritization. AI does not make hiring decisions or automatically reject candidates; those decisions are made by people at SugarAI. title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results. The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic. About the Role Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline. We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live. What You'll Do Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them. Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers. Write and integrate C2 and onboard autonomy software for unmanned air and sea vehicles, and debug it in the field when something breaks. Participate in and lead design reviews for your initiatives before work starts. Run post-incident reviews after field issues, find the root cause, and put fixes in place so the same problem does not happen again. Bring field data and lessons learned back to the core product team. Work with partner teams to align on priorities and timelines, gather their feedback, and run internal testing before every deployment. Plan how your initiatives fit into each contract release alongside core product work, and make sure they are tested and ready before the release ships. Serve as the main technical contact for vehicle and sensor vendors, and lead the integration of their systems with ours. Define success criteria with customers for each event, run the readiness review for your initiatives beforehand, and give the go/no-go recommendation. Mentor forward deployed engineers and help with technical assessments of potential candidates. Support deployments outside normal hours, including on-call response and rotational coverage aligned to mission tempo. Travel domestically and internationally (up to 50%) to test sites and customer locations, and lead the team on site. This Role Is For You If You have shipped software to the field and want to own a bigger share of the outcome. You like making technical calls under pressure and explaining them to people who need a straight answer. You enjoy helping other engineers grow while staying hands-on yourself. You can turn an ambiguous customer request into a plan a team can execute. This Role Is NOT A people management role away from the code A program or project management role A pilot position or vehicle operator role Primarily hands-on hardware work (electronics, wiring, mechanical assembly) Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability Experience leading a small team, feature crew, or sub-program through design and delivery Experience building and deploying software for unmanned systems (UAS, USVs, or UUVs), including C2 or onboard autonomy Experience working directly with government or military customers to turn mission needs into technical requirements Experience supporting live exercises, test events, or field deployments Experience shipping work as part of larger releases that combine contributions from several teams Strong proficiency in at least one systems language (Golang, Rust, or C/C++) Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: NAT, DNS/mDNS, UDP/TCP protocols, multicast, and firewall configuration Experience with Linux system administration and shell scripting Excellent communication skills for engaging with U.S. government and military customers, vendors, and internal engineering teams Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time, both domestically and internationally, including to remote or restricted-access locations Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance Preferred Qualifications Active U.S. Secret security clearance or higher Prior defense, intelligence community, or aerospace software experience, especially with the U.S. Navy Experience integrating C2 or autonomy software onto third-party vehicles Familiarity with unmanned systems and C2 interoperability standards (UMAA, MAVLink, STANAG 4586, OMS, UCI, or A-GRA) Background in multi-vehicle C2, track management, sensor fusion, or sensor-to-shooter software Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code Experience with robotics middleware (DDS/ROS2, ZeroMQ, gRPC) and Protobuf Comfort operating in non-permissive or resource-constrained environments ITAR requirement To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability. What We Offer Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company Competitive base salary commensurate with experience Medical, dental, vision, and 401k PTO and paid sick leave Monthly wellness stipend Daily catered lunch (office) Paid parental leave Direct impact on a critical national security mission A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems Compensation: $220K – $300K • Offers Equity • $220K – $300K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager – AI
description: Job Title: Engineering Manager – AI Reports to: Head of Engineering Location: UK / Europe Company Overview: Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments. We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software. As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed. About the Role As an Engineering Manager, you lead a team building and operating core parts of Radiant's cloud platform. You combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership and cross-functional collaboration. You work closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security and other engineering teams. This is a hands-on leadership role. It focuses on building strong teams, delivering reliable platform capabilities, and creating an environment where engineers do their best work. What You'll Do As an Engineering Manager – AI, you will lead a team building and operating the platforms customers use to train and serve AI models on our GPU infrastructure, joining one of our AI teams: MLOps Training or MLOps Inference. We hire strong managers first, then agree your team with you based on your strengths and interests. You'll combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership, and cross-functional collaboration, working closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security, and other engineering teams. Each team has around nine engineers: principal, senior and mid-level software engineers, an SDET, a DevOps engineer, and a platform engineer.Your first team is a starting point, and moves between teams are normal here. Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows: Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security AI: Training & Inference Key Responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a team of around nine engineers across software, platform, DevOps, and test. Own delivery end to end: planning, prioritisation, quality, and operational readiness. Partner with Product to turn priorities into clear technical plans and achievable milestones. Provide technical leadership on architecture, reliability, scalability, and engineering trade-offs. Set strong engineering practices for design, testing, observability, documentation, and incident learning. Hire, onboard, and retain high-performing engineers. Hiring is a large part of the first year: expect around two hours a day on it. Support career development through regular feedback, coaching, and progression planning. Bring AI-assisted engineering into daily work, within our guardrails. Your Profile Experience leading engineering teams building cloud platforms, infrastructure, developer tooling, or distributed systems. Proven experience in people management, hiring, coaching, and performance development. A strong technical background: you engage credibly in architecture and design discussions. A good understanding of: Cloud infrastructure: compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes, containers Platform engineering: APIs, automation, IAM, observability, reliability Distributed systems: scaling, consistency, failure handling Engineering operations: incident response, capacity, performance, production ownership Strong delivery and prioritisation skills across competing priorities. Comfortable working closely with product and other engineering leaders in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Experience with GPU, HPC, or AI infrastructure is a bonus. Nobody has depth in every area above: tell us which you know and which you want to learn. What You Bring People leadership: Build strong teams and help engineers grow. Technical judgement: Challenge designs and guide trade-offs without owning every implementation detail. Execution: Create clarity and drive complex work to completion. Systems thinking: Understand how platform components and teams fit together. Operational mindset: Care about reliability, maintainability, and production quality. Ownership: Take responsibility for both team health and engineering outcomes. Curiosity: Learn new domains fast. GPUs, networks, and storage excite you rather than worry you. Builder mindset: Much here is not built yet, and you enjoy creating the process, not just running it. Qualities we look for: Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same. Why should you join us? What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive. Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us: 25 days of annual leave A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work. Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together. Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job. Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa. Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work. Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps Participation in the company shares program Enhanced parental pay & leave Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (Principal Engineer and Engineering Lead) → Final. title: Fullstack Engineer, Source Code: Repository Services (Ruby)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><div><strong>About the role</strong><br>We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Repository Services team in GitLab's Create stage. We build this as an access layer on the primitives the Gitaly team provides, for GitLab's own features and for the artificial intelligence agents now writing and pushing code alongside people.<br>You'll work in one of GitLab's oldest and most complex product areas, using Ruby and GraphQL across <a href="http://GitLab.com" target="_blank">GitLab.com</a>, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Repository Services is a new team, and its first months are about reliability and support, so you'll spend real time on performance and structured query language tuning, caching, rate limiting, testing, observability, and resiliency, with experienced team members to lean on. You'll collaborate with product management, product design, testing, security, user experience research, technical writing, Gitaly, Code Review, and the other Source Code teams.<br><br><strong>What you'll do</strong></div> <ul> <li>Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby and GraphQL.</li> <li>Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.</li> <li>Design and maintain backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic that control how code reaches a repository, who may change it, and how it is verified.</li> <li>Build on the primitives Gitaly provides and work closely with the Gitaly team.</li> <li>Triage and fix bugs and support requests for the features the team owns.</li> <li>Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.</li> <li>Use artificial intelligence agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.</li> <li>Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.</li> <li>Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.</li> <li>Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <div><strong>What you'll bring</strong></div> <ul> <li>Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.</li> <li>An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.</li> <li>Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems.</li> <li>Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.</li> <li>Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.</li> </ul> <div><br><strong>About the team</strong><br>Repository Services is a small backend team in the Create stage, formed in September 2026 when Source Code split into focused teams. As the split is finalized we expect to own repository mirroring, Git Large File Storage (LFS), protected branches and Branch Rules, push rules, Code Owners (shared with Code Review), and commit and tag signing. title: PR Manager:in (m/w/d)
description: hypr schafft Aufmerksamkeit für inspirierende Personen und Unternehmen. Wir geben Visionär:innen eine Stimme und schaffen Aufmerksamkeit für ihre Unternehmen, Ideen, Geschichten und Ziele. Wir verstehen uns nicht als verlängerte Werkbank, sondern als Partner:innen auf Augenhöhe, die mitdenken, beraten und Impulse geben. Wir treiben Innovation voran. Unsere Spezialität: Personenzentrierte Kommunikation. Denn es sind immer Menschen, die ein Unternehmen oder ein Produkt erlebbar machen und begeistern. Standort: deutschlandweit (Wohnsitz in Deutschland erforderlich) Deine Aufgaben Du gibst Visionär:innen eine Stimme: Du berätst und unterstützt Personen und Unternehmen der Digitalbranche sicher auf Deutsch in Sachen Public Relations, vor allem hinsichtlich CEO-/Executive-Kommunikation als Teil der Corporate Communications. Du verantwortest das Partner:innen- und Projektmanagement von zunächst drei Auftraggebenden und arbeitest vertrauensvoll mit inspirierenden Gründer:innen, dem C-Level und Entscheider:innen zusammen. Unsere Auftraggebenden nennen wir bewusst Partner:innen, da wir auf Augenhöhe arbeiten. Du übernimmst die Konzeption, Durchführung und Moderation von Strategie-Workshops. Du erarbeitest personenzentrierte Kommunikationsstrategien sowie Positionierungsideen und verantwortest deren Umsetzung. Du entwickelst Narrative und Pitches für unterschiedliche Medien und Journalist:innen - zugeschnitten auf ihre Interessen, Formate und Zielgruppen. Du schreibst unterschiedliche für PR und Journalismus relevante Texte, z. B. Gastbeiträge, Interviews, LinkedIn-Posts und Redebeiträge. Du weißt, was sich in Sachen Digitalisierung aktuell bewegt, und verfolgst den Markt sowie mediale Debatten mit Blick auf die Themen unserer Partner:innen. Dein Profil Du bringst Erfahrung in PR, Journalismus oder Kommunikation mit. Nicht die Anzahl deiner Berufsjahre ist für uns entscheidend, sondern wie du sie genutzt hast: Für uns zählt, dass du Kommunikation als strategisches Werkzeug verstehst, Verantwortung übernimmst und aktiv berätst. Erfahrung hilft, aber Haltung, Drive und Lernfähigkeit sind für uns ausschlaggebend. Du hast eine Leidenschaft für digitale Kommunikation und gute Geschichten: Du kannst Narrative erarbeiten und sie handwerklich präzise kommunizieren. Zudem kennst du die Mechanismen der Medienbranche und Social-Media-Plattformen. Du bist neugierig, stellst die richtigen Fragen und hast ein starkes Interesse an digitalen Geschäftsmodellen sowie Start-ups. Du bist ambitioniert, agil, mutig, selbstbewusst, beweist Willensstärke und hast Freude daran, auf Augenhöhe zu beraten. Denn unsere Partner:innen erwarten proaktive Impulse, Sparring und an den richtigen Stellen auch mal ein klares Nein. Du hast ein Growth-Mindset und möchtest dich fachlich wie persönlich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Du bist selbstreflektiert, gibst aktiv und konstruktiv Feedback und nimmst es genauso an. Der Teamgedanke ist dir wichtig und du hast Lust, Teil eines leistungsstarken Teams zu sein. Du bringst dich aktiv ein, teilst Erfahrungen und Learnings und arbeitest empathisch mit anderen zusammen. Du kannst dich sehr gut selbst organisieren, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und möchtest in einem Remote-First-Set-up arbeiten. Dein Lebenslauf schreit nicht PR, Journalismus oder Kommunikation? Kein Problem. Bitte nutze das Anschreiben dazu, um uns kurz zu verraten, was dich an PR, der Rolle und hypr begeistert. Das hilft uns, deine Motivation und deinen Drive besser einzuordnen. Abhängig von Erfahrung und Potenzial bieten wir ein Gehalt zwischen 49k und 57k brutto pro Jahr bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche, inklusive Umsatzbeteiligung. Wir arbeiten mit Gehaltsbändern, sodass du dir sicher sein kannst, ein attraktives und zugleich faires Gehalt zu bekommen. Unser Angebot Arbeit und Privatleben: Full-Remote und flexibles Arbeiten sind bei uns nicht nur inhaltsleere Buzzwords, sondern gelebte Realität. Seit der Gründung 2017 arbeitet bei uns jede:r dort und so, wie es am besten in das eigene Leben passt. Eine 40-, 35- oder mindestens 32-Stunden-Woche – wir können über alles reden. Dezentrales Team: hypr ist eine dezentrale Agentur. Wir haben zwar ein kleines Büro in Berlin, aber niemand muss von dort aus arbeiten. Das bedeutet noch lange nicht, dass wir Einsiedler:innen sind. Im Gegenteil: Alle Kolleg:innen sind durch zahlreiche Tools digital miteinander vernetzt, und auch das Zwischenmenschliche kommt dank Team-Offsites, hypr School, digitaler Coffee-Dates & Co. nicht zu kurz. Remote Work aus dem Ausland: Arbeite bis zu 183 Tage pro Jahr im Europäischen Währungsraum. Exzellentes Team: Das Team besteht aus Expert:innen und hellen Köpfen. Wir haben gleichermaßen langjährige Erfahrung aus globalen Digitalunternehmen oder Agenturen wie auch junge Talente in unseren Reihen. Tatsächlich zählen fünf unserer Kolleg:innen zu den #30u30-Talenten der PR-Branche. Growth Mindset: Wir glauben daran, dass tägliches Lernen der Schlüssel zum Erfolg ist. Wir leben Feedback, täglich und aufrichtig. Wir verlassen unsere Komfortzone und sind davon überzeugt, dass wir jeden Tag ein Prozent besser werden können. Weiterbildung: Wir fördern dich mit einem Entwicklungsplan und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen, die genau auf dich zugeschnitten sind. Über das Jahr verteilt führen wir sechs Entwicklungs- und Feedbackgespräche, im Zuge derer wir uns Ziele für die fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung setzen und einander bei der Umsetzung unterstützen. hypr Events und Offsites: Ein digitales Event pro Monat. Jeden Monat nehmen wir uns Zeit als Team, um entweder einen spannenden Gast für ein Q&A einzuladen, in einem „Connecting the Dots“ über Themen zu sprechen, in denen wir als Team besser werden wollen, oder in einer hypr School Dinge beleuchten, über die wir noch mehr wissen wollen. Das absolute Highlight sind unsere Offsites, bei denen wir als Team in Person zusammenkommen und drei Tage lang gemeinsam Zeit verbringen. Hiervon haben wir zwei bis drei pro Jahr. Coworking oder Home-Office Ausstattung: Du bekommst von uns alles, was du zum Arbeiten brauchst. Du wählst die Ausstattung für dein Home-Office (höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch, Bürostuhl, Bildschirm etc.) oder wir übernehmen die Kosten für einen Coworking Space. Sonderurlaubstage bei speziellen Anlässen: Geburtstag, Geburt von Nachwuchs, Umzug oder Trauerfall. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Du hast die Möglichkeit, eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge bei der Allianz abzuschließen. Hypr beteiligt sich mit einem Zuschuss von 15 % des umgewandelten Entgelts. Corporate Benefits: 1.000 Rabattaktionen rund ums Reisen, Mode, Technik, Freizeit u.v.m., sowie monatlich 10 € Zuschuss zum Whoop-Abo. Der Bewerbungsprozess Macht uns deine Bewerbung neugierig, bitten wir dich via WhatsApp um ein kurzes Video, in dem du fünf Fragen beantwortest. Denn: Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass Menschen so viel mehr als ihr CV oder ein LinkedIn-Profil sind. Wir suchen keine „Arbeitskräfte“, sondern echte Persönlichkeiten. Du hast durch das Video die Chance, Facetten von dir zu zeigen, die dich – jenseits von harten Fakten – besonders machen. Sei ganz du selbst, Authentizität zählt. Begeisterst du uns im Video, sprichst du mit unserer Recruiting & People Experience Managerin Johanna. Wenn uns und dir das Gespräch gefallen hat, laden wir dich dazu ein, einen kleinen Case zu bearbeiten. Der Case gibt dir einen konkreten Einblick in unsere Arbeit und zeigt uns, wie du an Themen herangehst. Den Case bearbeitest du nicht in einem Gespräch, sondern asynchron. Überzeugt uns deine Case-Bearbeitung, triffst du als nächstes unseren CEO Sachar für ein Kennenlernen und ein Q&A. Du darfst und sollst ihn gerne mit Fragen löchern! Und wenn wir auch aus diesem Gespräch mit einem guten Gefühl rausgehen, lernst du deine potenzielle Führungskraft und ein weiteres Team-Member kennen. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, freuen wir uns, dich im Team willkommen zu heißen! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: GTM Pricing & Packaging Lead, Commercial Operations
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: You’ll drive pricing and packaging for our Sales Assist business. As Sales Assist becomes a larger part of Notion’s growth, we need a deliberate approach to pricing through increasingly complex customer journeys. As Notion takes a strong product and brand further up market, you’ll shape how we connect customer value to pricing for B2B and Enterprise customers. Your days may move from a Product discussion to a CRO presentation to a systems-focused meeting, turning GTM insight into investments EPD can act on. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Establish a coherent pricing and packaging perspective for Sales Assist that connects Self Serve pricing, customer value, and the needs of B2B and Enterprise customers. - By your 90th day: - Articulate the Sales Assist pricing-and-packaging narrative and the decisions it should guide. - Deliver a preliminary 18-month pricing and packaging roadmap, grounded in expected business impact and clear prioritization. - Use AI to monitor market trends, validate proposals, and surface business shifts that could change pricing and packaging decisions. - By the end of your first year: - Lead the GTM workstream for at least one pricing or packaging initiative, from recommendation through launch and impact assessment. - Establish a repeatable market-calibration and ROI feedback loop between GTM and EPD, raising the standard for how future investments are evaluated. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Track record of leading successful launches, starting with initial ideation, operationalization, and post launch analysis that allows us to tie bets with business outcomes. - Exceptional communication, executive presence, and commercial judgment—the role requires influencing Sales, Product, EPD, and senior leadership through complex decisions. - Ability to develop pricing recommendations using quantitative analysis, customer and seller research, market signals, and pricing experiments. - Curiosity and practical AI fluency: you use AI as a collaborator to analyze signals, test assumptions, validate proposals, and make the team’s work easier to build on. - Experience with B2B SaaS & AI Product Pricing, including Enterprise Offerings. - 12+ years experience with Pricing & Packaging. thorough documentation.</li> <li value="12">Commitment to learning and growing, with a willingness to investigate questions and work through problems independently.</li> <li value="13">Transferable value="2">Prior experience at a GitLab competitor.</li> <li value="3">Intermediate-to-advanced DevOps knowledge.</li> <li value="4">Prior experience leading executive-level conversations.</li> <li value="5">Prior experience selling services.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Customer Success Management team at GitLab works with customers across regions to drive adoption of the GitLab DevSecOps platform, measure and communicate outcomes, and build long-term advocacy. You’ll model effective use of AI, lead improvements to our docs site and processes, and contribute to one of the world’s largest open-source projects while engaging with our wider community. </p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own and maintain documentation across product areas (which GitLab organizes by engineering stages and sections), driving improvements and balancing priorities.</li> <li>Champion AI best practices by modeling approved tool use, establishing governance and quality checks, and integrating AI workflows that improve efficiency and quality.</li> <li>Lead efforts to improve the product user experience through UI text, creating model examples and improving the style guide.</li> <li>Design scalable information architecture and content types optimized for both human readability and AI retrieval.</li> <li>Model review practices that improve the quality of contributions and feed back into AI review flows.</li> <li>Design and lead process improvements. Identify systemic problems and the most efficient solution, building alignment with stakeholders and driving adoption.</li> <li>Partner with engineers to translate documentation, content-quality, and user needs into improvements to documentation systems and docs-site functionality.</li> <li>Use data to prioritize work, measure impact, and establish team KPIs.</li> <li>Lead large cross-stage content initiatives, driving collaboration across functions to achieve shared customer and company outcomes.</li> <li>Address feedback from internal teams, customers, support, and community contributors, identifying patterns for wider improvements.</li> <li>Act as a thought partner to management on technical and project decisions, and act as primary lead for a specialist domain such as AI, UX writing, metrics, or tooling.</li> <li>Mentor technical writers and team members on best practices and prioritization.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>End-to-end expertise in planning, researching, writing, and editing software documentation.</li> <li>UX and content design skills, with a track record of refining interface text, labels, and naming conventions to improve the product user experience.</li> <li>Experience designing and using AI workflows, including evaluating and refining AI-generated output and guiding quality checks for others.</li> <li>Proficiency working in a docs-as-code environment, using the same workflows and tooling as engineering, operations, and product teams.</li> <li>Fluency using the Linux shell and command-line Git, coupled with general familiarity with one or more programming languages.</li> <li>Excellent grammar, minimalist documentation design skills, and effective information architecture.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills, with the ability to triage and prioritize numerous issues and projects across stages and sections.</li> <li>A track record of leading cross-team projects and process improvements, building alignment with stakeholders, and driving adoption.</li> <li>Data-driven decision making, using analytics and feedback to guide content strategy and demonstrate impact.</li> <li>The ability to succeed in a remote, globally distributed environment, including collaborating across countries and time zones, and to model respectful, professional communication.</li> <li>Adaptability and readiness to work in a rapidly changing environment.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevSecOps tools and open-source software is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the title: Accountmanager in Auction Business - Nouvelle Aquitaine (gn)
description: For this position we source for our sistercompany Troostwijk. About us Troostwijk and it's group TBAuctions are one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support. What your day-to-day work will involve As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business. The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market. You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships. What this means in practice Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market. Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust. Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations. Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers. Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps. Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion. Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools. Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of the role</strong></h4> <p>As Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Engineering, you'll lead a small, distributed team of security engineers and own programs that span Corporate Security teams. You'll define clear team boundaries, run security tooling through GitOps-based engineering practices, and bring program priorities, budgets, and vendor decisions to Security leadership. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you won't be the primary implementer, but you'll write code, review designs and merge requests, make architecture decisions, and support incident response. This role is remote within North America, reports to the VP, Corporate Security, and is at job level M3 (Manager, Security Engineering).</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead, hire, coach, and develop security engineers, including Staff engineers setting technical direction in artificial intelligence (AI) security and cloud environments. Build clear career paths and support ownership, written communication, and psychological safety.</li> <li>Own the lifecycle of shared security tools, from evaluation and procurement through renewal and retirement. Use infrastructure-as-code repositories and GitOps practices, and give each tool a named owner, budget line, and exit plan. Initial priorities include Axonius, Push Security, Island, Material Security, the transition from Koi to Fleet osquery, and the CrowdStrike contract split with Security Operations.</li> <li>Lead the secure access service edge (SASE) and always-on virtual private network (VPN) rollout, and own data loss prevention policy. Coordinate Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) boundary decisions with Security Compliance, working with Endpoint Engineering on clients and device posture signals and Identity Engineering on Okta network-zone policy.</li> <li>Run the corporate email gateway and own domain-based message authentication, reporting, and conformance (DMARC), sender policy framework (SPF), and DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) across GitLab domains, including the FedRAMP tenant. Complete the separation of product email flow from corporate Google Workspace.</li> <li>Operate Sandbox Cloud across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including the self-service portal, demo and training environments, the SSP GitLab instance, and other gitlab.systems environments. Build automated deprovisioning and cost guardrails while keeping identity and access management with Identity Engineering and production infrastructure with Infrastructure Security and Site Reliability Engineering.</li> <li>Own Corporate Security's operating-model reporting, annual operating plan, software spend, change management, systems directory, handbook upkeep, and dashboards. Coordinate audit evidence across all three teams for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2), and FedRAMP, replacing screenshots with code and query exports.</li> <li>Run departmental intake and reduce repeated requests through Slack automation, Serval, self-service security reviews, documentation hubs, and AI-assisted answers. Help each team focus on the systems it owns rather than routine triage.</li> <li>Represent Platform Engineering in Corporate Security and Security leadership forums, the Authorization to Operate Council, and monthly AI spend reviews. Partner with Corporate IT, Infrastructure Security, security incident response, Security Compliance, Security Risk, Enterprise AI, Legal and Privacy, Procurement, and Finance to resolve shared priorities and ownership questions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience managing security or platform engineering teams across time zones, including hiring engineers and developing senior individual contributors. modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.</li> <li value="6">Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.</li> <li value="7">Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including You’ll combine people-focused leadership, technical judgment, and business acumen to develop engineers, strengthen our support program, and help customers realize value from GitLab.</p> <p>You’ll also connect the team’s technical contributions to outcomes that matter across the business. This includes telling a compelling, evidence-based story about how Support Engineering helps protect revenue, enable growth, remove barriers to adoption, and accelerate customer time to value. You’ll help executives and sales teams understand the significance of the work engineers perform and how that work supports customer and organizational success.</p> <p>Beyond individual cases, you’ll recognize Support Engineering as a valuable source of business intelligence. By bringing together engineers’ firsthand observations, product trends, and recurring customer pain points, you’ll turn field signal into actionable insights for Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Co-lead, coach, and develop a team of Support Engineers, building a culture of trust, accountability, technical excellence, and understanding of their broader business impact.</li> <li>Partner with other Support Engineering Managers to shape program strategy, establish priorities, plan capacity, and evolve processes and tooling as customer and business needs change.</li> <li>Translate complex technical work into clear, compelling narratives for executives and sales teams, connecting engineers’ contributions to revenue protection, growth opportunities, customer adoption, and faster time to value.</li> <li>Use operational data, customer context, and qualitative feedback to evaluate support effectiveness, communicate impact, and guide investment and improvement decisions.</li> <li>Establish a repeatable approach to capturing engineers’ insights and identifying product trends, recurring customer pain points, adoption barriers, and emerging government requirements.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to turn support intelligence into actionable recommendations for product improvements, enablement, and customer engagement.</li> <li>Maintain technical engagement by joining customer calls, reviewing tickets, and helping engineers navigate complex or sensitive issues, while developing the team’s ability to resolve challenges independently.</li> <li>Coordinate responses to escalated and critical customer situations during working hours, providing clear communication and sound judgment.</li> <li>Champion improvements that address recurring problems, reduce customer friction, and strengthen the quality and scalability of our U.S. Government support offering.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Demonstrated success leading and developing technical support or engineering teams, including coaching, performance management, career development, and leadership through growth and change.</li> <li>A strong technical background supporting complex enterprise software or infrastructure, with the ability to assess technical challenges, recognize the value engineers deliver, and understand the implications for customer outcomes.</li> <li>Experience translating technical accomplishments into business value for executive and sales audiences, using clear storytelling supported by data and customer context.</li> <li>Business acumen to connect support outcomes with revenue protection, customer retention, growth, product adoption, and time to value.</li> <li>The ability to treat engineers’ knowledge and customer interactions as sources of business intelligence, synthesizing individual observations into meaningful trends and actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Experience setting priorities, planning resources, and improving support programs while balancing immediate customer needs with longer-term organizational goals.</li> <li>A people-focused leadership approach that builds trust, encourages candid feedback, recognizes contributions, and creates opportunities for engineers to grow.</li> <li>Experience managing high-severity incidents and sensitive escalations, including effective communication with customers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>The ability to influence across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success, building alignment around customer needs and shared business outcomes.</li> <li>Familiarity with U.S. Government customers and the operational, security, and regulatory constraints that shape their environments. We also welcome candidates with relevant experience in other complex or regulated industries.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Our U.S. Government Support team formed in 2019 and has grown alongside the adoption of GitLab within government agencies. We help customers troubleshoot complex environments and use GitLab’s DevSecOps platform securely and effectively.</p> <p>Distributed across the United States, we combine synchronous and asynchronous collaboration to support customers and build strong working relationships in a remote-first environment. Our team includes both tenured and newer engineers, bringing diverse technical experience and perspectives.</p> <p>We’re focused on developing our people, scaling our operations, strengthening crisis management for sensitive systems, and deepening our partnerships across GitLab. As a senior leader, you’ll help make the team’s technical expertise and customer knowledge more valuable to the broader organization, while ensuring engineers have the support, direction, and development opportunities they need to succeed.</p> <h4><br><br><br></h4><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), AI Engineering: AI Catalog
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.</p> <p>In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the GitLab monolith (Ruby) and, where needed, the AI Gateway (Python). Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.</li> <li>Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.</li> <li>Design, implement and review GraphQL and REST APIs and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients.</li> <li>Improve and extend automated testing (RSpec and other frameworks) to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.</li> <li>Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.</li> <li>Join Tier 2 <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/incident-management/on-call/tier-2/">on-call rotations</a> to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.</li> <li>Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, including background jobs, APIs and data models.</li> <li>Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Python backends and/or Vue frontends is a plus.</li> <li>Skill in designing or extending REST and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.</li> <li>Real enthusiasm for AI and hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work. Experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or integrations is a plus.</li> <li>Proven SQL and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and data modeling.</li> <li>Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.</li> <li>Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/ai/agent-foundations/">Agent Foundations stage</a> builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution, they provide the core harness for GitLab’s agents, the tools Agent’s need to interact with GitLab as well as ways to configure and execute Agents across GitLab.<br><br></p> <p>Our engineers work async-first across EMEA and AMER timezones.
