title: Integrated Marketing Lead, Business Banking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£78,000 - £100,000 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a> | 12 month fixed term contract</p> <p>The Integrated Marketing Lead will develop and deliver marketing campaigns that support Monzo Business's growth ambitions. You'll bring together marketing channels, product launches and commercial partnerships to drive customer acquisition, engagement and business value, working closely with teams across Marketing and Business Banking.</p> <p>This is a 12-month fixed-term contract.</p> <p><strong>⭐️ Capabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cross-functional leadership: Ability to bring together Marketing centers of excellence, Product, Sales and commercial partners to deliver coordinated B2B campaigns and shared business outcomes.</li> <li>Strategic thinking & B2B expertise: Strong understanding of business customer segments, buying behaviors and go-to-market approaches, with the ability to apply B2B marketing best practices to commercial opportunities.</li> <li>Commercial acumen in marketing: Understanding of B2B marketing economics, customer acquisition, engagement and lifetime value, with the ability to prioritize investment and resources based on business impact.</li> <li>Integrated campaign design: Expertise in developing and delivering multi-channel campaigns and product launches, connecting customer insight, proposition, messaging and channels across the buying journey.</li> <li>Performance and measurement: Ability to use data and customer insights to evaluate marketing effectiveness, understand funnel performance, test new approaches and improve business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🔑 What you’ll be doing: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and deliver marketing plans and campaigns that support Business Banking's commercial priorities and wider go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Own the planning and execution of priority campaigns, product launches and commercial partnerships, coordinating teams across Marketing, Product and the wider business.</li> <li>Translate customer and market insights into effective audience strategies, channel plans and customer journeys.</li> <li>Manage campaign budgets, timelines, resources and dependencies, making recommendations on where to focus effort and investment.</li> <li>Work with commercial partners on joint marketing initiatives, coordinating plans, managing relationships and measuring results.</li> <li>Monitor campaign performance, share results with stakeholders and identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Contribute B2B marketing expertise, new ideas and external best practices to strengthen our go-to-market approach.</li> <li>Explore how AI and new technologies can improve campaign planning, execution and measurement, challenging existing ways of working.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You’ll love this role if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a strong track record in B2B marketing, delivering campaigns and product launches targeting SMEs that have driven measurable commercial results.</li> <li>Understand different B2B go-to-market approaches, including self-serve acquisition and how marketing works with Sales to reach and convert businesses.</li> <li>Have experience working across Marketing, Product and commercial teams, including managing external partners and agencies.</li> <li>Are comfortable managing budgets, using performance data and making decisions based on customer and commercial impact.</li> <li>Bring fresh thinking and a strong point of view on what great B2B marketing looks like, with the curiosity to keep learning and improving.</li> <li>Actively use AI in your work and enjoy experimenting with new tools and approaches to improve how marketing gets done.</li> <li>Can balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, managing competing priorities and getting things done.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A bit about you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>​You think strategically, but you’re not afraid to get hands-on.</li> <li>​You understand how to prioritise when there’s a lot to juggle</li> <li>​You bring people together and know how to get them excited about the work.</li> <li>You care about doing the right thing for customers and for the business.</li> <li>You’re humble and curious, asking for help when you need it and you’re always looking for ways to do things better.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🌈 The Interview Process (for successful applicants)</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (30mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (45mins)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 £78,000 - £100,000 </p> <p>📍This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </p> <p>See our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> <strong>here </strong></a></p> <p>⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-CM1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Security Risk Management Specialist
description: <p>In security risk management we’re looking to harness the power of industry best practice combined with driving new innovation on how we do security risk assessments and modelling. Our security risk management team is the primary owner of the strategy and practices of how we identify, track and reduce our security risk across everything we do. </p> <p>To support this we need to use industry best practices paired with emerging threat information to to promote risk identification, quantification, impact analysis, and modelling to ultimately drive decision making. In this role, you will help establish and execute a broad strategic vision for the security risk program at Canonical. You will not only work within the team but also cross-functionally with various teams across the organisation. The team contributes ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attacks. Additionally, the team collaborates with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate security training across Canonical.</p> <p>The security risk management team’s mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.</p> <h2>What you will do in this role:</h2> <ul> <li>Define Canonical's security risk management  standards and playbooks</li> <li>Analyse and improve Canonical's security risk practices</li> <li>Evaluate, select and implement new security requirements, tools and practices</li> <li>Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical security risk management practice</li> <li>Develop Canonical security risk learning and development materials</li> <li>Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change</li> <li>Participate in developing key risk indicators, provide inputs to the development of key control indicators, and key performance indicators for various programs</li> <li>Apply statistical models to risk frameworks (such as FAIR, sensitivity analysis, and others)</li> <li>Participate in risk management, decision-making, and collaborative discussions</li> <li>Lead quantified risk assessments and understand the value of qualitative data for improvements to quality and engineering processes</li> <li>Interpret internal or external cyber security risk analyses in business terms and recommend a responsible course of action</li> <li>Develop templates and materials to help with self-service risk management actions </li> <li>Monitor and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of risk management processes</li> <li>Launch campaigns to perform security assessments and help mitigate security risks across the company</li> <li>Build evaluation methods and performance indicators to measure efficiency of security functions and capabilities.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for</h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record </li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path</li> <li>Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations</li> <li>Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security</li> <li>Leadership and management ability</li> <li>Excellent business English writing and presentation skills</li> <li>Problem-solver with excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of security assessments and risk management</li> <li>Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks</li> <li>Broad knowledge of how to operationalize the management of security risk</li> <li>Experience in Secure Development Lifecycle and Security by Design methodology</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
description: Protect what matters. Primion Technology is a global solution provider and market leader in Converged Security Solutions and Workforce Management . For more than 30 years, we have supported around 5,000 satisfied customers worldwide who rely on our certified solutions every day. From consulting and planning to development, installation, maintenance, and support, a team of over 470 dedicated experts works passionately to meet the highest standards. PRIMION France is a key growth market within PRIMION's European expansion strategy, focusing on delivering enterprise-grade, software-centric solutions to mid-size and large organizations across French territory. As an Account Executive (m/f/d) , you will acquire new customers and expand PRIMION's presence across enterprise and mid-market organizations. Positioning our integrated software solutions as strategic business enablers, you will guide prospects through the full sales cycle, from lead qualification and solution discovery to contract negotiation and close. If you enjoy building relationships, uncovering opportunities, and turning them into sustainable business growth, then this role could be the perfect fit for you. Ready to make an impact? Experience selling to enterprise accounts in at least one of PRIMION's target verticals (Critical Infrastructure, Healthcare, Logistics, Manufacturing, Public Sector, or Financial Services). Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes. Comfortable navigating complex organizational structures and building relationships at C-level, VP, and Director level. Native or fluent French speaker; professional English proficiency for internal collaboration. Based in France with the ability and willingness to travel extensively across the territory, with a particular focus on Southern France. Nice-to-Have Experience with physical security, access control, video surveillance, or workforce management solutions. Familiarity with NIS2, KRITIS, or similar European cybersecurity/compliance frameworks relevant to critical infrastructure operators. Experience working with channel partners and system integrators as part of a go-to-market model. Exposure to identity management, OT/IT security convergence, or PSIM platforms. Formal sales methodology certification (MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN Selling, or similar). What We Offer Protect what matters – Powered by People. Stability: Benefit from the backing of an established European technology brand with a 30+ year track record, strong R&D investment, and a clear multi-year growth strategy. Market Opportunity: Capitalize on growing market demand driven by regulatory developments such as NIS2 and KRITIS, creating strong opportunities for customer acquisition and business growth. Collaboration: Work closely with Pre-Sales experts, Customer Success Managers, and Product specialists to develop compelling customer solutions and drive successful sales outcomes. Excellence: Continuously develop your expertise through PRIMION's sales enablement resources, industry insights, and proven vertical playbooks. Growth: Grow with a business that is actively expanding across European markets while taking on increasing responsibility and shaping future market success. Equipment: Benefit from a company car as well as modern business equipment, including a company phone and laptop, to support your daily work and customer engagements. Have we piqued your interest? title: Spécialiste Support Services Financiers bilingue allemand H/F
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance. This team helps turn customer priorities into real adoption and measurable outcomes by guiding complex implementations, shaping new service patterns, and bringing emerging GitLab capabilities into production environments.</p> <p>You'll own the Global Technical Architecture practice across both presales and delivery, managing a team of AMER Technical Architects who work on complex customer needs, early-stage offerings, and strategic engagements. This role is well suited for someone who can coach senior technical talent, bring structure to ambiguity, and keep the team focused on customer outcomes instead of task completion.</p> <p>In your first year, you'll focus on stabilizing and growing the team, tightening the link between presales scoping and delivery, and turning field work into repeatable offerings. You'll work alongside architects in areas including AI, security, and broader platform architecture, while helping the team turn what they learn in the field into repeatable methods that can scale across Professional Services.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li>Running technical discovery, scoping, and delivery for complex Professional Services engagements in AMER</li> <li>Turning early customer work on new GitLab capabilities into repeatable delivery kits, standards, and service patterns</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hire, manage, and develop a growing AMER Technical Architecture team, including Intermediate, Senior, and Staff Technical Architects working across platform, AI, and security-related customer engagements.</li> <li>Lead the global Technical Architecture practice, aligning architects in AMER, EMEA, and APJ on shared standards for scoping, statement of work review, service offerings and delivery leadership.</li> <li>Manage the practice end to end, covering presales collaboration, engagement scoping, technical delivery oversight, staffing, utilization, and forecast alignment, with accountability for improving utilization, delivery quality, and forecast accuracy.</li> <li>Coach architects to grow from hands-on implementers into technical leaders and credible advisors on most of their engagements, with a focus on customer outcomes, strong technical judgment, and consultative communication.</li> <li>Partner on complex presales motions with Engagement Managers on estimation, solution framing, technical objection handling, statement of work assumptions, and technical risk to build customer confidence, improve scoping accuracy, and strengthen delivery readiness.</li> <li>Join strategic customer conversations where senior technical expertise helps build credibility, clarify ambiguity, and improve the path to successful delivery.</li> <li>Guide the team through first-mover delivery of new GitLab capabilities, helping shape how emerging offerings are tested, delivered, and improved in real customer environments to shorten time to production and increase successful adoption.</li> <li>Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable templates, architecture guidance, migration patterns, and implementation standards that increase reuse and improve delivery consistency across the broader Professional Services organization.</li> <li>Represent the Technical Architecture practice in AMER Professional Services management discussions and partner with adjacent functions to improve coordination, service evolution, and delivery consistency.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience managing senior technical professionals in a services, consulting, or Professional Services environment, with a strong track record of coaching, performance management, and career development.</li> <li>Working knowledge of GitLab, software development, site reliability and infrastructure engineering, security, cloud architecture, and agile delivery, with enough depth to guide technical direction and build credibility with highly experienced architects.</li> <li>Experience running consultative engagements by linking technical work to business goals and keeping teams focused on customer value and realized outcomes.</li> <li>Experience with technically complex presales work, including discovery, scoping, estimation, solution definition, and risk assessment.</li> <li>Experience running a billable team against utilization targets, with a clear grasp of how utilization, margin, and forecast accuracy drive Professional Services revenue.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments where offerings, priorities, and organizational needs continue to evolve.</li> <li>Experience building or improving repeatable delivery methods such as playbooks, standards, service kits, architecture patterns, or implementation guidance.</li> <li>A servant-leadership style built on empathy and continuous improvement: you remove blockers for your team, act on what retrospectives surface, and build processes that make it easy to do the right thing.</li> <li>Experience leading customer conversations at every level, from platform engineers to the CTO, giving clear feedback, and aligning cross-functional stakeholders around delivery direction.</li> <li>Familiarity with GitLab-relevant domains such as AI-powered developer workflows, security, DevSecOps, or enterprise platform adoption is helpful, along with experience ramping up quickly in adjacent areas where needed.</li> <li>Experience using AI to scale how your team scopes, documents, and delivers work.</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25%.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Professional Services team helps customers adopt GitLab in ways that create lasting value. Within that organization, the Technical Architecture team handles some of the most complex and ambiguous work. This includes shaping early delivery approaches for new capabilities, contributing to high-impact customer engagements, and creating the patterns that help the wider organization scale successful services.</p> <p>You'll manage a growing AMER team of Technical Architects, lead the global Technical Architecture practice, and work closely with Engagement Management, Professional Services Operations, Customer Experience Engineering, and other Professional Services colleagues. We play an important role in setting the technical standard for delivery while also helping define how new services should be scoped, delivered, and improved over time.</p> <p>GitLab works in an all-remote, asynchronous environment built on transparency, iteration, collaboration, and empowered ownership. In our team, that means giving managers and architects the latitude to solve hard problems, exchange what they learn openly, and continuously improve how the practice runs. description: About The Opportunity We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling. Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary). Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus). Quality Assurance: Participate in a rigorous, 4-layer human quality control process (creation, human review, calibration review, and audit) alongside automated LLM-based checks to ensure fairness, grammatical accuracy, and benchmark integrity. cross-team resolution.</li> <li>Own UAT strategy and acceptance criteria in collaboration with BSAs, ensuring system changes meet business requirements before production release.</li> <li>Support post-launch stabilization and continuous improvement cycles, prioritizing defect resolution and incremental enhancements based on business impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Systems Architecture Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers to evaluate build-vs-buy-vs-configure decisions for new capabilities.</li> <li>Bring informed opinions on QTC platform architecture trade-offs (e.g., billing model design, middleware integration patterns, revenue recognition rule configuration) based on deep domain knowledge.</li> <li>Stay current on platform roadmaps for Salesforce, Zuora, and NetSuite, identifying opportunities to leverage native capabilities before custom builds.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></h3> <ul> Quote-to-Cash systems: Salesforce CPQ, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, and NetSuite ERP are the core stack—hands-on configuration or implementation experience strongly preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to own and communicate multi-quarter internal product roadmaps to senior business and technology stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong command of revenue lifecycle processes: opportunity-to-quote, title: Senior Professional Services Engineer - PubSec - DC Metro
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Professional Services Engineer at GitLab, you'll partner with public sector customers to help them successfully adopt and expand GitLab across their organization. You'll deliver services such as installation, migration, training, and advisory engagements, meeting customers where they are, from single-node Omnibus installations to larger reference architectures using infrastructure as code and configuration as code. In this role, you'll balance hands-on technical delivery with clear communication and project ownership, helping customers make practical choices that fit their goals, timelines, and environments. You'll also work closely with project managers and engagement managers to make delivery more consistent and improve how we run engagements. As you work with customers, you'll act as a feedback loop to GitLab's product and engineering teams by communicating insights that can improve GitLab features and delivery processes. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, working across multiple engagements, and succeeding in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Delivering GitLab installations and upgrades using tools like Terraform or Ansible, from simple deployments to highly available architectures</li> <li value="2">Leading migrations from existing systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, including planning, execution, and knowledge transfer</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Deliver Professional Services engagements such as installation, migration, training, and advisory services to help customers achieve successful outcomes with GitLab, including completing projects on scope and on schedule.</li> <li value="2">Plan and execute GitLab deployments across a range of architectures, from single-node Omnibus installations to large reference architectures using infrastructure as code and configuration as code practices.</li> <li value="3">Oversee and perform migrations from multiple source systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, helping customers reduce risk, maintain momentum during change, and complete cutovers with minimal disruption.</li> <li value="4">Provide technical guidance across the GitLab feature stack, helping customers adopt best practices that fit their goals, constraints, and operating environment.</li> <li value="5">Partner closely with project managers and engagement managers by providing feedback and updates that improve delivery consistency, keep work on schedule, and reduce delivery issues across engagements.</li> <li value="6">Manage and deliver multiple customer projects at once, balancing customer outcomes with awareness of billable time and delivery priorities to meet utilization and delivery goals.</li> <li value="7">Mentor and assist other Professional Services Engineers by communicating expertise in specific technical areas and contributing to stronger, more repeatable delivery patterns.</li> <li value="8">Work closely with GitLab's product and engineering teams to remove blockers for customers and help improve GitLab features and delivery processes based on field insights, leading to faster issue resolution and more consistent delivery.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll <strong><strong class="textBold">bring</strong></strong></h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with one or more infrastructure as code or configuration as code tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, or Chef.</li> <li value="2">Experience with one or more infrastructure as code or configuration as code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, or Chef.</li> <li><strong><strong class="textBold">Active TS/SCI with CI Poly clearance is required for this role due to the nature of the customers you’ll support.</strong></strong> <ul> <li value="3"><strong><strong class="textBold">Occasional travel to SCIF sites as needed.</strong></strong></li> <li value="3"><strong><strong class="textBold">Desirable locations - Reston or Chantilly, VA </strong></strong></li> advisory engagements. title: Creative Studio Resource Manager - Creative Ops
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/UK Remote | 💰£57,000 - £77,100 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ About the role</strong></p> <p>As our Creative Studio Resource Manager, you’ll be the operational engine at the heart of our In-House Studio. While the Creative Operations Manager focuses on the long-term pipeline, you will manage the live, day-to-day workflow and reactive resourcing shifts. </p> <p>You’ll handle brief intake, scheduling, capacity planning, and urgent "fire-drill" requests, ensuring that daily traffic across our resource charts reflects the real-time capacity and capabilities of our design and writing team.</p> <p>You’ll serve as an on-the-ground process champion and gatekeeper for the designer and writers time, ensuring they are protected from scope creep and unrealistic deadlines while maintaining smooth, collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Day-to-Day Traffic & Resource Planning: </strong>Manage the live studio pipeline, project queues, and daily resource allocation across designers, copywriters, and motion graphic designer.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Reactive Workflow & Capacity Management: </strong>Handle urgent "fire-drill" requests, brief delays, and scope adjustments in real time, shifting schedules and reallocating resources to prevent bottlenecks and balance workloads.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Gatekeeping & Process Championing: </strong>Act as the "gatekeeper of the possible" during briefing sessions and creative reviews. Ensure incoming briefs are complete and realistic before assigning work, shielding creative teams from scope creep.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Traffic Meetings & Stand-ups: </strong>Lead daily and weekly traffic status meetings with internal studio teams and project owners to review project progress, monitor deadlines, and clear operational blockers.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Collaboration & Agency Support: </strong>Maintain clear, proactive communication with Project Owners managing expectations and facilitating smooth delivery across all creative channels.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if …</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You can demonstrate robust experience across traffic management</strong>: including creative project management, or studio coordination experience.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You thrive in a fast-paced environment: </strong>You have experience working in a<strong> </strong>fast-paced creative agency, or<strong> </strong>as part of a high-growth in-house team<br><br></li> <li><strong>You have an unflappable Mindset: </strong>You’re calm and composed under pressure, effortlessly managing sudden schedule changes or scope pivots.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You’re a Problem Solver: </strong>You thrive in grey areas, taking initiative as a self-starter to find pragmatic solutions when resourcing conflicts arise.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You’re a strong Communicator: </strong>You manage stakeholders and navigate difficult conversations with diplomacy, tact, and a positive attitude.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £57,000 - £77,100 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short call with a Monzo Recruiter</li> <li>Video-call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>Full-Loop Interviews (1 x Role Specific + 1 x Behavioural)</li> </ul> <p>📆 <strong>Please Note</strong>: We pause hiring from 14th Dec 2026 - 4th January 2027. Full Loop interviews will take place w/c 4th January + w/c 11th January 2027.</p> <p>⏳We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p><br><br></p> <p>#LI-REMOTE<br>#CM-1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Android Developer
description: At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with your future colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an Android Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare. We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an Android Developer at Luscii, you will build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible. Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role. The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform. Your role As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps. What you will be doing: Develop and optimise Android applications in Kotlin, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience. Shape mobile architecture and technical solutions, applying sound software design principles and patterns. Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical approaches early. Develop features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. Investigate and resolve production issues, using debugging and performance analysis to keep our apps reliable. Review code, share technical guidelines and collaborate with development, QA and support colleagues. Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, and recommend improvements where they add value. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Most important benefits Salary : € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii). Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least five years of experience in Android or mobile development and extensive experience with Kotlin, including coroutines and Flow. You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment. You have experience with clean architecture, software design patterns and approaches such as MVVM or MVI, and you understand how to apply them in maintainable mobile applications. You have experience with Jetpack Compose, mobile unit and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and Android design guidelines. You understand mobile performance and reliability, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation, as well as working with web services, cloud platforms and APIs. You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Business Development Representative, Financial Services - UKI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>This position is 100% remote and will be based in the UK and Ireland.<br><br>GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing Sales team. As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted accounts working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.</p> <p>Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams.</p> <p>We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory.</li> <li>Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts.</li> <li>Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities.</li> <li>Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies.</li> <li>Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates.</li> <li>Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast.</li> <li>Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.</li> <li>Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.</li> <li>Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.</li> <li>Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.</li> <li>Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.</li> <li>Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.</li> <li>Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.</li> <li><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> <li>Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Interim Director of Financial Operations & Control
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London / UK Remote | 💰£142,000 - £170,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Financial Control team ⭐</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced finance operations leader for a 12-month fixed-term contract to lead our Global Financial Operations and Control team. The incumbent Director is stepping out of day-to-day operations to spearhead a strategic, multi-year finance automation and systems program.</p> <p>Your mandate is  to provide steady-state operational leadership across all financial operations, close cycles, and management reporting; and serve as the essential operational contact for the program.  You will ensure BAU integrity while actively operationalising and absorbing newly automated processes.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading all aspects of financial control and operations, including Accounts Payable, Treasury Operations/Product Control, Money Operations ensuring robust, well controlled, and timely transaction processing.</li> <li>Leading the production and end-to-end delivery of monthly close and management reporting cycle, working across Finance to provide the Group Financial Controller, UK CFO and EU CFOs with actionable insights and variance analysis.</li> <li>Maintaining a robust, control and governance framework focused on integrity of our data and processes.  </li> <li>Serving as the primary operational counterpart and sounding board to the Director of Financial Operations & Control (incumbent) within the programme, providing operational feedback on target operating models and workflow designs.</li> <li>Managing team capacity and workflows to free up key subject matter experts for involvement in the programme, including (not limited to) User Acceptance Testing, parallel runs, and systems testing.</li> <li>Supporting the practical change management and operational rollout of new automation tools within the live environment, establishing new standard operating procedures without interrupting daily processing.</li> <li>Working closely with the Director of Financial & Regulatory Reporting to ensure core financial operations and control processes comply with overarching accounting policies  and provide a seamless hand off into the consolidation.</li> <li>Providing stable, empathetic, and accountable leadership to a distributed team during a period of change, maintaining high engagement, retention, and performance.</li> <li>Building and maintaining effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, external auditors and advisors.</li> <li>Driving the delivery of the Financial Operations and Control teams milestones and actions on existing key projects such as EU expansion, working with stakeholders to identify and resolve delivery risks.</li> <li>Managing a structured, documented operational handover back to permanent leadership at the conclusion of the 12-month term.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Role Scope Clarification</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Included:</strong> Global financial operations and control process ownership, including delivery of those services to subsidiaries, Treasury operations/Product control, Money Operations, Month-end Close and related management reporting.</li> <li><strong>Excluded:</strong> Group Consolidation and the preparation/filing of Statutory Financial Statements for the Group and subsidiaries; Regulatory Reporting. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a demonstrated track record stepping into high volume, multi-entity finance operations leadership roles and delivering immediate stability within regulated environments (Fintech, Banking, or Financial Services preferred). </li> <li>You’re an empathetic, effective people leader with a strong track record of coaching individuals and fostering a positive, high-performing environment.</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of internal control environments and the ability to build "best-in-class" processes.</li> <li>You have experience operating within complex, multi-entity or cross-border structures where data consistency is paramount.</li> <li>You have demonstrated experience operationalising new technology, and embedding change within Finance teams.</li> <li>Have excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain operational complexities to key stakeholders and peers.</li> <li>You are adaptability and resilience in fast-paced, tech-led, and agile environments.</li> <li>You hold strong technical accounting knowledge (IFRS) </li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £142,000 - £170,000.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 5 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Initial Call with the Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager Interview</li> <li>Role Specific Interview</li> <li>Behavioural Interview</li> <li>Final Interview with the Team </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.</p> <p> #LI-TP1 #LI-REMOTE<strong><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>
