You'll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform - Support and grow the community — Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team - Collaborate across the company — Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF - You've built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge - You create content that makes people want to open their code editor - You're equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript - You're energized by community whether it's on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person - You're self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source REQUIREMENTS - Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.) - Experience creating technical content (written or video) - Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online) BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE - A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter - Prior experience in DevRel or open source - Have used (and loved) Supabase WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Product Manager PRINCE2
description: Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player, the global leader in the assessment and certification of professional skills industry with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥 Shape the future of PRINCE2. The home of modern projects, programme, and portfolio management. PeopleCert is looking for a Product Manager to help take our PRINCE2 portfolio of Best Practice to the next level of success - developing compelling propositions for globally recognised PRINCE2 products that ensure wide adoption among senior audiences, new sectors and markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of key products in the PRINCE2 portfolio – including certifications, official publications and learning materials – making sure they remain high quality, relevant and well supported in market. As Product Manager for the PRINCE2 portfolio , you will work closely with teams across the business in order to support delivery of the overall roadmap and enable commercial success for your product set within the PRINCE2 portfolio. As Product Manager PRINCE2 your tasks will be the following: Product strategy and vision Contribute to the product vision and strategy, and develop and maintain the roadmap for your product set. Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape that will inform the product strategy. Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance. Product management Monitor and analyze product performance, making data-driven recommendations to optimize and enhance your products. Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience. New product development Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences Stakeholder collaboration Contribute key elements to the go-to-market plans developed by Marketing, including positioning, key messaging and more. Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions. Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision. What we look for: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.) Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products. Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes. Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs Strong business/commercial acumen Excellent people and management skills to interact with colleagues, cross-functional teams, and third parties around the world Problem-solving and analytical capabilities. Prior exposure in Education, Consulting, Examination/Certification, or Technology sectors will be considered an asset. Excellent command of the English language (C2 level certification desired; LanguageCert C2 LTE or C2 IESOL a plus). Advanced computer literacy required; ECDL Advanced certification desirable. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or equivalent software will be considered an added advantage. What we offer: The opportunity to shape globally recognized frameworks used by professionals around the world. A collaborative, high-impact international team and a purpose-driven working culture. Flexible working conditions (location and hours). Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees Competitive compensation and personal development opportunities. A global network of professionals and subject matter experts. If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you! Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions. Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do. Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business. title: Principal Growth Marketing Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>Growth Marketing is the activation and delivery arm of GitLab marketing: campaigns, regional and field marketing, lifecycle and product led growth, marketing engineering and operations, corporate events including Transcend, partner marketing, community programs and Co-Create. If a program connects GitLab to a customer or a buyer, it lives here, and the team is accountable for pipeline, first orders, Flex conversion and expansion, and post sale adoption.</p> <p>As Principal Growth Marketing Strategist you work directly with the VP of Growth Marketing as a strategic partner and operator. You hold the whole picture of the engine: the goals every function has committed to, the budget and where it is moving, the strategic projects that do not fit cleanly inside any one function, and the decisions that are waiting on an answer. You keep that picture current, you act on it when the VP is engaged elsewhere, and you use it to move work faster.</p> <p>This is an individual contributor role at the Principal level. You do not manage a team. You manage outcomes across ten functions through influence, judgment and follow through, and you are trusted to speak for Growth Marketing in rooms the VP cannot be in. The people on the leadership team are senior, experienced marketers; they will work with you because you make them faster and sharper, not because of the title.</p> <p>You will be effective in this role if you have led marketing yourself at a senior level, understand how a modern B2B software company makes money, are curious and hands on with AI in your own work, and can move between a budget trade off, a partner negotiation, a pipeline review and a keynote plan in the same day without losing the thread.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Run Growth Marketing's operating rhythm: goals, business reviews, planning cycles and the metrics inspection behind them, so decisions get made, recorded and followed through.</li> <li>Track commitments across the leadership team between their 1:1s with the VP, so those conversations are about strategy rather than status.</li> <li>Own the strategic projects that matter to Growth Marketing and have no single functional home: scope them, find the owner or be the owner, and land them.</li> <li>Hold the budget picture across the team, prepare trade offs with a recommendation, and act within the authority the VP has delegated in writing.</li> <li>Represent Growth Marketing on the VP's behalf in pipeline reviews, cross functional planning and partner conversations; carry the position in and the decision out.</li> <li>Unblock functional leaders when the VP is engaged elsewhere, or stage the issue so it takes one conversation rather than three.</li> <li>Be a thinking partner to any functional leader who wants one, offered rather than assigned.</li> <li>Partner with marketing's AI Transformation Owner so AI adoption across Growth Marketing is visible, measured and moving.</li> <li>Prepare the VP for high stakes moments: executive updates, leadership material, keynotes, customer and partner meetings, with the numbers checked and the first draft written.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in B2B software marketing with senior leadership experience: you have owned a marketing function, a large program budget or a go to market motion, and you have been accountable for a pipeline or revenue number.</li> <li>Breadth across marketing. You have worked in or closely with demand and digital, field and events, lifecycle or product led growth, partner marketing and marketing operations, and you can hold a credible conversation with an expert in each.</li> <li>A track record of landing cross functional projects that nobody owned, through influence rather than authority, with executives, peers and individual contributors.</li> <li>Business fluency: you read a P&L, a pipeline report and a budget model comfortably, you understand consumption and subscription business models, and you can explain a trade off to a CFO in plain language.</li> <li>Program and operating rhythm experience: goal frameworks, business reviews, planning cycles, and the discipline to keep them honest without turning them into bureaucracy.</li> <li>Hands on AI fluency. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you have built or configured something with them, and you are curious about how they change the way a marketing organization operates. Prior experience in a chief of staff, strategy and operations, or business operations role is welcome but not required.</li> <li>Executive communication: concise writing, clear verbal briefs, comfort presenting to and being questioned by VPs and C level leaders, and the judgment to know what travels up and what does not.</li> <li>Discretion. You will handle confidential people, budget and strategy information every day.</li> <li>Familiarity with developer, DevOps or platform engineering audiences, or the ability to get there fast.</li> <li>The ability to use GitLab, and to travel occasionally for events and leadership offsites.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>Growth Marketing at GitLab is one integrated engine of roughly 100 people across ten functions, led by the VP of Growth Marketing and reporting into the Chief Product and Marketing Officer. The team runs Transcend, GitLab's flagship event program, the GitHub competitive motion, the regional and partner marketing engines in AMER, EMEA and APJ, the lifecycle and product led growth motions behind GitLab's self serve business, and marketing's AI transformation. The leadership team operates on a small set of shared principles: speed with quality, an ownership mindset, and customer outcomes. You can read more about <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/marketing/">how marketing operates at GitLab</a> in the handbook.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. title: Vulnerability Strategy Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£41,300-52,250  + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our VAIB team⭐</strong></p> <p>Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>As VAIB Strategy Analyst, you will play a critical role in fulfilling Monzo's mission to make money work for everyone by driving meaningful improvements for customers requiring additional support. Working collaboratively, you will leverage data, customer insights, and operational expertise to seamlessly embed vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion, and bereavement considerations into product and service design. You will take proactive ownership of complex strategic projects and use independent judgement to navigate ambiguous escalations, shape treatment strategies, and identify emerging risks. Ultimately, you will ensure that changes deliver equitable customer outcomes while maintaining strong standards of risk management, governance, and regulatory compliance.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Strategic Delivery:</strong> Take ownership of complex VAIB workstreams, translating strategic priorities into clear delivery plans and driving improvements that balance customer needs, regulatory expectations, and operational goals.</li> <li><strong>Drive Data-Led Improvements:</strong> Analyze quantitative data, customer feedback, and operational insights to identify systemic barriers, proactively monitor outcomes, and develop evidence-based recommendations for strategic change.</li> <li><strong>Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Operations to build VAIB awareness, influence decision-making, and embed inclusive considerations into the design of customer journeys and internal processes.</li> <li><strong>Navigate Complex Escalations:</strong> Act as the escalation point for complex, ambiguous customer or operational issues, applying strong independent judgement to recommend proportionate solutions when clear policy guidance is unavailable.</li> <li><strong>Own Governance and Risk:</strong> Manage control requirements for all strategic changes, ensuring work is rigorously assessed, documented, and governed to support informed decision-making and mitigate regulatory risk.</li> <li><strong>Coach and Build Capability:</strong> Strengthen the wider VAIB team by proactively sharing specialist knowledge, mentoring less experienced colleagues, and elevating overall analytical and strategic ways of working.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have deep subject matter expertise in VAIB and relevant legal frameworks (e.g., Consumer Duty, Equality Act, WCAG), applying this knowledge to identify systemic barriers and proactively recommend improvements to products and customer journeys. VAIB experience is preferable but we'd also love to hear from you if you have any other regulatory background. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to independently manage and deliver complex strategic initiatives, utilising quantitative data, customer insights, and operational feedback to investigate ambiguous challenges, resolve blockers, and implement practical solutions.</li> <li>You have a strong grasp of risk, governance, and assurance, paired with excellent decision-making skills to confidently navigate ambiguity, appropriately mitigate risks, and ensure complex decisions are effectively balanced and documented.</li> <li>You are highly skilled in stakeholder management and communication, with the ability to clearly convey sensitive information, constructively challenge existing approaches, and drive alignment across Operations, Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering.</li> <li>You are committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for vulnerable customers, coupled with a dedication to sharing expertise and coaching colleagues to build the overall capability and confidence of the wider team.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £41,300-52,250 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br></p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. title: Vulnerability Strategy Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£51,200-64,700 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our VAIB team⭐</strong></p> <p>Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <p>As VAIB Strategy Manager at Monzo, you will lead and develop a high-performing team of Strategy Analysts dedicated to improving vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion, and bereavement outcomes. You will act as the bridge between overarching strategy and execution, translating business priorities into data-driven programs that deliver exceptional customer experiences. By collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will ensure VAIB considerations are deeply embedded into all products and services while maintaining strict regulatory compliance and governance. Ultimately, you will balance empathetic people leadership with rigorous operational discipline to continuously identify emerging opportunities and drive meaningful change for our customers.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and Develop Talent:</strong> Coach and build a high-performing, engaged team of Strategy Analysts, driving recruitment, knowledge-sharing, and a culture of accountability that aligns with Monzo’s core values.</li> <li><strong>Drive Strategy and Delivery:</strong> Translate VAIB priorities into clear, actionable projects and oversee the implementation of customer-centric treatment strategies, expertly balancing team capacity with strategic and regulatory demands.</li> <li><strong>Leverage Data for Improvement:</strong> Monitor customer journeys and performance metrics, utilizing both quantitative and qualitative insights to identify emerging trends, resolve gaps, and make evidence-led recommendations with Strategy Leads.</li> <li><strong>Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner seamlessly across Operations, Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering to ensure VAIB considerations are deeply embedded into wider business initiatives and customer touchpoints.</li> <li><strong>Manage Risk and Governance:</strong> Work closely with Risk and Compliance partners to design, document, and operate robust controls, ensuring all team activities strictly adhere to internal governance and external regulatory expectations.</li> <li><strong>Resolve Complex Escalations:</strong> Act as the primary escalation point for complex customer, operational, or regulatory issues, guiding the team through ambiguity to reach appropriate and proportionate outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Lead Through Change:</strong> Own and cascade crucial business communications and leadership updates, effectively supporting stakeholders through process changes while identifying emerging opportunities for continuous improvement.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have deep subject matter expertise in vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion, and bereavement (VAIB), applying key legal and industry standards (e.g., Consumer Duty, Equality Act, WCAG) to proactively reduce barriers and champion exceptional customer outcomes.</li> <li>You are a values-driven leader with a proven track regulatory and operational challenges.</li> <li>You have a strong grasp of risk, governance, and control environments, paired with excellent communication skills to influence stakeholders, manage formal actions, and confidently guide your team through organisational change.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></em></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £51,200-64,700 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br></p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. title: Software Engineer - Solutions Engineering
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations.</p> <p>We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.</p> <p>The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.</p> <p>Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.</p> <p>This role is ideal for software engineers who want to work in a global team, have a passion for distributed systems and cloud computing, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <ul> <li>Work in Python and Golang to design and deliver open source software operations code</li> <li>Work with the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications</li> <li>Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure</li> <li>Rethink open source operations for our customers and open source community</li> <li>Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code</li> <li>Follow agile software development practices</li> <li>Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights</li> <li>Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values</li> <li>Global travel up to 10% of time for internal and external events</li> </ul> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>You are a passionate Python developer</li> <li>You are organised and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software</li> <li>You understand the importance of reliable operations in an agile world</li> <li>You have sound knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies</li> <li>You have practical knowledge of Linux and networking</li> <li>You are a lifelong learner</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus points for</h3> <ul> <li>You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field</li> <li>Golang programming skills</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

title: Global Mobility Manager
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Imagine being the person who makes a move across the world feel easy. A candidate in Sydney gets a visa on a timeline they can plan around. A teammate relocating to Tokyo has a clear playbook, a human to talk to, and nothing to chase. A leader opening a brand-new market has a partner who can map the laws, entities, and employment models. That's the job. At Notion, we build tools that change how people work together, no matter where they are. As our Global Mobility Manager, you'll build the bridges that make that true for our own team: immigration, relocation, and global expansion, all in one program that you shape, own, and scale. This is a rare chance to take a working foundation, with playbooks, policies, and vendors already in place, and elevate it. You'll shape the policies and run the cases. You'll partner with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax, with dotted-line support from our shared services model in People Operations, so you're building alongside a team, not on an island. And you'll use AI and automation to turn a historically manual, paper-heavy function into something elegant. If you love fast-moving environments and turning solid foundations into great systems, you'll feel at home here. This role is based in San Francisco or New York. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own mobility, end to end - Own immigration and relocation across hiring, transfers, rotations, and assignments, backed by clear policies and playbooks - Shorten time-to-visa and time-to-move through streamlined intake, approvals, SLAs, and vendor management - Guide candidates, employees, and managers with empathetic, concise communication and self-serve resources Power global expansion - Support our expansion into new markets by: - Researching and ensuring compliance with local employment laws and regulations - Partnering with Legal and Finance to establish new state registrations, entity structures, and employment models - Helping general managers and People Partners design the strategy and program for talent mobility into new markets Build the partnerships and the program - title: Principal Revenue Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Principal Revenue Strategist, you'll help shape how GitLab brings its products to market as artificial intelligence changes how software is built and bought. Reporting to the VP of Revenue Strategy, you'll be a senior individual contributor connecting market, product, and field insights to clear recommendations and changes in how we sell. You'll take on complex, open-ended go-to-market questions with limited context, working directly with executive partners across Sales, Finance, and Product to decide where to invest, how to reach customers, and what needs to change.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Shape revenue strategy across customer segmentation, sales coverage, sales motions, and investment priorities.</li> <li>Design multi-quarter changes in how we sell and monetize, defining the implications for the customer journey, metrics, roles, incentives, and operating model. Build agreement on the path forward and partner with Field Operations and Enablement on execution.</li> <li>Develop market and expansion strategies, prioritizing markets, defining go-to-market models and capacity needs, and identifying the operational dependencies of entering or scaling in new regions.</li> <li>Connect go-to-market strategy and Product by translating field and customer insights into product input, and product direction into commercial implications. Provide focused, commercially grounded input on pricing and packaging.</li> <li>Contribute strategic inputs to long-range planning, including total addressable market, sales capacity, productivity, and unit economics, while Field Operations and Finance retain ownership of annual planning, quota setting, and territory design.</li> <li>Build models, write decision memos, run analyses, and facilitate working sessions to turn recommendations into action with cross-functional partners.</li> <li>Advise senior leaders in Sales, Finance, and Product independently, distilling complex problems into clear recommendations with explicit assumptions and trade-offs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex go-to-market or revenue strategy work in a growing technology company, consulting, or a combination of both. Relevant experience and transferable skills matter more than a particular career path.</li> <li>Direct experience solving business-to-business software go-to-market problems, such as segmentation, coverage, pipeline and conversion, sales capacity and productivity, incentives, or pricing and packaging.</li> <li>A structured approach to testing assumptions and turning an unclear problem into a framework, a recommendation, and practical next steps.</li> <li>Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to build models and recognize when the evidence is sufficient to make a decision.</li> <li>The ability to work credibly with senior leaders, challenge decisions with evidence, and influence people without formal authority.</li> <li>A collaborative, hands-on approach that treats execution as part of strategy, not a handoff after the recommendation.</li> <li>Helpful, but not required: experience with usage-based or consumption models, international expansion, enterprise or platform sales, or a technical or scientific background. Interest in people management over time is welcome, but this is an individual contributor role.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Revenue Strategy team tackles strategic questions about how GitLab reaches customers, sells, and monetizes its platform. You'll work with Sales, Finance, and Product leaders to connect strategy with commercial decisions, and with Field Operations and Enablement to put those decisions into practice. GitLab is an all-remote company with a public handbook and a transparent, low-ego culture. Our mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. title: Field Marketing Manager, Europe
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts. We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it. Location & work mode Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings. What you’ll do - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners What we’re looking for - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run - Willingness to travel often, including evenings What we offer We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect: - Competitive salary and equity - Employee-friendly equity terms - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday - Paid co-working space or desk - Health coverage (based on country requirements) - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays - 4 months paid parental leave - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter - Regular team events and off-sites - Remote-first with no required commute Learn how we think and work - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse. You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant. - Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production. - Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping. - Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation. - Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works. - Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions. - Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice. - Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it. - Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts. - Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting. - Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE: - Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience. - Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility. - Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype. - Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers. - Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost. - Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences. - Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions. - Know Postgres and relational database practice. - Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams. - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector. - Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped. - Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents. - Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates. - Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained. - Experience across several product surfaces or teams. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Head of Ecosystem
description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We aim to empower developers by providing a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're looking for a Head of Ecosystem to lead the teams that make Supabase the backend for the platforms and tools developers already use. That covers AI app builders and coding agents, integrations with the developer tools teams rely on, and the Supabase Marketplace. You'll work closely with our Postgres engineering teams and with the PM lead for Databases, who leads Multigres https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PxlZssDNrws. Small improvements here compound across every project on the platform. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - You'll own Postgres versions, upgrades and end-of-life. Which major and minor versions we support, how and when customers upgrade, and how we retire old versions. Your goal is to make upgrades routine rather than risky. - You'll make maintenance predictable. You'll design how we schedule, communicate and run maintenance windows so customers stay informed and in control, and disruption is rare and expected. - You'll help developers understand their database. Query performance, metrics, logs and advisors: you'll own the path from "my database is slow" to the fix. - You'll own our extension ecosystem. Which extensions we offer, how we evaluate and support new ones, and how we keep them working across versions. - You'll own Postgres security. Roles and permissions, Row Level Security ergonomics, secure defaults, and how we respond to Postgres and extension CVEs. - You'll talk to developers across the full spectrum, from indie developers on their first project to enterprises running critical workloads, and bring what you learn into every prioritization call. - You'll own the problem definition, requirements and success metrics for what we ship, such as upgrade success rate, the share of the fleet on supported versions, and time-to-diagnose for performance problems. You'll set the metric before the team builds, then track it after launch. - You'll keep Engineering, Support and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order, and communicate version changes and deprecations clearly to customers. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE - 4+ years of Product Management experience on databases, developer tools or infrastructure, or equivalent depth as an engineer, DBA or founder moving into product. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required. - Know Postgres well, or another relational database well enough to ramp quickly. You're comfortable reading EXPLAIN output and talking about replication, WAL, roles and extensions. - Have shipped products where reliability and trust are the experience. You treat downtime and breaking changes as product problems, not just operational ones. - Write clearly. Your specs, announcements and deprecation notices leave little room for confusion. - Build with what you own. You run queries, test upgrades and try extensions yourself, and form opinions through first-hand use. - Use AI to move faster. You use AI tools to compress research, drafting and feedback synthesis so you spend more time on judgment calls. - Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings. STRONG SIGNAL - Worked on a managed database service. - Ran Postgres in production: upgrades, tuning, incident response. - Worked on database observability, performance tooling, or security and compliance products. - Contributed to Postgres, its extensions, or the wider open-source community. - Shipped something using Supabase. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Principal Strategic Sourcing - Technology, you'll lead GitLab's sourcing strategy for hyperscalers, cloud marketplaces, and artificial intelligence (AI) suppliers, some of our largest and fastest-growing areas of spend. You'll own negotiations and supplier lifecycle management, working with executives on both sides of the table to secure agreements that balance cost, flexibility, and speed.</p> <p>You'll partner with FinOps, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, and Legal to turn hyperscaler commitments, marketplace programs, and AI pricing models into a competitive advantage. (APIs) and inference platforms, with fluency in token-based, consumption, and reserved-capacity pricing.</li> <li>A track record of closing multi-million-dollar, multi-year agreements with measurable savings and value.</li> <li>Confidence engaging and influencing executives, both internally and at suppliers, and strong partnership skills across FinOps, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, and title: Software Engineer, Web Infrastructure
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Web Infrastructure builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients so product engineers can ship fast, reliable, accessible experiences. As a junior engineer on the team, you’ll help make those experiences measurably faster and more resilient. You’ll investigate performance bottlenecks, improve how the client loads and responds, and help build tools that catch regressions earlier. You don’t need to arrive as a performance expert; we’re looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a desire to learn by shipping useful work. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Use browser tools and real-world data to investigate page-load and interaction bottlenecks, then turn findings into focused improvements. - Help build or improve performance tests, dashboards, and guardrails that make regressions easier to catch during development and rollout. - Ship scoped improvements to client loading, rendering, asset delivery, or caching, measuring their impact and checking for regressions. - Partner with Web Infrastructure and product engineers to land changes safely across Notion’s web clients. - Document what you learn and share clear recommendations so teams can make better performance tradeoffs. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Solid programming fundamentals and some experience building software with JavaScript or TypeScript; familiarity with React or another component-based UI framework is helpful. - Curiosity about how browsers work and how code affects page load, rendering, and interaction responsiveness. - A thoughtful debugging approach: you can break a problem down, gather evidence, and ask for help when you’re stuck. - Clear, kind communication and an interest in collaborating across teams. - Intellectual curiosity about AI-enabled engineering tools; you use them thoughtfully and review their output critically. Experience with performance profiling, browser developer tools, React profiling, bundlers, code splitting, service workers, asset caching, or performance testing is a plus—not a prerequisite. We welcome candidates who are excited about the work even if they don’t match every bullet. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year. As capacity allows, you will also support the broader Commercial Legal team on other matters. - Apply and further build out our playbook and risk framework independently, and escalate to the Assistant General Counsel, Commercial where a deal falls outside approved positions or raises novel legal risk. - Negotiate data, privacy, and security terms (DPAs, security exhibits, cross-border transfers) within the Security team’s playbook, and bring in the AGC, Commercial or Privacy for anything outside it. - Review AI vendor terms, such as training on our data, output ownership, and model changes. Build and scale vendor contracting operations - Build out and maintain our vendor playbook in Claude, so the whole team works from the same guidance and low-risk deals move without bottlenecks. - Design and improve intake, triage, and approval workflows with FinOps. - Own the vendor and procurement workflow in Ironclad, including intake, templates, approvals, and the repository, working with Legal Ops, who own the platform. Use it to track renewals and notice windows with FinOps and flag spend concentration risks. - Create training and self-serve resources for business partners, and raise the visibility of the contracts function as a business enabler. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Required - 6 to 8+ years of experience negotiating procurement, vendor, or technology transactions contracting, ideally buy-side at a U.S. SaaS or technology company, with deep knowledge of SaaS, cloud, and software licensing terms. - A track record of negotiating directly with vendors and their counsel, independently and at pace. - Strong working knowledge of privacy, data protection, and security terms in commercial contracts, including DPA negotiation and international data transfers. - Experience designing contracting processes that are consistent, transparent, and easy for the business to follow. - Clear writing and speaking, with the ability to explain legal and commercial risk plainly and the judgment to know when to hold a position, approve a reasonable risk, or escalate. - Comfort using AI tools, Claude in particular, with sound judgment about when to rely on outputs, how to verify them, and how to protect confidential information. Preferred - A degree in a relevant field (for example, law, economics, or political science), though we value experience over the specific degree. - Sell-side experience negotiating customer, partner, or reseller agreements for a SaaS or technology company, which helps you see vendor terms from the other side. - Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a similar CLM tool (Juro, Docusign CLM) or building AI-assisted legal workflows, ideally with some exposure to AI governance. - Experience working across jurisdictions or with distributed, international teams. - Experience at a fast-growing, developer-focused, cloud, security, or open source company. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. You will work with data, customer interactions, operational processes, teams and partners to uncover root causes, test assumptions and turn agreed actions into measurable results.</p> <p>Delivery is expected at every level within the pillar. Investigate systemic partner-wide issues within agreed focus areas, testing hypotheses to isolate root causes from symptoms and determining whether issues are genuinely thematic or belong within metrics—to spot underlying trends, exceptions, and performance patterns.</li> <li><strong>Qualitative field research & journey auditing:</strong> Conduct on-site process shadowing, customer journey reviews, and direct interviews with frontline partner and Monzo teams to evaluate actual operational practices against intended process design.</li> <li><strong>Evidence synthesis & impact documentation:</strong> Triangulate quantitative and qualitative findings to identify structural drivers (tools, policy, capability, or operating model), clearly documenting root causes, customer impacts, and required next steps.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Detailed project and workstream delivery</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Workstream planning & direct execution:</strong> Own the end-to-end momentum.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional & partner alignment:</strong> Serve as the day-to-day operational contact across Global Ops, GCOO, and partner teams—leading regular working sessions, setting clear delivery expectations, and constructively challenging missed commitments.</li> <li><strong>Risk governance & record management:</strong> Proactively identify and resolve risks, issues, and dependencies early, escalating material blockers while maintaining transparent, accurate delivery records and baseline progress tracking.</li> <li><strong>Operational readiness & BAU handover:</strong> Ensure implementation readiness, monitor post-launch performance to verify intended outcomes materialise, and support stabilisation through to formal transition into business-as-usual.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Insights, recommendations and business cases</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Insight synthesis & evidence auditability:</strong> Translate complex investigation findings into root-cause insights and actionable solutions, maintaining a robust evidence trail to validate strategic recommendations and decisions.</li> <li><strong>Business case & operational analysis:</strong> Author business cases for smaller initiatives and supply detailed analytical inputs—covering costs, benefits, risks, and customer impacts—for Manager-led strategic proposals.</li> <li><strong>Product & Tech process optimisation:</strong> Deliver operational analysis for Product and Technology proposals, evaluating system enhancements and process simplifications to optimise service delivery.</li> <li><strong>Leadership communications & stakeholder papers:</strong> Draft clear updates, briefing papers, and executive presentation materials to synthesise analytical data and drive leadership decision-making.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Team and portfolio contribution</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Portfolio mobility & cross-functional collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with leads on strategic initiatives while retaining full ownership of assigned workstreams, flexibly deploying capacity across the portfolio as business priorities evolve.</li> <li><strong>Proactive risk & insight generation:</strong> Identify emerging risks, operational patterns, and areas for investigation, sharing key learnings to refine future program design and global estate decisions.</li> <li><strong>Pillar standards & capability development:</strong> Drive continuous improvement by establishing consistent analytical and workstream frameworks across the pillar, while proactively expanding expertise in outsourced operations, partner management, and data analytics.</li> <li><strong>Global on-site engagement:</strong> Travel periodically within the UK and internationally to support on-site investigations, partner discovery, mobilisation, transitions, and operational stabilisation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Essential experience independently delivering defined projects or substantial workstreams from initial planning through implementation and handover.</strong></li> <li><strong>Clear history of working directly with external partners, </strong>proving you would have the confidence to represent Monzo professionally in day to day delivery conversations.</li> <li>Experience preparing delivery plans, analysis, updates, recommendations or business case content for stakeholder review.</li> <li>Strong planning and organisation skills, with the ability to coordinate detailed actions, owners and dependencies while maintaining attention to quality.</li> <li><strong>Ability to travel within the UK and internationally when required.</strong> We currently have sites in India, Romania and South Africa, with plans underway for the EU.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to find, interpret and combine data from different sources to answer business questions.</li> <li>Confidence using spreadsheets, reporting tools and operational data to identify patterns, test assumptions and measure outcomes.</li> <li>An investigative mindset and the curiosity to understand how work operates in practice.</li> <li>Experience or confidence undertaking customer interaction shadowing, case reviews, process observation and structured conversations with frontline teams.</li> <li>The ability to complete structured root cause analysis and distinguish isolated examples from wider operational or partner themes.</li> <li>Strong problem solving skills, with the ability to move from an unclear issue to evidence based findings and practical proposed actions.</li> <li>The ability to work independently with limited oversight while recognising when a risk, decision or dependency requires escalation.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to coordinate activity and challenge missed commitments across different teams.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make detailed or complex information clear and accessible.</li> <li>Sound judgement when balancing pace, customer outcomes, quality, risk, cost and operational practicality.</li> <li>Experience working in an operational, regulated or customer
